`depthWrite:false` can cause sorting with inner. But if depthWrite false, both visible. Maybe depthWrite true. Inner is physically below; outer should occlude. Transparent outer draw after opaque inner, okay. Outer `depthWrite:false` might show through too much. Use true default.
At camera top, outer surface overlays inner; green. underside inner is opaque, outer surface edge seen.

Could maybe make outer opacity 0.96. Pale under not visible. Add `transmission:.28` but without renderer transmission pass maybe. Fine.

Need `renderer.localClippingEnabled` no.

One concern: r128 `MeshPhysicalMaterial` transmission with `opacity .94` and transparent may require `renderer.sortObjects`. no.

```html
    (() => {

      });

      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.outputEncoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;

      // A small procedural environment gives the polished brass soft reflections.
      function makeEnvironmentTexture() {
        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.width = 1024;
        canvas.height = 512;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
        sky.addColorStop(0, "#1d272b");
        sky.addColorStop(0.46, "#4a514d");
        sky.addColorStop(0.55, "#25251f");
        sky.addColorStop(1, "#090a08");
        ctx.fillStyle = sky;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        function glow(x, y, radius, color) {
          const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, radius);
          gradient.addColorStop(0, color);
          gradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
          ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
          ctx.fillRect(x - radius, y - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2);
        }

        glow(175, 95, 220, "rgba(255,241,202,0.95)");
        glow(520, 125, 155, "rgba(190,220,230,0.58)");
        glow(825, 80, 205, "rgba(255,219,151,0.72)");

        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)";
        ctx.fillRect(95, 55, 24, 210);
        ctx.fillRect(735, 30, 15, 245);

        const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
        texture.mapping = THREE.EquirectangularReflectionMapping;
        texture.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;
        return texture;
      }

      // Utility functions ------------------------------------------------------

      function roundedRectShape(width, depth, radius) {
        const r = Math.min(radius, width / 2, depth / 2);
        const x = -width / 2;
        const y = -depth / 2;
        const shape = new THREE.Shape();

        shape.moveTo(x + r, y);
        shape.lineTo(x + width - r, y);
        shape.quadraticCurveTo(x + width, y, x + width, y + r);
        shape.lineTo(x + width, y + depth - r);
        shape.quadraticCurveTo(
          x + width,
          y + depth,
          x + width - r,
          y + depth
        );
        shape.lineTo(x + r, y + depth);
        shape.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + depth, x, y + depth - r);
        shape.lineTo(x, y + r);
        shape.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
        return shape;
      }

      function roundedBox(width, height, depth, radius, material, parent = scene) {
        const bevel = Math.min(radius * 0.55, height * 0.28);
        const shape = roundedRectShape(
          Math.max(0.002, width - bevel * 2),
          Math.max(0.002, depth - bevel * 2),
          Math.max(0.002, radius - bevel)
        );

        const geometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
          depth: Math.max(0.002, height - bevel * 2),
          bevelEnabled: true,
          bevelSegments: 3,
          bevelSize: bevel,
          bevelThickness: bevel,
          curveSegments: 12,
          steps: 1
        });

        geometry.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
        geometry.translate(0, -height / 2 + bevel, 0);

        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        mesh.castShadow = true;
        mesh.receiveShadow = true;
        parent.add(mesh);
        return mesh;
      }

      function cylinderBetween(a, b, radius, material, parent = scene, radialSegments = 16) {
        const start = new THREE.Vector3(...a);
        const end = new THREE.Vector3(...b);
        const direction = end.clone().sub(start);
        const length = direction.length();

        const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
          radius,
          radius,
          length,
          radialSegments,
          1,
          false
        );

        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
        mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
          direction.normalize()
        );
        mesh.castShadow = true;
        mesh.receiveShadow = true;
        parent.add(mesh);
        return mesh;
      }

      // Procedural wood for the desk.
      function makeWoodTexture() {
        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.width = 1024;
        canvas.height = 1024;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        ctx.fillStyle = "#51331f";
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        for (let i = 0; i < 1700; i++) {
          const y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
          const amplitude = 1 + Math.random() * 8;
          const frequency = 0.003 + Math.random() * 0.012;
          const phase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          const alpha = 0.018 + Math.random() * 0.055;
          const light = Math.random() > 0.54;

          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let x = 0; x <= canvas.width; x += 8) {
            const yy = y +
              Math.sin(x * frequency + phase) * amplitude +
              Math.sin(x * frequency * 0.31 + phase) * amplitude * 0.45;
            if (x === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, yy);
            else ctx.lineTo(x, yy);
          }

          ctx.strokeStyle = light
            ? `rgba(224,170,103,${alpha})`
            : `rgba(35,15,7,${alpha * 1.2})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.8;
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        const image = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        const data = image.data;

        for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
          const noise = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
          data[i] += noise;
          data[i + 1] += noise * 0.65;
          data[i + 2] += noise * 0.4;
        }

        ctx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);

        const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
        texture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
        texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
        texture.repeat.set(2.4, 1.7);
        texture.anisotropy = Math.min(8, renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy());
        texture.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;
        return texture;
      }

      // A custom curve creates a genuinely smooth vertical-to-horizontal
      // quarter bend, rather than a visibly segmented pipe.
      class LampArmCurve extends THREE.Curve {
        getPoint(t, target = new THREE.Vector3()) {
          const verticalEnd = 1.15;
          const curveStart = 0.46;
          const curveEnd = 0.76;
          const radius = 0.30;
          const rearZ = -0.28;

          if (t <= curveStart) {
            const u = t / curveStart;
            return target.set(
              0,
              THREE.MathUtils.lerp(0.42, verticalEnd, u),
              rearZ
            );
          }

          if (t <= curveEnd) {
            const u = (t - curveStart) / (curveEnd - curveStart);
            const theta = Math.PI - u * Math.PI / 2;
            return target.set(
              0,
              verticalEnd + radius * Math.sin(theta),
              radius * Math.cos(theta)
            );
          }

          const u = (t - curveEnd) / (1 - curveEnd);
          return target.set(
            0,
            verticalEnd + radius,
            THREE.MathUtils.lerp(0, 0.10, u)
          );
        }
      }

      const arm = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(
          new LampArmCurve(),
          120,
          0.052,
          16,
          false
        ),

      // Cased-glass shade -----------------------------------------------------

      const shade = new THREE.Group();
      shade.position.set(0, 1.29, 0.10);

      const shadeLength = 2.70;
      const shadeWidth = 0.47;
      const shadeHeight = 0.22;
      const halfLength = shadeLength / 2;
      const glassThickness = 0.035;

      function makeArchSurface(offset, reverseNormals) {
        const xSegments = 4;
        const arcSegments = 48;
        const positions = [];
        const indices = [];

        for (let i = 0; i <= xSegments; i++) {
          const x = -halfLength + (i / xSegments) * shadeLength;

          for (let j = 0; j <= arcSegments; j++) {
            const theta = (j / arcSegments) * Math.PI;
            const z = -shadeWidth * Math.cos(theta);
            const y = shadeHeight * Math.sin(theta) + offset;
            positions.push(x, y, z);
          }
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < xSegments; i++) {
          for (let j = 0; j < arcSegments; j++) {
            const a = i * (arcSegments + 1) + j;
            const b = (i + 1) * (arcSegments + 1) + j;
            const c = a + 1;
            const d = b + 1;

            if (reverseNormals) {
              indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
            } else {
              indices.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
            }
          }
        }

        const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        geometry.setAttribute(
          "position",
          new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
        );
        geometry.setIndex(indices);
        geometry.computeVertexNormals();
        return geometry;
      }

      const outerShell = new THREE.Mesh(
        makeArchSurface(0, false),
        greenGlass
      );
      outerShell.renderOrder = 2;
      shade.add(outerShell);

      const innerShell = new THREE.Mesh(
        makeArchSurface(-glassThickness, true),
        paleGlass
      );
      innerShell.renderOrder = 1;
      shade.add(innerShell);

      // Thin brass rails define the lower edges of the glass.
      cylinderBetween(
        [-halfLength, -0.003, -shadeWidth],
        [halfLength, -0.003, -shadeWidth],
        0.022,
        brassBright,
        shade,
        14
      );

      cylinderBetween(
        [-halfLength, -0.003, shadeWidth],
        [halfLength, -0.003, shadeWidth],
        0.022,
        brassBright,
        shade,
        14
      );

      function makeEndProfile(width, height, bottom) {
        const shape = new THREE.Shape();
        shape.moveTo(-width, bottom);
        shape.lineTo(-width, 0);

        for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) {
          const theta = (i / 40) * Math.PI;
          shape.lineTo(
            -width * Math.cos(theta),
            height * Math.sin(theta)
          );
        }

        shape.lineTo(width, bottom);
        shape.closePath();
        return shape;
      }

      function makeEndMesh(profile, thickness, startX, direction, material) {
        const geometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(profile, {
          depth: thickness,
          bevelEnabled: false,
          curveSegments: 20,
          steps: 1
        });

        geometry.rotateY(direction > 0 ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2);
        geometry.translate(startX, 0, 0);

        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        mesh.castShadow = true;
        mesh.receiveShadow = true;
        shade.add(mesh);
        return mesh;
      }

      // Squared brass end caps.
      const capProfile = makeEndProfile(
        shadeWidth + 0.025,
        shadeHeight + 0.02,

      makeEndMesh(capProfile, 0.04, halfLength - 0.04, 1, brass);

      // Green outer end panes and pale inner end panes leave a narrow brass rim.

      makeEndMesh(paleEndProfile, 0.016, -halfLength + 0.04, 1, paleGlass);

      keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.0003;
      scene.add(keyLight);

      const rimLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xa8c9d8, 1.05);
      rimLight.position.set(4, 3.5, -3.5);
      scene.add(rimLight);

      const softFill = new THREE.PointLight(0xffd6a0, 0.45, 8);
      softFill.position.set(2.5, 3.5, 4);
      scene.add(softFill);

      // The bulb lights the pale inner surface and throws a warm pool downward.
      const bulbLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffc16a, 1.15, 2.8, 2);
      bulbLight.position.set(0, 0.055, 0);
      shade.add(bulbLight);

      const deskSpot = new THREE.SpotLight(
        0xffbf68,
        2.25,
        4.5,
        1.02,
        0.9,
        1.4
      );
      deskSpot.position.set(0, 0.03, 0);
      deskSpot.castShadow = true;
      deskSpot.shadow.mapSize.set(1024, 1024);
      deskSpot.shadow.camera.near = 0.05;
      deskSpot.shadow.camera.far = 5;
      deskSpot.shadow.bias = -0.0004;

      const spotTarget = new THREE.Object3D();
      spotTarget.position.set(0, -2.2, 0);
      shade.add(deskSpot);
      shade.add(spotTarget);
      deskSpot.target = spotTarget;

      // Camera interaction -----------------------------------------------------

      const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.92, 0);
      let radius = 5.35;
      let theta = 0.52;
      let phi = 1.28;
      let dragging = false;
      let previousX = 0;
      let previousY = 0;

      function updateCamera() {
        camera.position.set(
          target.x + radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta),
          target.y + radius * Math.cos(phi),
          target.z + radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta)
        );
        camera.lookAt(target);
      }

      renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
        dragging = true;
        previousX = event.clientX;
        previousY = event.clientY;
        renderer.domElement.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      });

      renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointermove", event => {
        if (!dragging) return;

        const deltaX = event.clientX - previousX;
        const deltaY = event.clientY - previousY;
        previousX = event.clientX;
        previousY = event.clientY;

        theta -= deltaX * 0.005;
        phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(phi + deltaY * 0.004, 0.72, 1.48);
        updateCamera();
      });

      function endDrag(event) {
        dragging = false;
        if (renderer.domElement.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
          renderer.domElement.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        }
      }

      renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerup", endDrag);
      renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);

      renderer.domElement.addEventListener(
        "wheel",
        event => {
          event.preventDefault();
          radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            radius + event.deltaY * 0.0035,
            3.4,
            8.2
          );
          updateCamera();
        },
        { passive: false }
      );

      renderer.domElement.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
        radius = 5.35;
        theta = 0.52;
        phi = 1.28;
        updateCamera();
      });

      function resize() {
        const width = window.innerWidth;
        const height = window.innerHeight;

        camera.aspect = width / height;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

        renderer.setSize(width, height);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      }

      window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

      updateCamera();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const canvas = document.querySelector("#scene");

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      canvas,
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xb9dce9);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xb9dce9, 48, 165);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      43,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.08,
      280
    );

    // Custom orbit/follow camera. No addons are used.
    const orbit = {
      target: new THREE.Vector3(-4.2, 1.0, 0),
      radius: 13.5,
      theta: 0.76,
      phi: 1.05,
      following: false
    };

    const spherical = new THREE.Spherical();

    function updateCamera() {
      spherical.set(orbit.radius, orbit.phi, orbit.theta);
      camera.position.setFromSpherical(spherical).add(orbit.target);
      camera.lookAt(orbit.target);
    }

    updateCamera();

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting and sky
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xe8f6ff, 0x657b45, 2.15);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const sunlight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1d4, 3.1);
    sunlight.position.set(-16, 21, 11);
    sunlight.castShadow = true;
    sunlight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    sunlight.shadow.camera.left = -19;
    sunlight.shadow.camera.right = 19;
    sunlight.shadow.camera.top = 19;
    sunlight.shadow.camera.bottom = -19;
    sunlight.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    sunlight.shadow.camera.far = 60;
    sunlight.shadow.bias = -0.00035;
    sunlight.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    scene.add(sunlight);
    scene.add(sunlight.target);

    const sky = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(190, 32, 18),
      new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
        side: THREE.BackSide,
        depthWrite: false,
        uniforms: {
          topColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0x78b9d7) },
          horizonColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xdcecf0) },
          lowerColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xf3ead1) }
        },
        vertexShader: `
          varying vec3 vPosition;
          void main() {
            vPosition = position;
            gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
          }
        `,
        fragmentShader: `
          uniform vec3 topColor;
          uniform vec3 horizonColor;
          uniform vec3 lowerColor;
          varying vec3 vPosition;
          void main() {
            float h = normalize(vPosition).y;
            vec3 color = mix(lowerColor, horizonColor, smoothstep(-0.35, 0.08, h));
            color = mix(color, topColor, smoothstep(0.02, 0.88, h));
            gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
          }
        `
      })
    );
    sky.renderOrder = -10;
    scene.add(sky);

    function makeSunTexture() {
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = c.height = 128;
      const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 3, 64, 64, 64);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,250,210,1)");
      g.addColorStop(0.18, "rgba(255,240,180,.95)");
      g.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(255,228,150,.25)");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,228,150,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      return texture;
    }

    const sunSprite = new THREE.Sprite(
      new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
        map: makeSunTexture(),
        transparent: true,
        depthWrite: false,
        fog: false
      })
    );
    sunSprite.position.set(-45, 42, -85);
    sunSprite.scale.set(25, 25, 1);
    scene.add(sunSprite);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function makeBalsaTexture() {
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = 1024;
      c.height = 256;
      const ctx = c.getContext("2d");

      ctx.fillStyle = "#d6a866";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);

      for (let i = 0; i < 190; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * c.width;
        const width = 0.4 + Math.random() * 2.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, 0);

        for (let y = 0; y <= c.height; y += 16) {
          ctx.lineTo(
            x + Math.sin(y * 0.035 + i) * (1.2 + Math.random() * 1.8),
            y
          );
        }

        ctx.strokeStyle = i % 5 === 0
          ? "rgba(112,70,30,.19)"
          : "rgba(255,231,176,.17)";
        ctx.lineWidth = width;
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * c.width;
        const y = Math.random() * c.height;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(x, y, 8 + Math.random() * 18, 2 + Math.random() * 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(104,61,27,.12)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    function makeGrassTexture() {
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = c.height = 512;
      const ctx = c.getContext("2d");

      ctx.fillStyle = "#6f8c4b";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

      for (let i = 0; i < 7000; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 512;
        const y = Math.random() * 512;
        const green = 70 + Math.random() * 65;
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${green - 25},${green + 18},${green - 28},.30)`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.5 + Math.random();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        ctx.lineTo(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4, y - 2 - Math.random() * 6);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(225,207,130,.14)";
        ctx.fillRect(Math.random() * 512, Math.random() * 512, 2, 2);
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(30, 30);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    function makeRunwayTexture() {
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = 1024;
      c.height = 256;
      const ctx = c.getContext("2d");

      ctx.fillStyle = "#c9b88b";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 256);

      for (let i = 0; i < 9000; i++) {
        const light = Math.random() > 0.5;
        ctx.fillStyle = light
          ? "rgba(255,244,203,.15)"
          : "rgba(85,73,48,.12)";
        const size = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.7;
        ctx.fillRect(Math.random() * 1024, Math.random() * 256, size, size);
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(8, 1);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    const balsaTexture = makeBalsaTexture();
    const grassTexture = makeGrassTexture();
    const runwayTexture = makeRunwayTexture();

    // Distant low-poly trees.
    const trunkMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x725139,
      roughness: 1
    });

    const leafMaterials = [
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x496d43, roughness: 1 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5b7b46, roughness: 1 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6e884d, roughness: 1 })
    ];

    function addTree(x, z, scale) {
      const tree = new THREE.Group();

      const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.12 * scale, 0.18 * scale, 1.6 * scale, 7),
        trunkMaterial
      );
      trunk.position.y = 0.8 * scale;
      tree.add(trunk);

      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        const foliage = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.ConeGeometry(
            (1.05 - i * 0.25) * scale,
            2.3 * scale,
            8
          ),
          leafMaterials[(i + Math.floor(x)) % leafMaterials.length]
        );
        foliage.position.y = (1.9 + i * 1.15) * scale;
        foliage.rotation.y = i * 0.5;
        tree.add(foliage);
      }

      tree.position.set(x, 0, z);
      scene.add(tree);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
      const x = -55 + Math.random() * 110;
      const side = i % 2 === 0 ? -1 : 1;
      const z = side * (11 + Math.random() * 31);
      addTree(x, z, 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.25);
    }

    // Soft cloud clusters.
    const cloudMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.82,
      depthWrite: false
    });

    function addCloud(x, y, z, scale) {
      const cloud = new THREE.Group();

      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const puff = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 10),
          cloudMaterial
        );
        puff.position.set(
          (i - 2) * 1.2,
          Math.sin(i * 1.7) * 0.28,
          Math.cos(i * 1.3) * 0.34
        );
        puff.scale.set(
          1.1 + Math.random() * 0.75,
          0.62 + Math.random() * 0.35,
          0.8 + Math.random() * 0.5
        );
        cloud.add(puff);
      }

      cloud.position.set(x, y, z);
      cloud.scale.setScalar(scale);
      scene.add(cloud);
    }

    addCloud(-28, 15, -38, 2.0);
    addCloud(12, 20, -58, 2.8);
    addCloud(42, 14, -27, 1.8);
    addCloud(-50, 18, 28, 2.2);
    addCloud(22, 24, 44, 2.6);
    addCloud(66, 17, -12, 2.1);

    // Wind sock.
    const windsock = new THREE.Group();
    const pole = new THREE.Mesh(

      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x59665d, roughness: 0.8 })
    );
    pole.position.set(-9.4, 1.125, 4.3);
    pole.castShadow = true;
    scene.add(pole);

    windsock.position.set(-9.4, 2.18, 4.3);

    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const radiusStart = 0.14 - i * 0.018;
      const radiusEnd = 0.14 - (i + 1) * 0.018;
      const segment = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radiusEnd, radiusStart, 0.31, 10),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: i % 2 === 0 ? 0xe05a3c : 0xf4eee0,
          roughness: 0.9

      );
      segment.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 2;
      segment.position.x = 0.16 + i * 0.305;
      windsock.add(segment);

    scene.add(windsock);

    // Launch marker.

    function makeGroundLabelTexture() {
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = 512;
      c.height = 128;
      const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);

      return texture;
    }

    const launchLabel = new THREE.Mesh(

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Glider construction
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const glider = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(glider);

    const balsaMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: balsaTexture,
      color: 0xffe2ae,
      roughness: 0.78,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const darkWoodMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x8b542c,
      roughness: 0.85
    });

    const redMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xd84932,
      roughness: 0.58
    });

    const creamMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xf3dfb0,
      roughness: 0.75
    });

    function makeFuselageGeometry() {
      const rings = [
        { x: -1.75, r: 0.025, y: 0.18 },
        { x: -1.42, r: 0.075, y: 0.17 },
        { x: -0.82, r: 0.125, y: 0.13 },
        { x: -0.10, r: 0.16, y: 0.09 },
        { x: 0.62, r: 0.155, y: 0.055 },
        { x: 1.18, r: 0.105, y: 0.045 },
        { x: 1.50, r: 0.028, y: 0.045 }
      ];

      const segments = 14;
      const positions = [];
      const uvs = [];
      const indices = [];

      for (const ring of rings) {
        for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
          const angle = (j / segments) * Math.PI * 2;
          positions.push(
            ring.x,
            ring.y + Math.sin(angle) * ring.r * 0.74,
            Math.cos(angle) * ring.r
          );
          uvs.push(j / segments, (ring.x + 1.75) / 3.25);
        }
      }

      for (let r = 0; r < rings.length - 1; r++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
          const nextJ = (j + 1) % segments;
          const a = r * segments + j;
          const b = r * segments + nextJ;
          const c = (r + 1) * segments + j;
          const d = (r + 1) * segments + nextJ;
          indices.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
        }
      }

      const tailCenter = positions.length / 3;
      positions.push(-1.78, 0.18, 0);
      uvs.push(0.5, 0);

      const noseCenter = positions.length / 3;
      positions.push(1.53, 0.045, 0);
      uvs.push(0.5, 1);

      for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
        const nextJ = (j + 1) % segments;
        indices.push(tailCenter, j, nextJ);
        const last = (rings.length - 1) * segments;
        indices.push(noseCenter, last + nextJ, last + j);
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute("uv", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();
      return geometry;
    }

    const fuselage = new THREE.Mesh(
      makeFuselageGeometry(),
      balsaMaterial
    );
    fuselage.castShadow = true;
    fuselage.receiveShadow = true;
    glider.add(fuselage);

    function makeWingGeometry() {
      const halfSpan = 2.7;
      const sections = [-halfSpan, 0, halfSpan];
      const positions = [];
      const uvs = [];
      const indices = [];

      for (const z of sections) {
        const ratio = Math.abs(z) / halfSpan;
        const leading = -0.58 + ratio * 0.14;
        const trailing = 0.76 - ratio * 0.16;
        const baseY = 0.13 + ratio * 0.28;
        const thickness = 0.045 - ratio * 0.009;

        // Top leading, top trailing, bottom leading, bottom trailing.
        positions.push(
          leading, baseY + thickness, z,
          trailing, baseY + thickness, z,
          leading, baseY - thickness * 0.35, z,
          trailing, baseY - thickness * 0.35, z
        );

        uvs.push(
          0, (z + halfSpan) / (halfSpan * 2),
          1, (z + halfSpan) / (halfSpan * 2),
          0, (z + halfSpan) / (halfSpan * 2),
          1, (z + halfSpan) / (halfSpan * 2)
        );
      }

      for (let s = 0; s < sections.length - 1; s++) {
        const a = s * 4;
        const b = (s + 1) * 4;

        indices.push(
          a, a + 1, b + 1, a, b + 1, b,
          a + 2, b + 2, b + 3, a + 2, b + 3, a + 3,
          a, b, b + 2, a, b + 2, a + 2,
          a + 1, a + 3, b + 3, a + 1, b + 3, b + 1
        );
      }

      indices.push(
        0, 2, 3, 0, 3, 1,
        8, 9, 11, 8, 11, 10
      );

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute("uv", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();
      return geometry;
    }

    const wingGeometry = makeWingGeometry();
    const wing = new THREE.Mesh(
      wingGeometry,
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        map: balsaTexture,
        color: 0xffdda2,
        roughness: 0.8,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      })
    );
    wing.castShadow = true;
    wing.receiveShadow = true;
    glider.add(wing);

    const wingBasePositions = Float32Array.from(
      wingGeometry.attributes.position.array
    );

    function cylinderBetween(start, end, radius, material, radialSegments = 7) {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
      const length = direction.length();
      const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
        radius,
        radius,
        length,
        radialSegments
      );
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      return mesh;
    }

    // Exposed wing ribs.
    for (const z of [-2.15, 0, 2.15]) {
      const ratio = Math.abs(z) / 2.7;
      const leading = -0.58 + ratio * 0.14;
      const trailing = 0.76 - ratio * 0.16;
      const y = 0.13 + ratio * 0.28 + 0.052;

      glider.add(
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(leading + 0.04, y, z),
          new THREE.Vector3(trailing - 0.05, y, z),
          0.012,
          darkWoodMaterial
        )
      );
    }

    // Red tip flashes painted on the upper wing.
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const tip = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.62, 0.018, 0.23),
        redMaterial
      );
      const ratio = 0.83;
      tip.position.set(
        0.12,
        0.13 + ratio * 0.28 + 0.056,
        side * 2.27
      );
      tip.rotation.x = side * -0.095;
      tip.castShadow = true;
      glider.add(tip);
    }

    // Lower fuselage keel and braces.
    glider.add(
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(-1.45, 0.09, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(1.18, 0.025, 0),
        0.025,
        darkWoodMaterial
      )
    );

    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      glider.add(
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(-1.2, 0.14, side * 0.58),
          new THREE.Vector3(-0.48, 0.08, 0),
          0.018,
          darkWoodMaterial
        )
      );
    }

    // Red nose band.
    const noseBand = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.112, 0.018, 8, 28),
      redMaterial
    );
    noseBand.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
    noseBand.position.set(0.92, 0.045, 0);
    noseBand.castShadow = true;
    glider.add(noseBand);

    // Horizontal stabilizer.
    const tailWing = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.72, 0.045, 1.68),
      creamMaterial
    );
    tailWing.position.set(-1.27, 0.13, 0);
    tailWing.castShadow = true;
    glider.receiveShadow = true;
    glider.add(tailWing);

    // Red tail flash.
    const tailFlash = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.13, 0.052, 1.69),
      redMaterial
    );
    tailFlash.position.set(-1.57, 0.13, 0);
    tailFlash.castShadow = true;
    glider.add(tailFlash);

    // Vertical tail.
    const finShape = new THREE.Shape();
    finShape.moveTo(0, 0);
    finShape.lineTo(0.72, 0);
    finShape.lineTo(0.48, 0.61);
    finShape.lineTo(0.12, 0.55);
    finShape.closePath();

    const fin = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(finShape, {
        depth: 0.045,
        bevelEnabled: true,
        bevelSegments: 1,
        steps: 1,
        bevelSize: 0.008,
        bevelThickness: 0.008
      }),
      balsaMaterial
    );
    fin.position.set(-1.64, 0.16, -0.0225);
    fin.castShadow = true;
    glider.add(fin);

    // Painted wing lettering.
    function makeWingLabelTexture() {
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = 1024;
      c.height = 256;
      const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);

      ctx.fillStyle = "#c83e2c";
      ctx.font = "900 112px Arial, sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText("CHUCK", 512, 102);

      ctx.fillStyle = "#5a3823";
      ctx.font = "700 28px Arial, sans-serif";
      ctx.letterSpacing = "10px";
      ctx.fillText("BALSA  ·  FLIGHT 01", 512, 193);

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      return texture;
    }

    const wingLabel = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.24, 0.31),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        map: makeWingLabelTexture(),
        transparent: true,
        depthWrite: false,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      })
    );
    wingLabel.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    wingLabel.position.set(0.1, 0.192, 0);
    glider.add(wingLabel);

    // Small red launch grip underneath the nose.
    const launchGrip = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.23, 0.045, 0.085),
      redMaterial
    );
    launchGrip.position.set(0.78, -0.065, 0);
    launchGrip.rotation.z = -0.18;
    launchGrip.castShadow = true;
    glider.add(launchGrip);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Flight state and animation
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const state = {
      launched: false,
      paused: false,
      flightTime: 0,
      wind: 0.15
    };

    const launchButton = document.querySelector("#launch");
    const resetButton = document.querySelector("#reset");
    const pauseButton = document.querySelector("#pause");
    const windInput = document.querySelector("#wind");
    const windValue = document.querySelector("#windValue");
    const statusElement = document.querySelector("#status");
    const timerElement = document.querySelector("#timer");
    const altitudeElement = document.querySelector("#altitude");
    const overviewButton = document.querySelector("#overview");
    const followButton = document.querySelector("#follow");

    function resetGlider() {
      state.launched = false;
      state.paused = false;
      state.flightTime = 0;

      glider.position.set(-7, 0.32, 0);
      glider.rotation.set(0, 0, 0.035);

      launchButton.disabled = false;
      pauseButton.textContent = "Pause";
      statusElement.textContent = "On launch pad";
      statusElement.classList.remove("flying");
      timerElement.textContent = "00.0 s";
      altitudeElement.textContent = "Altitude 0.0";
    }

    function launchGlider() {
      if (state.launched) return;

      state.launched = true;
      state.paused = false;
      state.flightTime = 0;
      launchButton.disabled = true;
      pauseButton.textContent = "Pause";
      statusElement.textContent = "Hand launch";
      statusElement.classList.add("flying");
    }

    function togglePause() {
      if (!state.launched) return;
      state.paused = !state.paused;
      pauseButton.textContent = state.paused ? "Resume" : "Pause";
    }

    launchButton.addEventListener("click", launchGlider);
    resetButton.addEventListener("click", resetGlider);
    pauseButton.addEventListener("click", togglePause);

    windInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
      state.wind = Number(windInput.value);

      if (state.wind < -0.08) {
        windValue.textContent = "Light left";
      } else if (state.wind > 0.08) {
        windValue.textContent = "Light right";
      } else {
        windValue.textContent = "Calm";
      }
    });

    overviewButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      orbit.following = false;
      orbit.target.set(-4.2, 1, 0);
      orbit.radius = 13.5;
      orbit.theta = 0.76;
      orbit.phi = 1.05;

      overviewButton.classList.add("active");
      followButton.classList.remove("active");
    });

    followButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      orbit.following = true;
      orbit.radius = 8.4;
      orbit.theta = -1.48;
      orbit.phi = 1.08;

      followButton.classList.add("active");
      overviewButton.classList.remove("active");
    });

    function updateFlight(dt) {
      if (state.launched && !state.paused) {
        state.flightTime += dt;
      }

      const t = state.flightTime;

      if (!state.launched) {
        glider.position.set(-7, 0.32, 0);
        glider.rotation.set(0, 0, 0.035);
      } else if (t < 1.25) {
        // Initial hand-launch impulse: a fast climb and gentle release.
        const u = t / 1.25;

        glider.position.set(
          -7 + 7.2 * u,
          0.32 + 4.1 * u - 1.25 * u * u,
          Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * 0.08
        );

        glider.rotation.set(
          0,
          0,
          0.035 + 0.16 * Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 0.5) * (1 - u * 0.35)
        );
      } else {
        // Gentle soaring: lift oscillation, shallow climb and wind drift.
        const u = t - 1.25;
        const wind = state.wind;

        glider.position.set(
          0.2 + 6.7 * u,
          3.22 + Math.sin(u * 0.68) * 0.68 + u * 0.03,
          Math.sin(u * 0.25) * 0.6 + wind * u * 0.16
        );

        glider.rotation.set(
          Math.sin(u * 0.52) * 0.13,
          -Math.sin(u * 0.25) * 0.1 - wind * u * 0.015,
          0.045 + Math.sin(u * 0.44) * 0.025
        );
      }

      const altitude = Math.max(0, glider.position.y);
      altitudeElement.textContent = `Altitude ${altitude.toFixed(1)}`;
      timerElement.textContent = `${t.toFixed(1).padStart(4, "0")} s`;

      if (state.paused) {
        statusElement.textContent = "Paused";
      } else if (!state.launched) {
        statusElement.textContent = "On launch pad";
      } else if (t < 1.25) {
        statusElement.textContent = "Hand launch";
      } else {
        statusElement.textContent = "Soaring";
      }
    }

    let flexFrame = 0;

    function animateWingFlex(time) {
      const positions = wingGeometry.attributes.position.array;
      const flightAmount = state.launched ? 1 : 0.28;

      for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 3) {
        const x = wingBasePositions[i];
        const y = wingBasePositions[i + 1];
        const z = wingBasePositions[i + 2];
        const tipWeight = Math.pow(Math.abs(z) / 2.7, 1.6);
        const flex =
          Math.sin(time * 7.5 + z * 1.35) *
          0.012 *
          tipWeight *
          flightAmount;

        positions[i] = x;
        positions[i + 1] = y + flex;
        positions[i + 2] = z;
      }

      wingGeometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;

      flexFrame++;
      if (flexFrame % 4 === 0) {
        wingGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
      }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom pointer camera controls
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    let dragging = false;
    let pointerX = 0;
    let pointerY = 0;

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      dragging = true;
      pointerX = event.clientX;
      pointerY = event.clientY;
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!dragging) return;

      const dx = event.clientX - pointerX;
      const dy = event.clientY - pointerY;
      pointerX = event.clientX;
      pointerY = event.clientY;

      orbit.theta -= dx * 0.006;
      orbit.phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(orbit.phi - dy * 0.005, 0.25, 1.48);
    });

    function stopDragging(event) {
      dragging = false;
      if (canvas.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
        canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      }
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", stopDragging);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", stopDragging);

    canvas.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        orbit.radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          orbit.radius * Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001),
          3.2,
          42
        );
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.code === "Space") {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (state.launched) {
          togglePause();
        } else {
          launchGlider();
        }
      }

      if (event.key.toLowerCase() === "r") {
        resetGlider();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Render loop
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();
    const desiredTarget = new THREE.Vector3();

    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);

      const dt = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);
      const elapsed = clock.elapsedTime;

      updateFlight(dt);
      animateWingFlex(elapsed);

      // Keep the shadow camera centered on the moving aircraft.
      sunlight.position.set(
        glider.position.x - 11,
        glider.position.y + 18,
        glider.position.z + 9
      );
      sunlight.target.position.copy(glider.position);
      sunlight.target.updateMatrixWorld();

      // Pulsing launch ring, fading after release.
      const markerPulse = 1 + Math.sin(elapsed * 3.2) * 0.055;
      markerRing.scale.setScalar(markerPulse);
      markerMaterial.opacity =
        state.launched
          ? Math.max(0, 0.68 - state.flightTime * 0.75)
          : 0.68;
      launchLabel.material.opacity = markerMaterial.opacity;

      // The windsock points and lifts according to the wind control.
      windsock.rotation.y = -0.35 + state.wind * 1.25;
      windsock.rotation.z = 0.12 + Math.abs(state.wind) * 0.22;
      windsock.rotation.x = Math.sin(elapsed * 3.1) * 0.03 * Math.abs(state.wind);

      if (orbit.following) {
        desiredTarget.copy(glider.position);
        desiredTarget.y += 0.18;
        orbit.target.lerp(
          desiredTarget,
          1 - Math.exp(-dt * 4.5)
        );
      }

      updateCamera();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    resetGlider();
    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const canvas = document.querySelector("#scene");

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      canvas,
      antialias: true,
      alpha: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight, false);
    renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      35,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      50
    );

    const cameraTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.72, 0);

    // Camera state, implemented without external controls.
    const initialCamera = {
      theta: 0.58,
      phi: 1.08,
      radius: 5.1
    };

    const cameraState = { ...initialCamera };
    const desiredCamera = { ...initialCamera };

    function updateCamera() {
      const sinPhi = Math.sin(cameraState.phi);

      camera.position.set(
        cameraTarget.x +
          cameraState.radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(cameraState.theta),
        cameraTarget.y + cameraState.radius * Math.cos(cameraState.phi),
        cameraTarget.z +
          cameraState.radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(cameraState.theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(cameraTarget);
    }

    updateCamera();

    // Lighting.
    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(
      0xfff8ef,
      0x38232d,
      1.65
    );
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const lightTarget = new THREE.Object3D();
    lightTarget.position.set(0, 0.72, 0);
    scene.add(lightTarget);

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe9d9, 3.2);
    keyLight.position.set(-3.8, 6.5, 4.6);
    keyLight.target = lightTarget;
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 15;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.00035;
    keyLight.shadow.normalBias = 0.018;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xc8dcff, 0.9);
    fillLight.position.set(4.5, 3.2, -3.5);
    fillLight.target = lightTarget;
    scene.add(fillLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xff785b, 1.15);
    rimLight.position.set(0.5, 2.7, -5.5);
    rimLight.target = lightTarget;
    scene.add(rimLight);

    /*
     * Red blood cell cross-section.
     *
     * The profile begins at the lower center, travels outward over the
     * concave lower face, around the rounded rim, and inward over the
     * concave upper face. Revolving it around Y produces a closed,
     * biconcave membrane.
     */
    const CELL_RADIUS = 1.16;
    const INNER_RADIUS = 0.84;
    const CENTER_DEPTH = 0.17;
    const RIM_HEIGHT = 0.51;
    const CURVE_WIDTH = 0.38;

    function topSurfaceHeight(radius) {
      const rise =
        1 -
        Math.exp(-Math.pow(radius / CURVE_WIDTH, 2));

      return CENTER_DEPTH + (RIM_HEIGHT - CENTER_DEPTH) * rise;
    }

    function buildCellProfile() {
      const points = [];
      const radialSteps = 42;
      const rimSteps = 36;

      // Lower center.
      points.push(new THREE.Vector2(0, -CENTER_DEPTH));

      // Concave lower face, moving outward.
      for (let i = 1; i <= radialSteps; i++) {
        const radius = (INNER_RADIUS * i) / radialSteps;
        points.push(
          new THREE.Vector2(radius, -topSurfaceHeight(radius))
        );
      }

      // Lower half of the rounded outer rim.
      for (let i = 1; i <= rimSteps; i++) {
        const t = i / rimSteps;
        const angle = t * Math.PI * 0.5;

        const radius =
          INNER_RADIUS +
          (CELL_RADIUS - INNER_RADIUS) * Math.sin(angle);

        const height = -RIM_HEIGHT * Math.cos(angle);

        points.push(new THREE.Vector2(radius, height));
      }

      // Upper half of the rounded outer rim.
      for (let i = 1; i <= rimSteps; i++) {
        const t = i / rimSteps;
        const angle = t * Math.PI * 0.5;

        const radius =
          CELL_RADIUS -
          (CELL_RADIUS - INNER_RADIUS) * Math.sin(angle);

        const height = RIM_HEIGHT * Math.sin(angle);

        points.push(new THREE.Vector2(radius, height));
      }

      // Concave upper face, moving inward to the center.
      for (let i = radialSteps - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const radius = (INNER_RADIUS * i) / radialSteps;
        points.push(
          new THREE.Vector2(radius, topSurfaceHeight(radius))
        );
      }

      return points;
    }

    const cellGeometry = new THREE.LatheGeometry(
      buildCellProfile(),
      192
    );

    // Radial vertex-color gradient:
    // light orange at the center, vivid red in the middle,
    // and deep burgundy along the outer rim.
    const centerColor = new THREE.Color(0xff8b42);
    const middleColor = new THREE.Color(0xdb301f);
    const edgeColor = new THREE.Color(0x590710);

    const position = cellGeometry.attributes.position;
    const colorValues = new Float32Array(position.count * 3);
    const workingColor = new THREE.Color();

    for (let i = 0; i < position.count; i++) {
      const radialPosition =
        Math.hypot(position.getX(i), position.getZ(i)) /
        CELL_RADIUS;

      const t = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(radialPosition, 0, 1);

      if (t < 0.62) {
        workingColor.lerpColors(
          centerColor,
          middleColor,
          THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(t, 0, 0.62)
        );
      } else {
        workingColor.lerpColors(
          middleColor,
          edgeColor,
          THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(t, 0.62, 1)
        );
      }

      colorValues[i * 3] = workingColor.r;
      colorValues[i * 3 + 1] = workingColor.g;
      colorValues[i * 3 + 2] = workingColor.b;
    }

    cellGeometry.setAttribute(
      "color",
      new THREE.BufferAttribute(colorValues, 3)
    );

    const cellMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      vertexColors: true,
      roughness: 0.28,
      metalness: 0,
      clearcoat: 0.72,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.2,
      sheen: 0.38,
      sheenColor: new THREE.Color(0xff6440),
      sheenRoughness: 0.55,
      specularIntensity: 0.7,
      specularColor: new THREE.Color(0xffffff),
      ior: 1.36,
      emissive: new THREE.Color(0x190102),
      emissiveIntensity: 0.08
    });

    const cell = new THREE.Mesh(cellGeometry, cellMaterial);
    cell.position.y = 0.82;
    cell.castShadow = true;
    cell.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(cell);

    /*
     * Slim circular display stand.
     * A separate lathed profile provides a flat top and rounded bevels.
     */
    const standProfile = [
      new THREE.Vector2(0.00, 0.002),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.25, 0.002),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.34, 0.005),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.40, 0.014),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.445, 0.032),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.460, 0.057),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.460, 0.235),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.454, 0.264),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.438, 0.286),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.414, 0.301),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.378, 0.309),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.330, 0.312),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.000, 0.312)
    ];

    const standGeometry = new THREE.LatheGeometry(
      standProfile,
      160
    );

    const standMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: 0x191b20,
      metalness: 0.72,
      roughness: 0.3,
      clearcoat: 0.22,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.32
    });

    const stand = new THREE.Mesh(standGeometry, standMaterial);
    stand.castShadow = true;
    stand.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(stand);

    // Transparent shadow-catching floor over the CSS background.
    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 30),
      new THREE.ShadowMaterial({
        color: 0x4a2823,
        opacity: 0.18
      })
    );

    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI * 0.5;
    floor.position.y = 0;
    floor.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(floor);

    // Pointer-based orbit controls.
    const pointers = new Map();
    let previousPinchDistance = 0;

    function clampCameraState() {
      desiredCamera.phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
        desiredCamera.phi,
        0.25,
        1.49
      );

      desiredCamera.radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
        desiredCamera.radius,
        3.25,
        8.0
      );
    }

    function pinchDistance() {
      const values = Array.from(pointers.values());

      if (values.length < 2) {
        return 0;
      }

      return Math.hypot(
        values[0].x - values[1].x,
        values[0].y - values[1].y
      );
    }

    function markInteraction() {
      document.body.classList.add("interacted");
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (pointers.size === 2) {
        previousPinchDistance = pinchDistance();
      }

      markInteraction();
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      const previous = pointers.get(event.pointerId);

      if (!previous) {
        return;
      }

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        const deltaX = event.clientX - previous.x;
        const deltaY = event.clientY - previous.y;

        desiredCamera.theta -= deltaX * 0.006;
        desiredCamera.phi -= deltaY * 0.005;
      } else {
        pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
          x: event.clientX,
          y: event.clientY
        });

        const currentDistance = pinchDistance();

        if (
          previousPinchDistance > 0 &&
          currentDistance > 0
        ) {
          desiredCamera.radius *=
            previousPinchDistance / currentDistance;
        }

        previousPinchDistance = currentDistance;
      }

      clampCameraState();
    });

    function releasePointer(event) {
      pointers.delete(event.pointerId);
      previousPinchDistance =
        pointers.size === 2 ? pinchDistance() : 0;
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", releasePointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", releasePointer);

    canvas.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();

        desiredCamera.radius *= Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001);
        clampCameraState();
        markInteraction();
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    function resetCamera() {
      desiredCamera.theta = initialCamera.theta;
      desiredCamera.phi = initialCamera.phi;
      desiredCamera.radius = initialCamera.radius;
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("dblclick", resetCamera);

    function resize() {
      const width = window.innerWidth;
      const height = window.innerHeight;

      camera.aspect = width / height;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.setSize(width, height, false);
    }

    window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

    function animate() {
      const damping = 0.11;

      cameraState.theta +=
        (desiredCamera.theta - cameraState.theta) * damping;

      cameraState.phi +=
        (desiredCamera.phi - cameraState.phi) * damping;

      cameraState.radius +=
        (desiredCamera.radius - cameraState.radius) * damping;

      updateCamera();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);

      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      document.querySelector("#loading")?.remove();
      animate();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
  <main id="stage" aria-label="Interactive three-dimensional bronze bow fibula"></main>

  <section class="ui title-card">
```
