  <div class="hint"><span>Drag</span> to orbit &nbsp;·&nbsp; <span>Scroll</span> to zoom</div>
  <div class="edition">Procedural reconstruction · Three.js / r160</div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const stage = document.querySelector("#stage");
    const spinButton = document.querySelector("#spin");
    const resetButton = document.querySelector("#reset");

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0c1415);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x0c1415, 8, 17);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      34,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      40
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.domElement.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "Orbitable reconstruction of an ancient bronze bow fibula"
    );
    stage.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Deterministic random utilities keep the procedural textures stable.
    function mulberry32(seed) {
      return function () {
        let t = (seed += 0x6d2b79f5);
        t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
        t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
        return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
      };
    }

    function makeBronzeTexture() {
      const size = 512;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = size;

      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const random = mulberry32(9173);

      const base = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, size, size);
      base.addColorStop(0, "#9b6431");
      base.addColorStop(0.45, "#69421f");
      base.addColorStop(1, "#b17435");
      ctx.fillStyle = base;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

      for (let i = 0; i < 92; i++) {
        const x = random() * size;
        const y = random() * size;
        const radius = 12 + random() * 75;
        const green = random() > 0.25;

        const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, radius);
        gradient.addColorStop(
          0,
          green
            ? "rgba(54, 118, 91, 0.25)"
            : "rgba(43, 25, 12, 0.30)"
        );
        gradient.addColorStop(0.55, "rgba(76, 75, 39, 0.10)");
        gradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)");
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(x - radius, y - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2);
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < 4200; i++) {
        const x = random() * size;
        const y = random() * size;
        const alpha = 0.025 + random() * 0.12;
        ctx.fillStyle = random() > 0.7
          ? `rgba(128, 177, 145, ${alpha})`
          : `rgba(30, 17, 8, ${alpha})`;

        const radius = random() * 1.5 + 0.25;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      for (let i = 0; i < 180; i++) {
        const x = random() * size;
        const y = random() * size;
        const length = 4 + random() * 30;
        const angle = random() * Math.PI;

        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(231, 173, 93, ${0.025 + random() * 0.09})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.3 + random() * 0.8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        ctx.lineTo(
          x + Math.cos(angle) * length,
          y + Math.sin(angle) * length
        );
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(1.35, 1.35);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    function makeBumpTexture() {
      const size = 256;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = size;

      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const image = ctx.createImageData(size, size);
      const random = mulberry32(441);

      for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
          const index = (y * size + x) * 4;
          const wave =
            Math.sin(x * 0.085) * 12 +
            Math.cos(y * 0.13) * 9 +
            Math.sin((x + y) * 0.045) * 10;
          const value = Math.max(
            0,
            Math.min(255, 128 + wave + (random() - 0.5) * 42)
          );

          image.data[index] = value;
          image.data[index + 1] = value;
          image.data[index + 2] = value;
          image.data[index + 3] = 255;
        }
      }

      ctx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(2, 2);
      return texture;
    }

    function makeStoneTexture() {
      const size = 512;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = size;

      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const random = mulberry32(218);

      ctx.fillStyle = "#343b3a";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

      for (let i = 0; i < 22000; i++) {
        const shade = 35 + Math.floor(random() * 50);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${shade}, ${shade + 3}, ${shade + 2}, 0.18)`;
        const radius = random() * 1.8;
        ctx.fillRect(
          random() * size,
          random() * size,
          radius + 0.4,
          radius + 0.4
        );
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(3, 3);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    function makeGlowTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = 512;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(256, 256, 0, 256, 256, 256);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "rgba(70, 130, 118, 0.42)");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(42, 82, 77, 0.16)");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)");

      ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);
      return new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    }

    const bronzeMap = makeBronzeTexture();
    const bronzeBump = makeBumpTexture();

    const bronzeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      map: bronzeMap,
      metalness: 0.82,
      roughness: 0.34,
      bumpMap: bronzeBump,
      bumpScale: 0.022
    });

    const polishedBronze = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xe2a25c,
      map: bronzeMap,
      metalness: 0.92,
      roughness: 0.23,
      bumpMap: bronzeBump,
      bumpScale: 0.009
    });

    const darkBronze = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x2c1b10,
      metalness: 0.68,
      roughness: 0.53
    });

    const patinaMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x3f806c,
      metalness: 0.12,
      roughness: 0.88
    });

    const palePatinaMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x789a73,
      metalness: 0.08,
      roughness: 0.94
    });

    const stoneMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      map: makeStoneTexture(),
      metalness: 0.04,
      roughness: 0.88
    });

    // Studio lighting.
    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xb9d4d0, 0x20170f, 1.05));

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffd5a0, 3.7);
    keyLight.position.set(4.5, 6, 5);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 20;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -4;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.0003;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x78d5c6, 2.4);
    rimLight.position.set(-4, 2.5, -3);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xe4f1ed, 0.9);
    fillLight.position.set(-4, 1, 5);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    const warmLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffae58, 14, 10, 2);
    warmLight.position.set(1.8, -0.5, 3);
    scene.add(warmLight);

    // Background halo.
    const halo = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(3.1, 80),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        map: makeGlowTexture(),
        transparent: true,
        depthWrite: false,
        opacity: 0.72
      })
    );
    halo.position.set(0, 0.15, -2.8);
    scene.add(halo);

    // Ground and plinth.
    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 30),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x111a1b,
        metalness: 0.04,
        roughness: 0.93
      })
    );
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = -1.64;
    ground.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(ground);

    const plinth = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.48, 1.62, 0.34, 96),
      stoneMaterial
    );
    plinth.position.y = -1.45;
    plinth.castShadow = true;
    plinth.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(plinth);

    const plinthRing = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.18, 0.007, 6, 120),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0x77aa9e,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.34
      })
    );
    plinthRing.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    plinthRing.position.y = -1.272;
    scene.add(plinthRing);

    // Fibula artifact.
    const artifact = new THREE.Group();
    artifact.position.set(0, -0.08, 0);
    artifact.rotation.set(0.045, -0.16, -0.035);
    scene.add(artifact);

    const bowCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
      [
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.92, 0.95, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.68, 1.18, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.12, 1.23, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(0.52, 0.86, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(0.82, 0.18, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(0.61, -0.52, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(0.68, -0.94, 0)
      ],
      false,
      "centripetal"
    );

    const halfBandWidth = 0.105;

    function createBowShape() {
      const points = bowCurve.getPoints(110);
      const left = [];
      const right = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
        const tangent = bowCurve.getTangent(i / (points.length - 1));
        const normal = new THREE.Vector2(-tangent.y, tangent.x);
        const point = points[i];

        left.push(
          new THREE.Vector2(
            point.x + normal.x * halfBandWidth,
            point.y + normal.y * halfBandWidth
          )
        );

        right.push(
          new THREE.Vector2(
            point.x - normal.x * halfBandWidth,
            point.y - normal.y * halfBandWidth
          )
        );
      }

      const shape = new THREE.Shape();
      shape.moveTo(left[0].x, left[0].y);

      for (let i = 1; i < left.length; i++) {
        shape.lineTo(left[i].x, left[i].y);
      }

      for (let i = right.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        shape.lineTo(right[i].x, right[i].y);
      }

      shape.closePath();
      return shape;
    }

    const bowGeometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(createBowShape(), {
      depth: 0.22,
      steps: 1,
      curveSegments: 110,
      bevelEnabled: true,
      bevelSegments: 3,
      bevelSize: 0.018,
      bevelThickness: 0.018
    });
    bowGeometry.translate(0, 0, -0.11);

    const bow = new THREE.Mesh(bowGeometry, bronzeMaterial);
    bow.castShadow = true;
    bow.receiveShadow = true;
    artifact.add(bow);

    // Incised border lines.
    function createBorderGroove(offset) {
      const points = bowCurve.getPoints(140);
      const groovePoints = points.map((point, index) => {
        const tangent = bowCurve.getTangent(index / (points.length - 1));
        const normal = new THREE.Vector2(-tangent.y, tangent.x);

        return new THREE.Vector3(
          point.x + normal.x * offset,
          point.y + normal.y * offset,
          0.136
        );
      });

      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(groovePoints);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 240, 0.006, 6, false),
        darkBronze
      );
      artifact.add(mesh);
    }

    createBorderGroove(halfBandWidth * 0.70);
    createBorderGroove(-halfBandWidth * 0.70);

    // Punched ornament.
    const punchMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x2b190d
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const t = 0.16 + i * 0.083;
      const point = bowCurve.getPoint(t);
      const tangent = bowCurve.getTangent(t);
      const normal = new THREE.Vector2(-tangent.y, tangent.x);
      const offset = (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * 0.022;

      const punch = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CircleGeometry(i % 3 === 0 ? 0.018 : 0.012, 18),
        punchMaterial
      );

      punch.position.set(
        point.x + normal.x * offset,
        point.y + normal.y * offset,
        0.137
      );
      artifact.add(punch);
    }

    // Raised corrosion and mineral deposits.
    const corrosionRandom = mulberry32(721);
    const corrosionGeometry = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1);

    for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
      const t = 0.07 + corrosionRandom() * 0.86;
      const point = bowCurve.getPoint(t);
      const tangent = bowCurve.getTangent(t);
      const normal = new THREE.Vector2(-tangent.y, tangent.x);
      const offset = (corrosionRandom() - 0.5) * 0.15;
      const radius = 0.008 + corrosionRandom() * 0.025;

      const deposit = new THREE.Mesh(
        corrosionGeometry,
        corrosionRandom() > 0.62 ? palePatinaMaterial : patinaMaterial
      );

      deposit.position.set(
        point.x + normal.x * offset,
        point.y + normal.y * offset,
        0.137 + radius * 0.16
      );
      deposit.scale.set(radius * 1.35, radius * 0.72, radius * 0.30);
      deposit.rotation.z = Math.atan2(tangent.y, tangent.x);
      artifact.add(deposit);
    }

    // Spring barrel.
    const springPoint = bowCurve.getPoint(0);

    const barrel = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.087, 0.087, 0.44, 32),
      polishedBronze
    );
    barrel.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    barrel.position.copy(springPoint);
    barrel.castShadow = true;
    artifact.add(barrel);

    // Wound pin: a visible helical wire around the spring barrel.
    const helixPoints = [];
    const helixTurns = 3.25;
    const helixSegments = 180;

    for (let i = 0; i <= helixSegments; i++) {
      const t = i / helixSegments;
      const angle = t * Math.PI * 2 * helixTurns;

      helixPoints.push(
        new THREE.Vector3(
          springPoint.x + Math.cos(angle) * 0.108,
          springPoint.y + Math.sin(angle) * 0.108,
          -0.12 + t * 0.24
        )
      );
    }

    const helix = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TubeGeometry(
        new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(helixPoints),
        280,
        0.017,
        8,
        false
      ),
      polishedBronze
    );
    helix.castShadow = true;
    artifact.add(helix);

    // Long tapered pin.
    const catchPoint = bowCurve.getPoint(1);
    const pinStart = springPoint.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0.10, -0.11, 0.19));
    const pinEnd = catchPoint.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.015, 0.19));

    const connector = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
      springPoint.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0.015, -0.025, 0.13)),
      springPoint.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0.045, -0.075, 0.20)),
      pinStart
    ]);

    const connectorMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TubeGeometry(connector, 40, 0.024, 12, false),
      polishedBronze
    );
    connectorMesh.castShadow = true;
    artifact.add(connectorMesh);

    const pinDirection = pinEnd.clone().sub(pinStart);
    const pinLength = pinDirection.length();
    const pinDirectionNormalized = pinDirection.clone().normalize();

    const pin = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.004, 0.028, pinLength, 20),
      polishedBronze
    );
    pin.position.copy(pinStart).add(pinEnd).multiplyScalar(0.5);
    pin.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
      pinDirectionNormalized
    );
    pin.castShadow = true;
    artifact.add(pin);

    const pinTip = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.007, 0.065, 16),
      polishedBronze
    );
    pinTip.position.copy(pinEnd).addScaledVector(pinDirectionNormalized, -0.0325);
    pinTip.quaternion.copy(pin.quaternion);
    pinTip.castShadow = true;
    artifact.add(pinTip);

    // Raised catch plate and U-shaped retaining lip.
    const catchGroup = new THREE.Group();
    catchGroup.position.copy(catchPoint);

    const endTangent = bowCurve.getTangent(1);
    catchGroup.rotation.z = Math.atan2(endTangent.y, endTangent.x);
    artifact.add(catchGroup);

    const catchBack = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.34, 0.23, 0.075),
      bronzeMaterial
    );
    catchBack.position.z = 0.07;
    catchBack.castShadow = true;
    catchBack.receiveShadow = true;
    catchGroup.add(catchBack);

    const catchLipPoints = [
      new THREE.Vector3(-0.16, -0.065, 0.145),
      new THREE.Vector3(-0.185, 0.025, 0.16),
      new THREE.Vector3(-0.12, 0.105, 0.17),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.125, 0.175),
      new THREE.Vector3(0.12, 0.105, 0.17),
      new THREE.Vector3(0.185, 0.025, 0.16),
      new THREE.Vector3(0.16, -0.065, 0.145)
    ];

    const catchLip = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TubeGeometry(
        new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(catchLipPoints),
        80,
        0.025,
        10,
        false
      ),
      polishedBronze
    );
    catchLip.castShadow = true;
    catchGroup.add(catchLip);

    // Small pin collar.
    const collar = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.045, 20, 12),
      polishedBronze
    );
    collar.scale.set(1, 0.82, 0.82);
    collar.position.copy(pinStart);
    collar.castShadow = true;
    artifact.add(collar);

    // Custom camera controls implemented without external addons.
    const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.02, 0);
    const defaultView = {
      azimuth: 0.32,
      polar: 1.33,
      distance: 5.65
    };

    let azimuth = defaultView.azimuth;
    let polar = defaultView.polar;
    let distance = defaultView.distance;
    let dragging = false;
    let previousX = 0;
    let previousY = 0;
    let autoRotate = true;

    function updateCamera() {
      const sinPolar = Math.sin(polar);

      camera.position.set(
        target.x + distance * sinPolar * Math.sin(azimuth),
        target.y + distance * Math.cos(polar),
        target.z + distance * sinPolar * Math.cos(azimuth)
      );

      camera.lookAt(target);
    }

    function setAutoRotate(value) {
      autoRotate = value;
      spinButton.textContent = autoRotate ? "Pause rotation" : "Rotate object";
      spinButton.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(autoRotate));
    }

    function resetView() {
      azimuth = defaultView.azimuth;
      polar = defaultView.polar;
      distance = defaultView.distance;
      target.set(0, 0.02, 0);
      setAutoRotate(false);
      updateCamera();
    }

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      dragging = true;
      previousX = event.clientX;
      previousY = event.clientY;
      renderer.domElement.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      setAutoRotate(false);
    });

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!dragging) return;

      const deltaX = event.clientX - previousX;
      const deltaY = event.clientY - previousY;

      azimuth -= deltaX * 0.006;
      polar = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(polar - deltaY * 0.005, 0.42, 2.45);

      previousX = event.clientX;
      previousY = event.clientY;
    });

    function endDrag(event) {
      dragging = false;
      if (renderer.domElement.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
        renderer.domElement.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      }
    }

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerup", endDrag);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        distance = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          distance * Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001),
          3.8,
          9
        );
        setAutoRotate(false);
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("dblclick", resetView);

    spinButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      setAutoRotate(!autoRotate);
    });

    resetButton.addEventListener("click", resetView);

    function resize() {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    }

    window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

    updateCamera();

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();

    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);

      const delta = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);

      if (autoRotate) {
        azimuth += delta * 0.11;
      }

      updateCamera();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

<body>
  <div class="label">
    <h1>Bird Wishbone</h1>
    <p>Fused plate · bowed clavicle arms · shallow U-base</p>
  </div>

  <div class="hint">Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom · double-click to reset</div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      alpha: false,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.domElement.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "Interactive three-dimensional bird wishbone"
    );
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x081119);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x081119, 8.5, 18);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      36,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );

    const controls = {
      target: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.35, 0),
      radius: 6.2,
      phi: 1.34,
      theta: 0.28,
      goalRadius: 6.2,
      goalPhi: 1.34,
      goalTheta: 0.28
    };

    function updateCamera() {
      controls.radius += (controls.goalRadius - controls.radius) * 0.09;
      controls.phi += (controls.goalPhi - controls.phi) * 0.09;
      controls.theta += (controls.goalTheta - controls.theta) * 0.09;

      const spherical = new THREE.Spherical(
        controls.radius,
        controls.phi,
        controls.theta
      );

      camera.position.setFromSpherical(spherical).add(controls.target);
      camera.lookAt(controls.target);
    }

    updateCamera();

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural microscopic bone texture
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function makeBoneBumpTexture() {
      const size = 128;
      const data = new Uint8Array(size * size * 4);

      for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
          const i = (y * size + x) * 4;
          const broad =
            Math.sin(x * 0.17) * Math.cos(y * 0.13) * 8;
          const fine =
            Math.sin(x * 0.63 + y * 0.19) * 3;
          const grain = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18;
          const value = Math.max(
            0,
            Math.min(255, 128 + broad + fine + grain)
          );

          data[i] = value;
          data[i + 1] = value;
          data[i + 2] = value;
          data[i + 3] = 255;
        }
      }

      const texture = new THREE.DataTexture(
        data,
        size,
        size,
        THREE.RGBAFormat
      );

      texture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(3, 3);
      texture.needsUpdate = true;

      return texture;
    }

    const boneMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: 0xe9dfc8,
      roughness: 0.31,
      metalness: 0,
      clearcoat: 0.16,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.4,
      sheen: 0.18,
      sheenColor: new THREE.Color(0xfff5dc),
      bumpMap: makeBoneBumpTexture(),
      bumpScale: 0.018
    });

    const edgeMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: 0xd8c9a9,
      roughness: 0.4,
      metalness: 0,
      clearcoat: 0.08
    });

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Swept elliptical tube geometry
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function smoothstep(min, max, value) {
      const t = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
        (value - min) / (max - min),
        0,
        1
      );
      return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
    }

    function createSweptGeometry(
      curve,
      radiusAt,
      depthScale = 0.72,
      tubularSegments = 100,
      radialSegments = 28
    ) {
      const frames = curve.computeFrenetFrames(
        tubularSegments,
        false
      );

      const positions = [];
      const normals = [];
      const uvs = [];
      const indices = [];

      for (let i = 0; i <= tubularSegments; i++) {
        const t = i / tubularSegments;
        const point = curve.getPointAt(t);
        const normal = frames.normals[i];
        const binormal = frames.binormals[i];
        const radius = radiusAt(t);

        for (let j = 0; j <= radialSegments; j++) {
          const v = (j / radialSegments) * Math.PI * 2;
          const cos = Math.cos(v);
          const sin = Math.sin(v);

          const radial = normal
            .clone()
            .multiplyScalar(cos * radius)
            .add(
              binormal.clone().multiplyScalar(
                sin * radius * depthScale
              )
            );

          positions.push(
            point.x + radial.x,
            point.y + radial.y,
            point.z + radial.z
          );

          const surfaceNormal = normal
            .clone()
            .multiplyScalar(cos)
            .add(
              binormal.clone().multiplyScalar(
                sin / depthScale
              )
            )
            .normalize();

          normals.push(
            surfaceNormal.x,
            surfaceNormal.y,
            surfaceNormal.z
          );

          uvs.push(t, j / radialSegments);
        }
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < tubularSegments; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < radialSegments; j++) {
          const a = i * (radialSegments + 1) + j;
          const b = a + radialSegments + 1;
          const c = b + 1;
          const d = a + 1;

          indices.push(a, b, d);
          indices.push(b, c, d);
        }
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "normal",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "uv",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2)
      );
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeBoundingSphere();

      return geometry;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Wishbone construction
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const wishbone = new THREE.Group();
    wishbone.rotation.y = -0.13;
    scene.add(wishbone);

    // The arms taper through their length and thicken toward the sternal ends.
    const armRadius = (t) => {
      const shaft = 0.125;
      const upperRoot = 0.09 * Math.exp(-t * 9);
      const sternalFlare = 0.16 * smoothstep(0.62, 1, t);
      return shaft + upperRoot + sternalFlare;
    };

    const leftArmCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
      [
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.32, 1.61, 0.015),
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.53, 1.34, 0.035),
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.94, 1.04, 0.015),
        new THREE.Vector3(-1.28, 0.66, -0.015),
        new THREE.Vector3(-1.41, 0.19, 0.005),
        new THREE.Vector3(-1.31, -0.26, 0.025),
        new THREE.Vector3(-1.08, -0.66, 0.01),
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.72, -0.96, 0)
      ],
      false,
      "catmullrom",
      0.42
    );

    const rightArmCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
      [
        new THREE.Vector3(0.32, 1.61, -0.015),
        new THREE.Vector3(0.53, 1.34, -0.035),
        new THREE.Vector3(0.94, 1.04, -0.015),
        new THREE.Vector3(1.28, 0.66, 0.015),
        new THREE.Vector3(1.41, 0.19, -0.005),
        new THREE.Vector3(1.31, -0.26, -0.025),
        new THREE.Vector3(1.08, -0.66, -0.01),
        new THREE.Vector3(0.72, -0.96, 0)
      ],
      false,
      "catmullrom",
      0.42
    );

    const leftArm = new THREE.Mesh(
      createSweptGeometry(leftArmCurve, armRadius, 0.72),
      boneMaterial
    );

    const rightArm = new THREE.Mesh(
      createSweptGeometry(rightArmCurve, armRadius, 0.72),
      boneMaterial
    );

    leftArm.castShadow = true;
    leftArm.receiveShadow = true;
    rightArm.castShadow = true;
    rightArm.receiveShadow = true;

    wishbone.add(leftArm, rightArm);

    // Shallow U-shaped fused base.
    const baseCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
      [
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.74, -0.95, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.53, -1.17, 0.005),
        new THREE.Vector3(0, -1.29, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(0.53, -1.17, -0.005),
        new THREE.Vector3(0.74, -0.95, 0)
      ],
      false,
      "catmullrom",
      0.5
    );

    const base = new THREE.Mesh(
      createSweptGeometry(
        baseCurve,
        (t) => {
          const end = Math.abs(t - 0.5) * 2;
          return 0.245 - 0.035 * smoothstep(0.45, 1, end);
        },
        0.8,
        90,
        30
      ),
      boneMaterial
    );

    base.castShadow = true;
    base.receiveShadow = true;
    wishbone.add(base);

    // Broad, flattened fused upper plate with softly irregular contours.
    const plateShape = new THREE.Shape();
    plateShape.moveTo(-0.9, 0.1);
    plateShape.bezierCurveTo(
      -0.82, 0.36,
      -0.45, 0.52,
      0, 0.55
    );
    plateShape.bezierCurveTo(
      0.45, 0.52,
      0.82, 0.36,
      0.9, 0.1
    );
    plateShape.bezierCurveTo(
      0.68, -0.02,
      0.34, -0.1,
      0, -0.18
    );
    plateShape.bezierCurveTo(
      -0.34, -0.1,
      -0.68, -0.02,
      -0.9, 0.1
    );

    const plateGeometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(plateShape, {
      depth: 0.28,
      bevelEnabled: true,
      bevelThickness: 0.075,
      bevelSize: 0.07,
      bevelOffset: 0,
      bevelSegments: 6,
      curveSegments: 32
    });

    plateGeometry.translate(0, 0, -0.14);
    plateGeometry.computeVertexNormals();

    const upperPlate = new THREE.Mesh(plateGeometry, boneMaterial);
    upperPlate.position.y = 1.65;
    upperPlate.castShadow = true;
    upperPlate.receiveShadow = true;
    wishbone.add(upperPlate);

    // Subtle shoulder pads visually blend the arms into the plate.
    for (const sign of [-1, 1]) {
      const shoulder = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.22, 32, 20),
        edgeMaterial
      );
      shoulder.position.set(sign * 0.32, 1.59, 0);
      shoulder.scale.set(1.05, 0.8, 0.66);
      shoulder.castShadow = true;
      shoulder.receiveShadow = true;
      wishbone.add(shoulder);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Studio environment
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(5.2, 128),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x101b20,
        roughness: 0.78,
        metalness: 0.04
      })
    );

    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    floor.position.y = -1.62;
    floor.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(floor);

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(
      0xb9d7e4,
      0x30251c,
      1.45
    );
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff0d2, 3.4);
    keyLight.position.set(3.8, 6.2, 4.4);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 16;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -4;
    keyLight.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.0002;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x9bc9e8, 2.1);
    rimLight.position.set(-4.5, 2.7, -3.5);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffd9a5, 24, 10, 2);
    fillLight.position.set(-3, 1.3, 4);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    // Sparse atmospheric particles.
    const particleCount = 90;
    const particlePositions = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);

    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
      particlePositions[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 11;
      particlePositions[i * 3 + 1] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 7;
      particlePositions[i * 3 + 2] = -2 - Math.random() * 6;
    }

    const particleGeometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    particleGeometry.setAttribute(
      "position",
      new THREE.BufferAttribute(particlePositions, 3)
    );

    const particles = new THREE.Points(
      particleGeometry,
      new THREE.PointsMaterial({
        color: 0xc5d7d9,
        size: 0.018,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.25,
        depthWrite: false
      })
    );

    scene.add(particles);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom orbit, pinch, wheel, and reset controls
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const pointers = new Map();
    let previousPinchDistance = 0;

    const canvas = renderer.domElement;

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (pointers.size === 2) {
        const [a, b] = [...pointers.values()];
        previousPinchDistance = Math.hypot(
          b.x - a.x,
          b.y - a.y
        );
      }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!pointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;

      const previous = pointers.get(event.pointerId);

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        const dx = event.clientX - previous.x;
        const dy = event.clientY - previous.y;

        controls.goalTheta -= dx * 0.006;
        controls.goalPhi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          controls.goalPhi - dy * 0.006,
          0.55,
          1.55
        );
      }

      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (pointers.size === 2) {
        const [a, b] = [...pointers.values()];
        const distance = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);

        if (previousPinchDistance > 0) {
          controls.goalRadius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            controls.goalRadius -
              (distance - previousPinchDistance) * 0.012,
            4.1,
            9.5
          );
        }

        previousPinchDistance = distance;
      }
    });

    function endPointer(event) {
      pointers.delete(event.pointerId);
      previousPinchDistance = 0;
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", endPointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", endPointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", endPointer);

    canvas.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        controls.goalRadius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          controls.goalRadius + event.deltaY * 0.0035,
          4.1,
          9.5
        );
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    canvas.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
      controls.goalRadius = 6.2;
      controls.goalPhi = 1.34;
      controls.goalTheta = 0.28;
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(
        Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2)
      );
    });

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Animation
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();

    function animate() {
      const elapsed = clock.getElapsedTime();

      particles.rotation.y = elapsed * 0.008;
      particles.position.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 0.16) * 0.045;

      updateCamera();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    renderer.setAnimationLoop(animate);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const app = document.querySelector("#app");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer, scene, camera and lighting
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0b1218);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x0b1218, 15, 29);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      38,
      innerWidth / innerHeight,
      0.1,
      60
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.13;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    app.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xb8d9e2, 0x182024, 1.55);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff2dc, 3.25);
    keyLight.position.set(4.5, 9, 6.5);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -8;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 8;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 8;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 25;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.00025;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x7cc4dc, 1.1);
    fillLight.position.set(-6, 4, -5);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x4cc9ac, 10, 14, 2);
    rimLight.position.set(0, 3.5, -3.5);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const materials = {
      pipe: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x688083,
        metalness: 0.58,
        roughness: 0.31
      }),

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Geometry helpers
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const UP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

    const v = (x, y, z = 0) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);

    function addMesh(geometry, material, position, rotation = null) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      mesh.position.copy(position);
      if (rotation) mesh.rotation.set(rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function cylinderBetween(a, b, radius, material, radialSegments = 24) {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(b, a);
      const length = direction.length();

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius, length, radialSegments),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(UP, direction.normalize());
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function sphereAt(position, radius, material, scale = null) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(radius, 28, 18),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(position);
      if (scale) mesh.scale.copy(scale);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function torusAt(
      position,
      majorRadius,
      tubeRadius,
      material,
      rotation = new THREE.Euler()
    ) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(majorRadius, tubeRadius, 12, 56),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(position);
      mesh.rotation.copy(rotation);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function boxAt(position, size, material, rotation = null) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(size.x, size.y, size.z),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(position);
      if (rotation) mesh.rotation.copy(rotation);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Label sprites
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createLabel(text, position, width = 1.5, accent = "#6fd2bb") {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 512;
      canvas.height = 128;

      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8, 16, 21, 0.9)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(153, 193, 196, 0.35)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.strokeRect(2, 2, canvas.width - 4, canvas.height - 4);

      ctx.fillStyle = accent;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 12, canvas.height);

      let fontSize = 42;
      ctx.font = `700 ${fontSize}px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace`;

      while (ctx.measureText(text).width > 460 && fontSize > 22) {
        fontSize -= 2;
        ctx.font = `700 ${fontSize}px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace`;
      }

      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e7f2f1";
      ctx.fillText(text, 262, 64);

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;

      const material = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
        map: texture,
        transparent: true,
        depthTest: false,
        depthWrite: false
      });

      const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(material);
      sprite.position.copy(position);
      sprite.scale.set(width, width / 4, 1);
      sprite.renderOrder = 20;
      scene.add(sprite);

      return sprite;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Flange assembly
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function makeFlange(x, y, radius = 0.44, boltCount = 8) {
      cylinderBetween(
        v(x - 0.085, y, 0),
        v(x + 0.085, y, 0),
        radius,
        materials.flange,
        36
      );

      torusAt(
        v(x, y, 0),
        radius * 0.81,
        0.025,
        materials.darkMetal,
        new THREE.Euler(0, Math.PI / 2, 0)
      );

      for (let i = 0; i < boltCount; i++) {
        const angle = (i / boltCount) * Math.PI * 2;
        const by = y + Math.cos(angle) * radius * 0.76;
        const bz = Math.sin(angle) * radius * 0.76;

        cylinderBetween(
          v(x - 0.14, by, bz),
          v(x + 0.14, by, bz),
          0.028,
          materials.bolt,
          8
        );

        cylinderBetween(
          v(x + 0.13, by, bz),
          v(x + 0.18, by, bz),
          0.047,
          materials.bolt,
          6
        );

        cylinderBetween(
          v(x - 0.18, by, bz),
          v(x - 0.13, by, bz),
          0.047,
          materials.bolt,
          6
        );
      }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Isolation valve with red handwheel
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function makeIsolationValve(x, y) {
      // Bulbous valve body centered over the horizontal pipe.
      sphereAt(
        v(x, y, 0),
        1,
        materials.darkMetal,
        v(0.32, 0.255, 0.255)
      );

      // Reinforced collars on either side of the body.
      cylinderBetween(
        v(x - 0.34, y, 0),
        v(x - 0.25, y, 0),
        0.205,
        materials.flange
      );
      cylinderBetween(
        v(x + 0.25, y, 0),
        v(x + 0.34, y, 0),
        0.205,
        materials.flange
      );

      // Bonnet and rising stem.
      cylinderBetween(
        v(x, y + 0.17, 0),
        v(x, y + 0.42, 0),
        0.14,
        materials.darkMetal
      );

      cylinderBetween(
        v(x, y + 0.39, 0),
        v(x, y + 0.69, 0),
        0.043,
        materials.bolt,
        16
      );

      // Horizontal handwheel.
      const wheelY = y + 0.69;

      torusAt(
        v(x, wheelY, 0),
        0.255,
        0.043,
        materials.red,
        new THREE.Euler(Math.PI / 2, 0, 0)
      );

      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const angle = (i / 4) * Math.PI * 2;
        const dx = Math.cos(angle) * 0.225;
        const dz = Math.sin(angle) * 0.225;

        cylinderBetween(
          v(x, wheelY, 0),
          v(x + dx, wheelY, dz),
          0.019,
          materials.red,
          10
        );
      }

      cylinderBetween(
        v(x, wheelY - 0.045, 0),
        v(x, wheelY + 0.045, 0),
        0.072,
        materials.red
      );
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Floor and supports
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const floor = addMesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 30),
      materials.floor,

    floor.castShadow = false;

    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(24, 48, 0x30464c, 0x1c2b31);
    grid.position.y = -0.012;
    grid.material.transparent = true;
    grid.material.opacity = 0.52;
    scene.add(grid);

    function makePipeSupport(x) {
      boxAt(v(x, 0.055, 0), v(0.52, 0.11, 0.58), materials.darkMetal);
      cylinderBetween(

    }

    makePipeSupport(-3.72);
    makePipeSupport(3.72);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Main steam run
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const pipeY = 1.65;

    cylinderBetween(

    makeFlange(-4.02, pipeY, 0.34, 6);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Horizontal steam trap body
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const trapBody = addMesh(

      v(0, pipeY, 0),

    );

    // Central reinforcing band.
    torusAt(
      v(0, pipeY, 0),
      0.35,
      0.032,
      materials.flange,

    // Raised top bonnet and hex cap.

      24

    cylinderBetween(
      v(0, 2.22, 0),

      0.23,

      6
    );

    // Small front inspection cover.
    const inspection = addMesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.12, 0.12, 0.055, 24),
      materials.brass,
      v(0, pipeY, 0.345),
      new THREE.Euler(Math.PI / 2, 0, 0)
    );

    torusAt(
      v(0, pipeY, 0.376),
      0.085,
      0.013,
      materials.bolt,
      new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0)
    );

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Overhead bypass loop
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const bypassPath = new THREE.CurvePath();

    bypassPath.add(
      new THREE.LineCurve3(
        v(-1.65, pipeY, 0),
        v(-1.65, 2.93, 0)
      )
    );

    bypassPath.add(
      new THREE.QuadraticBezierCurve3(
        v(-1.65, 2.93, 0),
        v(-1.65, 3.35, 0),
        v(-1.27, 3.35, 0)
      )
    );

    bypassPath.add(
      new THREE.LineCurve3(
        v(-1.27, 3.35, 0),
        v(1.27, 3.35, 0)
      )
    );

    bypassPath.add(
      new THREE.QuadraticBezierCurve3(
        v(1.27, 3.35, 0),

    bypassPath.add(
      new THREE.LineCurve3(
        v(1.65, 2.93, 0),
        v(1.65, pipeY, 0)
      )

    const bypassMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TubeGeometry(bypassPath, 140, 0.115, 18, false),
      materials.bypass
    );

    bypassMesh.castShadow = true;
    bypassMesh.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(bypassMesh);

    // Rounded tee joints where the bypass meets the main run.
    sphereAt(v(-1.65, pipeY, 0), 0.165, materials.bypass);
    sphereAt(v(1.65, pipeY, 0), 0.165, materials.bypass);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Two isolation valves
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    makeIsolationValve(-2.95, pipeY);
    makeIsolationValve(3.15, pipeY);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Hanging strainer pot
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    cylinderBetween(
      v(0, 1.34, 0),
      v(0, 1.02, 0),
      0.14,
      materials.brass,
      24
    );

    const strainerBody = addMesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.38, 0.38, 0.62, 32),
      materials.brass,
      v(0, 0.61, 0)
    );

    sphereAt(
      v(0, 0.31, 0),
      0.38,
      materials.brass,
      v(1, 0.55, 1)
    );

    cylinderBetween(
      v(0, 0.91, 0),
      v(0, 1.05, 0),
      0.43,
      materials.brass,
      32
    );

    // Strainer cover bolts.
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const angle = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
      const bx = Math.cos(angle) * 0.34;
      const bz = Math.sin(angle) * 0.34;

      cylinderBetween(
        v(bx, 1.045, bz),
        v(bx, 1.105, bz),
        0.038,
        materials.bolt,
        6
      );
    }

    // Reinforcing ribs on the strainer body.
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const angle = (i / 4) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI / 4;
      const rib = boxAt(
        v(
          Math.cos(angle) * 0.36,
          0.61,
          Math.sin(angle) * 0.36
        ),
        v(0.055, 0.52, 0.055),
        materials.darkMetal

      rib.rotation.y = -angle;
    }

    // Small drain plug on the lower side of the pot.
    cylinderBetween(
      v(0.27, 0.32, 0),
      v(0.44, 0.32, 0),
      0.055,
      materials.flange,
      6

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const sightX = 2.15;

    cylinderBetween(

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Direct camera controls: orbit, pan, zoom, touch pinch and keyboard reset
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const target = v(0, 1.78, 0);
    const spherical = new THREE.Spherical(11.9, 1.24, 0.36);
    const canvas = renderer.domElement;

    function updateCamera() {
      const offset = new THREE.Vector3().setFromSpherical(spherical);
      camera.position.copy(target).add(offset);
      camera.lookAt(target);
      camera.updateMatrixWorld();
    }

    function resetView() {
      target.set(0, 1.78, 0);
      spherical.set(11.9, 1.24, 0.36);
      updateCamera();
    }

    const pointers = new Map();
    let activePointer = null;
    let lastX = 0;
    let lastY = 0;
    let pinchDistance = 0;
    let panMode = false;

    function pointerDistance() {
      const points = [...pointers.values()];
      if (points.length < 2) return 0;

      return Math.hypot(
        points[0].x - points[1].x,
        points[0].y - points[1].y
      );
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        activePointer = event.pointerId;
        lastX = event.clientX;
        lastY = event.clientY;
        panMode = event.button === 2 || event.shiftKey;
      } else if (pointers.size === 2) {
        pinchDistance = pointerDistance();
      }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!pointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;

      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (pointers.size >= 2) {
        const distance = pointerDistance();

        if (pinchDistance > 0 && distance > 0) {
          spherical.radius *= pinchDistance / distance;
          spherical.radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            spherical.radius,
            6.8,
            19
          );
          updateCamera();
        }

        pinchDistance = distance;
        return;
      }

      if (event.pointerId !== activePointer) return;

      const dx = event.clientX - lastX;
      const dy = event.clientY - lastY;

      lastX = event.clientX;
      lastY = event.clientY;

      if (panMode) {
        const right = new THREE.Vector3()
          .setFromMatrixColumn(camera.matrix, 0);
        const up = new THREE.Vector3()
          .setFromMatrixColumn(camera.matrix, 1);

        const panScale = spherical.radius * 0.00115;

        target.addScaledVector(right, -dx * panScale);
        target.addScaledVector(up, dy * panScale);

        target.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(target.x, -3.5, 3.5);
        target.y = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(target.y, 0.35, 4.0);
        target.z = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(target.z, -2.5, 2.5);
      } else {
        spherical.theta -= dx * 0.006;
        spherical.phi -= dy * 0.006;
        spherical.phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          spherical.phi,
          0.35,
          1.48
        );
      }

      updateCamera();
    });

    function endPointer(event) {
      pointers.delete(event.pointerId);

      if (pointers.size === 0) {
        activePointer = null;
        pinchDistance = 0;
      } else if (pointers.size === 1) {
        const remaining = [...pointers.entries()][0];
        activePointer = remaining[0];
        lastX = remaining[1].x;
        lastY = remaining[1].y;
        pinchDistance = 0;
      }
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", endPointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", endPointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => event.preventDefault());

    canvas.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();

        spherical.radius *= Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001);
        spherical.radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          spherical.radius,
          6.8,
          19
        );

        updateCamera();
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    canvas.addEventListener("dblclick", resetView);
    document.querySelector("#reset").addEventListener("click", resetView);

    document.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key.toLowerCase() === "r") resetView();
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = innerWidth / innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
    });

    updateCamera();

    // Render loop.
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<body>
  <div class="title">
    <div class="eyebrow">Relic of the Verdant Court</div>
