  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x071013);
    scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x071013, 0.027);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.domElement.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "Interactive 3D scene showing an elven signal horn on a carved wall rack"
    );
    document.body.prepend(renderer.domElement);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      38,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      60
    );

    const cameraTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.04, 0.32);
    const cameraState = {
      radius: 6.35,
      phi: 1.48,
      theta: 0.055
    };

    const spherical = new THREE.Spherical();
    const yAxis = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
    const zAxis = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);

    function updateCamera() {
      spherical.set(
        cameraState.radius,
        cameraState.phi,
        cameraState.theta
      );
      camera.position
        .setFromSpherical(spherical)
        .add(cameraTarget);
      camera.lookAt(cameraTarget);
    }

    updateCamera();

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural textures
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createStoneTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 1024;
      canvas.height = 1024;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      const image = ctx.createImageData(canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const data = image.data;

      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
        const n = 24 + Math.random() * 25;
        const m = Math.random() * 8;
        data[i] = n + m * 0.35;
        data[i + 1] = n + m;
        data[i + 2] = n + m * 1.05;
        data[i + 3] = 255;
      }

      ctx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(5, 13, 14, 0.45)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 8;

      const rowHeight = 170;
      for (let row = 0, y = 0; y < canvas.height; row++, y += rowHeight) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, y);
        ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
        ctx.stroke();

        const offset = row % 2 === 0 ? -140 : 80;
        for (let x = offset; x < canvas.width + 260; x += 330) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          ctx.lineTo(x + (row % 3 - 1) * 12, y + rowHeight);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
        const y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
        const length = 20 + Math.random() * 100;

        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(120,145,140,${0.025 + Math.random() * 0.05})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          x + length * 0.3,
          y - 12,
          x + length * 0.7,
          y + 18,
          x + length,
          y + 4
        );
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(2.1, 1.25);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    function createWoodTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 768;
      canvas.height = 256;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#4d2e1b");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.5, "#28180f");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#56351e");
      ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      for (let i = 0; i < 420; i++) {
        const y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
        const wave = 2 + Math.random() * 8;

        ctx.strokeStyle = Math.random() > 0.45
          ? `rgba(18,8,4,${0.08 + Math.random() * 0.24})`
          : `rgba(157,101,49,${0.025 + Math.random() * 0.1})`;

        ctx.lineWidth = 0.5 + Math.random() * 2.4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, y);

        for (let x = 0; x <= canvas.width; x += 32) {
          ctx.lineTo(
            x,
            y + Math.sin(x * 0.012 + i) * wave +
              Math.sin(x * 0.031 + i * 0.3) * 2
          );
        }

        ctx.stroke();
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
        const y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
        const radius = 7 + Math.random() * 23;

        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(18,8,3,0.26)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(x, y, radius, radius * 0.38, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(2, 1);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    const stoneTexture = createStoneTexture();
    const stoneBump = stoneTexture.clone();
    stoneBump.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
    stoneBump.needsUpdate = true;

    const woodTexture = createWoodTexture();
    const woodBump = woodTexture.clone();
    woodBump.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
    woodBump.needsUpdate = true;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const stoneMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x73807a,
      map: stoneTexture,
      bumpMap: stoneBump,
      bumpScale: 0.12,
      roughness: 0.96,
      metalness: 0.02
    });

    const wallCarvingMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x354541,
      roughness: 0.9,
      metalness: 0.04
    });

    const woodMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xb08055,
      map: woodTexture,
      bumpMap: woodBump,
      bumpScale: 0.09,
      roughness: 0.7,
      metalness: 0.02
    });

    const woodEdgeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x332015,
      map: woodTexture,
      bumpMap: woodBump,
      bumpScale: 0.08,
      roughness: 0.78
    });

    const darkWoodMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x4a2c18,
      map: woodTexture,
      bumpMap: woodBump,
      bumpScale: 0.07,
      roughness: 0.72
    });

    const carvedWoodMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x17100b,
      roughness: 0.8,
      metalness: 0.02
    });

    const brassMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xb88a38,
      metalness: 0.88,
      roughness: 0.28
    });

    const darkBrassMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x725023,
      metalness: 0.82,
      roughness: 0.39
    });

    const silverMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xc7c3aa,
      metalness: 0.92,
      roughness: 0.23
    });

    const innerHornMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x2d1d0e,
      metalness: 0.7,
      roughness: 0.48,
      side: THREE.BackSide
    });

    const blackMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x050504,
      roughness: 0.8,
      metalness: 0.1,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    const runeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x92f4d9,
      emissive: 0x25c9a2,
      emissiveIntensity: 1.35,
      metalness: 0.28,
      roughness: 0.3
    });

    const enamelMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x176c5c,
      emissive: 0x073c31,
      emissiveIntensity: 0.5,
      metalness: 0.42,
      roughness: 0.25
    });

    const bronzeLineMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x927143,
      emissive: 0x201307,
      emissiveIntensity: 0.32,
      metalness: 0.75,
      roughness: 0.4
    });

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Wall
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const wall = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(14, 8, 0.4),
      stoneMaterial
    );
    wall.position.set(0, 0.2, -0.4);
    wall.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(wall);

    for (const radius of [2.63, 2.82]) {
      const halo = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(radius, 0.025, 8, 180),
        wallCarvingMaterial
      );
      halo.position.set(0, 0.04, -0.185);
      scene.add(halo);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Carved wooden wall rack
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const boardShape = new THREE.Shape();
    boardShape.moveTo(-2.48, -1.3);
    boardShape.lineTo(2.48, -1.3);
    boardShape.lineTo(2.48, 0.7);
    boardShape.quadraticCurveTo(2.45, 1.25, 1.95, 1.53);
    boardShape.quadraticCurveTo(1.15, 1.94, 0, 1.98);
    boardShape.quadraticCurveTo(-1.15, 1.94, -1.95, 1.53);
    boardShape.quadraticCurveTo(-2.45, 1.25, -2.48, 0.7);
    boardShape.closePath();

    const boardGeometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(boardShape, {
      depth: 0.18,
      bevelEnabled: true,
      bevelSegments: 3,
      steps: 1,
      bevelSize: 0.045,
      bevelThickness: 0.035,
      curveSegments: 40
    });

    const board = new THREE.Mesh(
      boardGeometry,
      [woodMaterial, woodEdgeMaterial]
    );
    board.position.z = -0.02;
    board.castShadow = true;
    board.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(board);

    const shelf = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(5.15, 0.24, 0.46),
      darkWoodMaterial
    );
    shelf.position.set(0, -1.27, 0.31);
    shelf.castShadow = true;
    shelf.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(shelf);

    function cylinderBetween(start, end, radiusStart, radiusEnd, material, segments = 12) {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
      const length = direction.length();

      const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
        radiusEnd,
        radiusStart,
        length,
        segments,
        1,
        false
      );

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        yAxis,
        direction.normalize()
      );
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    cylinderBetween(
      new THREE.Vector3(-2.13, -1.22, 0.18),
      new THREE.Vector3(-1.62, -0.55, 0.25),
      0.11, 0.075, darkWoodMaterial
    );

    cylinderBetween(
      new THREE.Vector3(2.13, -1.22, 0.18),
      new THREE.Vector3(1.62, -0.55, 0.25),
      0.11, 0.075, darkWoodMaterial
    );

    const leftBranch = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
      new THREE.Vector3(-1.85, -1.14, 0.47),
      new THREE.Vector3(-1.55, -0.78, 0.52),
      new THREE.Vector3(-1.12, -0.48, 0.56),
      new THREE.Vector3(-0.72, -0.38, 0.56)
    ]);

    const rightBranch = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
      new THREE.Vector3(1.85, -1.14, 0.47),
      new THREE.Vector3(1.52, -0.83, 0.52),
      new THREE.Vector3(1.03, -0.63, 0.56),
      new THREE.Vector3(0.58, -0.58, 0.55)
    ]);

    for (const branchCurve of [leftBranch, rightBranch]) {
      const branch = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(branchCurve, 56, 0.085, 12, false),
        darkWoodMaterial
      );
      branch.castShadow = true;
      branch.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(branch);
    }

    // Carved border on the board.
    const borderCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
      new THREE.Vector3(-2.16, -1.08, 0.225),
      new THREE.Vector3(-2.16, 0.65, 0.225),
      new THREE.Vector3(-1.76, 1.17, 0.225),
      new THREE.Vector3(-1.1, 1.58, 0.225),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.78, 0.225),
      new THREE.Vector3(1.1, 1.58, 0.225),
      new THREE.Vector3(1.76, 1.17, 0.225),
      new THREE.Vector3(2.16, 0.65, 0.225),
      new THREE.Vector3(2.16, -1.08, 0.225)
    ]);

    const border = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TubeGeometry(borderCurve, 100, 0.021, 7, false),
      bronzeLineMaterial
    );
    scene.add(border);

    // Circular carved seal behind the horn.
    const seal = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.57, 0.018, 8, 140),
      bronzeLineMaterial
    );
    seal.position.set(0, 0.02, 0.235);
    scene.add(seal);

    const tickGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.026, 0.13, 0.025);
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      const angle = (i / 16) * Math.PI * 2;
      const tick = new THREE.Mesh(tickGeometry, bronzeLineMaterial);
      tick.position.set(
        Math.sin(angle) * 1.57,
        0.02 + Math.cos(angle) * 1.57,
        0.245
      );
      tick.rotation.z = -angle;
      scene.add(tick);
    }

    // Spiral carvings on both sides of the rack.
    function createSpiral(cx, cy, z, startRadius, turns) {
      const points = [];
      const count = 80;

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const t = i / (count - 1);
        const angle = t * Math.PI * 2 * turns;
        const radius = startRadius * (1 - t * 0.77);

        points.push(new THREE.Vector3(
          cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
          cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
          z
        ));
      }

      return new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points);
    }

    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const spiral = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(
          createSpiral(side * 1.87, -0.34, 0.235, 0.31, 1.65),
          70,
          0.016,
          7,
          false
        ),
        carvedWoodMaterial
      );
      scene.add(spiral);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Elven signal horn
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const hornCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
      new THREE.Vector3(-1.72, -0.68, 0.56),
      new THREE.Vector3(-1.50, -0.18, 0.58),
      new THREE.Vector3(-1.15, 0.30, 0.62),
      new THREE.Vector3(-0.55, 0.58, 0.63),
      new THREE.Vector3(0.10, 0.54, 0.62),
      new THREE.Vector3(0.53, 0.20, 0.61),
      new THREE.Vector3(0.55, -0.27, 0.63),
      new THREE.Vector3(0.85, -0.47, 0.78),
      new THREE.Vector3(1.20, -0.38, 1.02)
    ], false, "catmullrom", 0.5);

    function hornRadius(t) {
      if (t < 0.78) {
        return 0.105 + 0.07 * (t / 0.78);
      }

      const flare = (t - 0.78) / 0.22;
      return 0.175 + 0.415 * Math.pow(flare, 1.7);
    }

    function createVariableTube(curve, radiusFunction, material, segments = 180, sides = 32) {
      const frames = curve.computeFrenetFrames(segments, false);
      const positions = [];
      const uvs = [];
      const indices = [];

      const point = new THREE.Vector3();
      const radial = new THREE.Vector3();

      for (let i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
        const t = i / segments;
        curve.getPointAt(t, point);

        const radius = radiusFunction(t);
        const normal = frames.normals[i];
        const binormal = frames.binormals[i];

        for (let j = 0; j <= sides; j++) {
          const angle = (j / sides) * Math.PI * 2;
          radial
            .copy(normal)
            .multiplyScalar(Math.cos(angle))
            .addScaledVector(binormal, Math.sin(angle));

          positions.push(
            point.x + radial.x * radius,
            point.y + radial.y * radius,
            point.z + radial.z * radius
          );

          uvs.push(t, j / sides);
        }
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < sides; j++) {
          const a = i * (sides + 1) + j;
          const b = a + sides + 1;
          const c = b + 1;
          const d = a + 1;

          indices.push(a, b, d);
          indices.push(b, c, d);
        }
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "uv",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2)
      );
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    createVariableTube(
      hornCurve,
      hornRadius,
      brassMaterial,
      190,
      36
    );

    // Fine enamel vein running along the front of the horn.
    const veinPoints = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 90; i++) {
      const t = 0.15 + (i / 90) * 0.61;
      const point = hornCurve.getPointAt(t);
      point.z += hornRadius(t) * 0.94;
      veinPoints.push(point);
    }

    const veinCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(veinPoints);
    const vein = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TubeGeometry(veinCurve, 130, 0.008, 7, false),
      runeMaterial
    );
    scene.add(vein);

    // Silver collars around the horn.
    for (const t of [0.12, 0.24, 0.39, 0.55, 0.7, 0.775]) {
      const point = hornCurve.getPointAt(t);
      const tangent = hornCurve.getTangentAt(t).normalize();

      const collar = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(
          hornRadius(t) + 0.006,
          t === 0.12 || t === 0.775 ? 0.029 : 0.018,
          10,
          54
        ),
        t === 0.12 || t === 0.775
          ? silverMaterial
          : darkBrassMaterial
      );

      collar.position.copy(point);
      collar.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(zAxis, tangent);
      collar.castShadow = true;
      scene.add(collar);
    }

    // Glowing leaf-shaped rune glyphs.
    for (const t of [0.285, 0.365, 0.445, 0.525, 0.605, 0.68]) {
      const center = hornCurve.getPointAt(t);
      const tangent = hornCurve.getTangentAt(t);
      const lengthDirection = new THREE.Vector3(tangent.x, tangent.y, 0).normalize();
      const transverse = new THREE.Vector3(
        -lengthDirection.y,
        lengthDirection.x,
        0
      );

      const zOffset = center.z + hornRadius(t) + 0.022;
      const glyphPoints = [
        center.clone().addScaledVector(transverse, -0.044).setZ(zOffset),
        center.clone().addScaledVector(lengthDirection, 0.07).setZ(zOffset),
        center.clone().addScaledVector(transverse, 0.044).setZ(zOffset),
        center.clone().addScaledVector(lengthDirection, -0.07).setZ(zOffset)
      ];

      const glyphCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
        glyphPoints,
        true,
        "centripetal"
      );

      const glyph = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(glyphCurve, 28, 0.008, 6, true),
        runeMaterial
      );
      scene.add(glyph);
    }

    // Small enamel leaves set into the horn.
    const leafGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 12);

    for (const t of [0.225, 0.43, 0.63]) {
      const point = hornCurve.getPointAt(t);
      const tangent = hornCurve.getTangentAt(t);
      const leaf = new THREE.Mesh(leafGeometry, enamelMaterial);

      leaf.position.copy(point);
      leaf.position.z += hornRadius(t) * 0.72;
      leaf.scale.set(0.115, 0.047, 0.028);
      leaf.rotation.z = Math.atan2(tangent.y, tangent.x);
      leaf.castShadow = true;
      scene.add(leaf);
    }

    // Mouthpiece.
    const mouthStart = hornCurve.getPointAt(0);
    const mouthTangent = hornCurve.getTangentAt(0).normalize();
    const mouthEnd = mouthStart.clone().addScaledVector(mouthTangent, 0.04);
    const mouthBack = mouthStart.clone().addScaledVector(mouthTangent, -0.36);

    cylinderBetween(
      mouthBack,
      mouthEnd,
      0.13,
      0.105,
      silverMaterial,
      24
    );

    const mouthBand = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.125, 0.018, 9, 40),
      silverMaterial
    );
    mouthBand.position.copy(mouthBack);
    mouthBand.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(zAxis, mouthTangent);
    scene.add(mouthBand);

    const mouthOpening = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.087, 32),
      blackMaterial
    );
    mouthOpening.position.copy(mouthBack).addScaledVector(mouthTangent, -0.008);
    mouthOpening.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(zAxis, mouthTangent);
    scene.add(mouthOpening);

    // Flared bell and dark inner funnel.
    const bellEnd = hornCurve.getPointAt(1);
    const bellTangent = hornCurve.getTangentAt(1).normalize();

    const bellLip = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.585, 0.042, 14, 84),
      brassMaterial
    );
    bellLip.position.copy(bellEnd);
    bellLip.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(zAxis, bellTangent);
    bellLip.castShadow = true;
    scene.add(bellLip);

    const bellLipHighlight = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.582, 0.014, 10, 84),
      silverMaterial
    );
    bellLipHighlight.position.copy(bellEnd);
    bellLipHighlight.quaternion.copy(bellLip.quaternion);
    scene.add(bellLipHighlight);

    const innerFunnel = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.55, 0.16, 0.53, 64, 1, true),
      innerHornMaterial
    );
    innerFunnel.position.copy(bellEnd).addScaledVector(bellTangent, -0.265);
    innerFunnel.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(yAxis, bellTangent);
    scene.add(innerFunnel);

    const innerDisk = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.16, 40),
      blackMaterial
    );
    innerDisk.position.copy(bellEnd).addScaledVector(bellTangent, -0.53);
    innerDisk.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(zAxis, bellTangent);
    scene.add(innerDisk);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Rack details: leaves, rivets, and a hanging charm
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const smallLeafGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 10);

    const leafDetails = [
      [-1.62, -0.73, 0.61, -0.45],
      [-1.18, -0.5, 0.63, 0.38],
      [1.6, -0.78, 0.61, 0.5],
      [1.05, -0.62, 0.63, -0.4]
    ];

    for (const [x, y, z, rotation] of leafDetails) {
      const leaf = new THREE.Mesh(smallLeafGeometry, darkBrassMaterial);
      leaf.position.set(x, y, z);
      leaf.scale.set(0.19, 0.075, 0.042);
      leaf.rotation.z = rotation;
      leaf.castShadow = true;
      scene.add(leaf);
    }

    const rivetGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.055, 14, 10);
    for (const x of [-2.22, -1.5, 1.5, 2.22]) {
      const rivet = new THREE.Mesh(rivetGeometry, darkBrassMaterial);
      rivet.position.set(x, -1.27, 0.56);
      scene.add(rivet);
    }

    const cord = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.012, 0.012, 0.42, 8),
      enamelMaterial
    );
    cord.position.set(0, -1.62, 0.49);
    scene.add(cord);

    const charm = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.075, 0),
      bronzeLineMaterial
    );
    charm.position.set(0, -1.88, 0.49);
    charm.scale.set(0.7, 1.35, 0.7);
    charm.castShadow = true;
    scene.add(charm);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x9fc4cb, 0x24150d, 1.35));

    const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x54727a, 0.55);
    scene.add(ambient);

    const keyLight = new THREE.SpotLight(
      0xffd3a0,
      115,
      24,
      Math.PI / 5,
      0.58,

    const warmFill = new THREE.PointLight(0xd5893c, 18, 7, 2);

    const runeLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x38e2b8, 6, 3.5, 2);
    runeLight.position.set(-0.4, 0.45, 1.4);
    scene.add(runeLight);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Floating motes
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const moteCount = 95;
    const motePositions = new Float32Array(moteCount * 3);
    const moteBase = new Float32Array(moteCount * 3);

    for (let i = 0; i < moteCount; i++) {
      const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8.5;
      const y = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 5.1;
      const z = 0.2 + Math.random() * 3.2;

      motePositions[i * 3] = x;
      motePositions[i * 3 + 1] = y;
      motePositions[i * 3 + 2] = z;

      moteBase[i * 3] = x;
      moteBase[i * 3 + 1] = y;
      moteBase[i * 3 + 2] = z;
    }

    const moteGeometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    moteGeometry.setAttribute(
      "position",
      new THREE.BufferAttribute(motePositions, 3)
    );

    const moteMaterial = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
      color: 0xb6f4d8,
      size: 0.025,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.55,
      depthWrite: false,
      blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
      sizeAttenuation: true
    });

    const motes = new THREE.Points(moteGeometry, moteMaterial);
    scene.add(motes);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom camera controls: orbit, wheel zoom, pinch zoom, double-click reset
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const pointers = new Map();
    let dragging = false;
    let lastX = 0;
    let lastY = 0;
    let lastPinchDistance = 0;

    const canvas = renderer.domElement;

    function resetView() {
      cameraState.radius = 6.35;
      cameraState.phi = 1.48;
      cameraState.theta = 0.055;
      updateCamera();
    }

    function pointerDistance() {
      const values = [...pointers.values()];
      if (values.length < 2) return 0;

      return Math.hypot(
        values[0].x - values[1].x,
        values[0].y - values[1].y
      );
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      pointers.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        dragging = true;
        lastX = event.clientX;
        lastY = event.clientY;
      } else if (pointers.size === 2) {
        dragging = false;
        lastPinchDistance = pointerDistance();
      }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!pointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;

      pointers.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });

      if (pointers.size === 2) {
        const distance = pointerDistance();

        if (lastPinchDistance > 0 && distance > 0) {
          cameraState.radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            cameraState.radius * (lastPinchDistance / distance),
            4.15,
            10
          );
        }

        lastPinchDistance = distance;
      } else if (dragging) {
        const dx = event.clientX - lastX;
        const dy = event.clientY - lastY;

        cameraState.theta = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          cameraState.theta - dx * 0.0045,
          -0.8,
          0.8
        );

        cameraState.phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          cameraState.phi + dy * 0.0037,
          0.98,
          1.73
        );

        lastX = event.clientX;
        lastY = event.clientY;
      }
    });

    function releasePointer(event) {
      pointers.delete(event.pointerId);

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        const remaining = [...pointers.values()][0];
        dragging = true;
        lastX = remaining.x;
        lastY = remaining.y;
      } else {
        dragging = false;
        lastPinchDistance = 0;
      }
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", releasePointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", releasePointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", releasePointer);

    canvas.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      cameraState.radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
        cameraState.radius + event.deltaY * 0.0032,
        4.15,
        10
      );
    }, { passive: false });

    canvas.addEventListener("dblclick", resetView);
    document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", resetView);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Resize and animation
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    });

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();

    function animate() {
      const elapsed = clock.getElapsedTime();

      updateCamera();

      runeMaterial.emissiveIntensity =
        1.25 + Math.sin(elapsed * 1.7) * 0.22;

      runeLight.intensity =
        5.7 + Math.sin(elapsed * 1.7) * 1.25;

      const positions = moteGeometry.attributes.position.array;

      for (let i = 0; i < moteCount; i++) {
        const index = i * 3;

        positions[index] =
          moteBase[index] + Math.sin(elapsed * 0.23 + i * 0.83) * 0.08;

        positions[index + 1] =
          moteBase[index + 1] + Math.sin(elapsed * 0.34 + i * 1.27) * 0.11;

        positions[index + 2] =
          moteBase[index + 2] + Math.cos(elapsed * 0.19 + i * 0.47) * 0.06;
      }

      moteGeometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

RoundedRectCurve class:
class RoundedRectCurve extends THREE.Curve {
 constructor(width, depth, radius, y) {
 super();
 this.width...
 const hw=width/2, hd=depth/2;
 // path sequence
 this.segments = [
 {type:'line', length: depth-2r, start:[hw, -hd+r], end:[hw,hd-r]},
 {type:'arc', length:(Math.PI/2)*r, center:[hw-r,hd-r], a0:0,a1:PI/2},
 {type:'line', length: width-2r, start:[hw-r,hd],end:[-hw+r,hd]},
 {type:'arc', length:..., center:[-hw+r,hd-r], a0:PI/2,a1:PI},
 {type:'line', length:depth-2r,start:[-hw,hd-r],end:[-hw,-hd+r]},
 {type:'arc', center[-hw+r,-hd+r], a0:PI,a1:1.5PI},
 {type:'line', length:width-2r,start:[-hw+r,-hd],end:[hw-r,-hd]},
 {type:'arc', center[hw-r,-hd+r], a0:1.5PI,a1:2PI}
 ];
 cumulative. total.
 }
 getPoint(t,target=new THREE.Vector3()) {
 const d = clamp(t)*total; find segment.
 if line lerp.
 arc angle.
 target.set(x,y,z)
 return target;
 }
}

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer, scene and lighting
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.05;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.domElement.setAttribute("aria-label", "Interactive three-dimensional piped-edge cushion");
    document.body.prepend(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xe9e4dc);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xe9e4dc, 10, 20);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      38,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(
      0xfff7e9,
      0x66584d,
      1.9
    );
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1da, 3.1);
    keyLight.position.set(4.5, 7, 5.5);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 20;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.00025;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xdce7f0, 1.0);
    fillLight.position.set(-5, 3.5, -4);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe3be, 0.85);
    rimLight.position.set(-2, 4, 6);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural woven-fabric texture
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function makeFabricCanvas() {
      const size = 256;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = size;
      canvas.height = size;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      context.fillStyle = "#f4f1ec";
      context.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

      // Fine warp and weft.
      for (let p = 0; p < size; p += 4) {
        context.fillStyle = "rgba(65, 47, 34, 0.055)";
        context.fillRect(p, 0, 1, size);
        context.fillRect(0, p, size, 1);

        context.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32)";
        context.fillRect(p + 1, 0, 1, size);
        context.fillRect(0, p + 1, size, 1);
      }

      // Subtle diagonal threads.
      context.lineWidth = 0.6;
      context.strokeStyle = "rgba(69, 48, 34, 0.035)";
      for (let d = -size; d < size * 2; d += 12) {
        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(d, 0);
        context.lineTo(d - size, size);
        context.stroke();
      }

      // Deterministic fabric flecks.
      let seed = 91357;
      const random = () => {
        seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
        return seed / 4294967296;
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < 2200; i++) {
        const x = Math.floor(random() * size);
        const y = Math.floor(random() * size);
        const alpha = 0.015 + random() * 0.035;
        context.fillStyle = `rgba(62, 43, 30, ${alpha})`;
        context.fillRect(x, y, 1, 1);
      }

      return canvas;
    }

    const fabricSource = makeFabricCanvas();
    const maxAnisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

    function makeTexture(source, colorTexture, repeatX, repeatY) {
      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(source);
      texture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(repeatX, repeatY);
      texture.anisotropy = maxAnisotropy;

      if (colorTexture) {
        texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      }

      return texture;
    }

    const topMap = makeTexture(fabricSource, true, 5, 4);
    const topBump = makeTexture(fabricSource, false, 5, 4);

    const sideMap = makeTexture(fabricSource, true, 1, 1);
    const sideBump = makeTexture(fabricSource, false, 1, 1);

    const buttonMap = makeTexture(fabricSource, true, 2, 1);
    const buttonBump = makeTexture(fabricSource, false, 2, 1);

    const topMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xd9be96,
      map: topMap,
      bumpMap: topBump,
      bumpScale: 0.018,
      roughness: 0.92,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const bottomMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xc3a47c,
      map: topMap,
      bumpMap: topBump,
      bumpScale: 0.016,
      roughness: 0.95,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const sideMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x9c704e,
      map: sideMap,
      bumpMap: sideBump,
      bumpScale: 0.028,
      roughness: 0.98,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const pipingMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x60402e,
      roughness: 0.68,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const buttonMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x765039,
      map: buttonMap,
      bumpMap: buttonBump,
      bumpScale: 0.015,
      roughness: 0.82,
      metalness: 0
    });

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Closed rounded-rectangle path used by both piping loops
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    class RoundedRectCurve extends THREE.Curve {
      constructor(width, depth, radius, y) {
        super();

        this.width = width;
        this.depth = depth;
        this.radius = radius;
        this.y = y;
        this.arcLengthDivisions = 800;

        const hw = width * 0.5;
        const hd = depth * 0.5;

        this.segments = [
          {
            type: "line",
            length: depth - radius * 2,
            start: [hw, -hd + radius],
            end: [hw, hd - radius]
          },
          {
            type: "arc",
            length: Math.PI * radius * 0.5,
            center: [hw - radius, hd - radius],
            angleStart: 0,
            angleEnd: Math.PI * 0.5
          },
          {
            type: "line",
            length: width - radius * 2,
            start: [hw - radius, hd],
            end: [-hw + radius, hd]
          },
          {
            type: "arc",
            length: Math.PI * radius * 0.5,
            center: [-hw + radius, hd - radius],
            angleStart: Math.PI * 0.5,
            angleEnd: Math.PI
          },
          {
            type: "line",
            length: depth - radius * 2,
            start: [-hw, hd - radius],
            end: [-hw, -hd + radius]
          },
          {
            type: "arc",
            length: Math.PI * radius * 0.5,
            center: [-hw + radius, -hd + radius],
            angleStart: Math.PI,
            angleEnd: Math.PI * 1.5
          },
          {
            type: "line",
            length: width - radius * 2,
            start: [-hw + radius, -hd],
            end: [hw - radius, -hd]
          },
          {
            type: "arc",
            length: Math.PI * radius * 0.5,
            center: [hw - radius, -hd + radius],
            angleStart: Math.PI * 1.5,
            angleEnd: Math.PI * 2
          }
        ];

        let accumulated = 0;

        for (const segment of this.segments) {
          segment.startDistance = accumulated;
          accumulated += segment.length;
        }

        this.totalLength = accumulated;
      }

      getPoint(t, target = new THREE.Vector3()) {
        const distance = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(t, 0, 1) * this.totalLength;
        let segment = this.segments[this.segments.length - 1];

        for (const candidate of this.segments) {
          if (distance <= candidate.startDistance + candidate.length) {
            segment = candidate;
            break;
          }
        }

        const localT = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          (distance - segment.startDistance) / segment.length,
          0,
          1
        );

        if (segment.type === "line") {
          const x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
            segment.start[0],
            segment.end[0],
            localT
          );
          const z = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
            segment.start[1],
            segment.end[1],
            localT
          );
          return target.set(x, this.y, z);
        }

        const angle = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
          segment.angleStart,
          segment.angleEnd,
          localT
        );

        return target.set(
          segment.center[0] + Math.cos(angle) * this.radius,
          this.y,
          segment.center[1] + Math.sin(angle) * this.radius
        );
      }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Cushion dimensions
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const cushionWidth = 4.4;
    const cushionDepth = 3.2;
    const cornerRadius = 0.42;

    const topEdgeY = 0.34;
    const bottomEdgeY = -0.34;
    const topCrown = 0.09;
    const bottomCrown = -0.045;
    const buttonDimpleDepth = 0.04;

    const perimeterSegments = 192;
    const panelRings = 24;

    const topPipeCurve = new RoundedRectCurve(
      cushionWidth,
      cushionDepth,
      cornerRadius,
      topEdgeY + 0.012
    );

    const bottomPipeCurve = new RoundedRectCurve(
      cushionWidth,
      cushionDepth,
      cornerRadius,
      bottomEdgeY - 0.012
    );

    const boundary = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < perimeterSegments; i++) {
      boundary.push(
        topPipeCurve.getPointAt(i / perimeterSegments, new THREE.Vector3())
      );
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Domed top and bottom panels
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createPanelGeometry(
      perimeter,
      edgeY,
      crown,
      dimpleDepth,
      faceUp
    ) {
      const positions = [];
      const uvs = [];
      const indices = [];

      const surfaceHeight = (x, z, rho) => {
        let y = edgeY + crown * (1 - rho * rho);

        if (dimpleDepth > 0) {
          const dimpleRadius = 0.18;
          const falloff = Math.exp(
            -(x * x + z * z) / (dimpleRadius * dimpleRadius)
          );
          y -= dimpleDepth * falloff;
        }

        return y;
      };

      // Center vertex.
      positions.push(0, surfaceHeight(0, 0, 0), 0);
      uvs.push(0.5, 0.5);

      // Concentric perimeter rings.
      for (let ring = 1; ring <= panelRings; ring++) {
        const rho = ring / panelRings;

        for (let i = 0; i < perimeterSegments; i++) {
          const x = perimeter[i].x * rho;
          const z = perimeter[i].z * rho;
          const y = surfaceHeight(x, z, rho);

          positions.push(x, y, z);
          uvs.push(
            x / cushionWidth + 0.5,
            z / cushionDepth + 0.5
          );
        }
      }

      // Center fan.
      for (let i = 0; i < perimeterSegments; i++) {
        const current = 1 + i;
        const next = 1 + ((i + 1) % perimeterSegments);

        if (faceUp) {
          indices.push(0, next, current);
        } else {
          indices.push(0, current, next);
        }
      }

      // Ring-to-ring triangles.
      for (let ring = 0; ring < panelRings - 1; ring++) {
        const innerStart = 1 + ring * perimeterSegments;
        const outerStart = innerStart + perimeterSegments;

        for (let i = 0; i < perimeterSegments; i++) {
          const next = (i + 1) % perimeterSegments;

          const a = innerStart + i;
          const b = innerStart + next;
          const c = outerStart + i;
          const d = outerStart + next;

          if (faceUp) {
            indices.push(a, b, d, a, d, c);
          } else {
            indices.push(a, d, b, a, c, d);
          }
        }
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "uv",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2)
      );
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();
      geometry.computeBoundingSphere();

      return geometry;
    }

    const topPanel = new THREE.Mesh(
      createPanelGeometry(
        boundary,
        topEdgeY,
        topCrown,
        buttonDimpleDepth,
        true
      ),
      topMaterial
    );

    const bottomPanel = new THREE.Mesh(
      createPanelGeometry(
        boundary,
        bottomEdgeY,
        bottomCrown,
        0,
        false
      ),
      bottomMaterial
    );

    topPanel.castShadow = true;
    topPanel.receiveShadow = true;
    bottomPanel.castShadow = true;
    bottomPanel.receiveShadow = true;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Fabric side band, slightly pinched at the seams and fuller in the middle
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createSideBandGeometry(perimeter) {
      const rows = 10;
      const positions = [];
      const uvs = [];
      const indices = [];

      for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
        const v = row / (rows - 1);
        const y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(topEdgeY, bottomEdgeY, v);
        const bulge = 0.043 * Math.sin(Math.PI * v);

        for (let i = 0; i < perimeterSegments; i++) {
          const previous = perimeter[
            (i - 1 + perimeterSegments) % perimeterSegments
          ];
          const next = perimeter[
            (i + 1) % perimeterSegments
          ];

          const tangentX = next.x - previous.x;
          const tangentZ = next.z - previous.z;
          const tangentLength = Math.hypot(tangentX, tangentZ);

          // Outward normal for this path orientation.
          const normalX = tangentZ / tangentLength;
          const normalZ = -tangentX / tangentLength;

          const x = perimeter[i].x + normalX * bulge;
          const z = perimeter[i].z + normalZ * bulge;

          positions.push(x, y, z);
          uvs.push((i / perimeterSegments) * 8, v);
        }
      }

      for (let row = 0; row < rows - 1; row++) {
        const currentRow = row * perimeterSegments;
        const nextRow = (row + 1) * perimeterSegments;

        for (let i = 0; i < perimeterSegments; i++) {
          const next = (i + 1) % perimeterSegments;

          const a = currentRow + i;
          const b = currentRow + next;
          const c = nextRow + i;
          const d = nextRow + next;

          indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
        }
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "uv",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2)
      );
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();
      geometry.computeBoundingSphere();

      return geometry;
    }

    const sideBand = new THREE.Mesh(
      createSideBandGeometry(boundary),
      sideMaterial
    );

    sideBand.castShadow = true;
    sideBand.receiveShadow = true;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Continuous round piping at the upper and lower seams
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const topPiping = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TubeGeometry(
        topPipeCurve,
        360,
        0.058,
        12,
        true
      ),
      pipingMaterial
    );

    const bottomPiping = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TubeGeometry(
        bottomPipeCurve,
        360,
        0.058,
        12,
        true
      ),
      pipingMaterial
    );

    topPiping.castShadow = true;
    topPiping.receiveShadow = true;
    bottomPiping.castShadow = true;
    bottomPiping.receiveShadow = true;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Fabric-covered centre button, seated in a small tuft depression
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const buttonY =
      topEdgeY + topCrown - buttonDimpleDepth + 0.015;

    const button = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.14, 40, 20),
      buttonMaterial
    );

    button.position.set(0, buttonY, 0);
    button.scale.set(1, 0.55, 1);
    button.castShadow = true;
    button.receiveShadow = true;

    const buttonRim = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.138, 0.012, 10, 56),
      buttonMaterial
    );

    buttonRim.rotation.x = Math.PI * 0.5;
    buttonRim.position.set(0, buttonY + 0.004, 0);
    buttonRim.castShadow = true;

    const cushion = new THREE.Group();
    cushion.add(
      topPanel,
      bottomPanel,
      sideBand,
      topPiping,
      bottomPiping,
      button,
      buttonRim
    );
    scene.add(cushion);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Studio floor
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xded7cc,
        roughness: 1,
        metalness: 0
      })
    );

    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI * 0.5;
    floor.position.y = -0.45;
    floor.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(floor);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Camera controls implemented directly without external addons
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const defaultView = {
      theta: 0.66,
      phi: 1.08,
      radius: 6.5
    };

    const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.015, 0);
    let theta = defaultView.theta;
    let phi = defaultView.phi;
    let radius = defaultView.radius;

    function updateCamera() {
      const horizontalRadius = radius * Math.sin(phi);

      camera.position.set(
        target.x + horizontalRadius * Math.sin(theta),
        target.y + radius * Math.cos(phi),
        target.z + horizontalRadius * Math.cos(theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(target);
    }

    function resetView() {
      theta = defaultView.theta;
      phi = defaultView.phi;
      radius = defaultView.radius;
      updateCamera();
    }

    const pointers = new Map();
    let lastPointerX = 0;
    let lastPointerY = 0;
    let pinchDistance = 0;

    function getPinchDistance() {
      const values = [...pointers.values()];
      if (values.length < 2) return 0;

      return Math.hypot(
        values[0].x - values[1].x,
        values[0].y - values[1].y
      );
    }

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      renderer.domElement.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        lastPointerX = event.clientX;
        lastPointerY = event.clientY;
      } else if (pointers.size === 2) {
        pinchDistance = getPinchDistance();
      }
    });

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!pointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;

      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        const deltaX = event.clientX - lastPointerX;
        const deltaY = event.clientY - lastPointerY;

        theta -= deltaX * 0.006;
        phi -= deltaY * 0.005;

        phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(phi, 0.42, 1.48);

        lastPointerX = event.clientX;
        lastPointerY = event.clientY;
      } else if (pointers.size === 2) {
        const newDistance = getPinchDistance();
        const oldDistance = pinchDistance;

        if (oldDistance > 0 && newDistance > 0) {
          radius *= oldDistance / newDistance;
          radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(radius, 3.8, 10);
        }

        pinchDistance = newDistance;
      }

      updateCamera();
    });

    function endPointer(event) {
      pointers.delete(event.pointerId);

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        const remaining = [...pointers.values()][0];
        lastPointerX = remaining.x;
        lastPointerY = remaining.y;
      } else {
        pinchDistance = 0;
      }
    }

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerup", endPointer);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointercancel", endPointer);

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      radius *= Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001);
      radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(radius, 3.8, 10);
      updateCamera();
    }, { passive: false });

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("dblclick", resetView);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
    });

    document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", resetView);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Resize and render
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });

    resetView();
    renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => renderer.render(scene, camera));
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

 for j...
   const a=j/segments*2PI;
   const irregular = 1 + 0.055*sin(a*3+seed)+0.025*sin(a*7-seed*1.7)+0.018*sin(a*11+y0*2+seed);
   const rr=r*irregular;
   positions.push(rr*cos,a y0+ ... ,rr*sin)
...
 }
 for i < rings-1:
  for j:
   next=(j+1)%segments
   a=i*seg+j,b=i*seg+next,c=(i+1)*seg+j,d=(i+1)*seg+next
   indices.push(a,b,c,b,d,c)
 }
 const endBase=positions.length/3;
 if(profile[last][0]>.02){
   positions.push(0,lastY,0); colors...
   for j indices.push(lastBase, endBase, lastRing+next?) orientation bottom maybe. underside.
 }

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const canvas = document.querySelector("#scene");
    const loading = document.querySelector("#loading");

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      canvas,
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x080d10);
    scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x081014, 0.034);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      38,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      70
    );

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom camera controls: no external control modules are used.
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const controls = {
      target: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.45, 0),
      theta: 0.49,
      phi: 1.43,
      radius: 14.8,
      desiredTheta: 0.49,
      desiredPhi: 1.43,
      desiredRadius: 14.8
    };

    function updateCamera() {
      const sinPhi = Math.sin(controls.phi);

      camera.position.set(
        controls.target.x +
          controls.radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(controls.theta),
        controls.target.y + controls.radius * Math.cos(controls.phi),
        controls.target.z +
          controls.radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(controls.theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(controls.target);
    }

    function resetView() {
      controls.desiredTheta = 0.49;
      controls.desiredPhi = 1.43;
      controls.desiredRadius = 14.8;
    }

    let dragging = false;
    let pointerX = 0;
    let pointerY = 0;

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      dragging = true;
      pointerX = event.clientX;
      pointerY = event.clientY;
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!dragging) return;

      const dx = event.clientX - pointerX;
      const dy = event.clientY - pointerY;

      pointerX = event.clientX;
      pointerY = event.clientY;

      controls.desiredTheta -= dx * 0.005;
      controls.desiredPhi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
        controls.desiredPhi - dy * 0.004,
        0.76,
        1.67
      );
    });

    function stopDragging(event) {
      dragging = false;
      if (event.pointerId !== undefined && canvas.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
        canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      }
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", stopDragging);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", stopDragging);

    canvas.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        controls.desiredRadius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          controls.desiredRadius * Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001),
          7.2,
          20
        );
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    canvas.addEventListener("dblclick", resetView);
    document.querySelector("#reset").addEventListener("click", resetView);

    updateCamera();

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x9ac5d2, 0x241307, 1.45);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const moon = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xa8d4e3, 2.15);
    moon.position.set(-8, 12, 7);
    moon.castShadow = true;
    moon.shadow.mapSize.set(1536, 1536);
    moon.shadow.camera.left = -12;
    moon.shadow.camera.right = 12;
    moon.shadow.camera.top = 12;
    moon.shadow.camera.bottom = -12;
    moon.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    moon.shadow.camera.far = 35;
    moon.shadow.bias = -0.00035;
    scene.add(moon);

    const warmSpot = new THREE.SpotLight(
      0xffbd72,
      185,
      30,
      Math.PI / 5,
      0.62,
      1.35
    );
    warmSpot.position.set(3.6, 8, 5.2);
    warmSpot.target.position.set(0, 0.8, 0);
    warmSpot.castShadow = true;
    warmSpot.shadow.mapSize.set(1536, 1536);
    warmSpot.shadow.bias = -0.0002;
    scene.add(warmSpot, warmSpot.target);

    const blueRim = new THREE.PointLight(0x69b6cf, 62, 18, 2);
    blueRim.position.set(-5.5, 2.6, -5.5);
    scene.add(blueRim);

    const amberFill = new THREE.PointLight(0xff9d4a, 48, 13, 2);
    amberFill.position.set(1.2, -1.7, 3.5);
    scene.add(amberFill);

    const basinGlow = new THREE.PointLight(0xffc477, 8, 4.5, 2);
    basinGlow.position.set(0, -1.3, 0.4);
    scene.add(basinGlow);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural geometry helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function clamp01(value) {
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));
    }

    function waveNoise(a, y, seed) {
      return (
        0.5 +
        0.25 * Math.sin(a * 3.1 + seed) +
        0.15 * Math.sin(a * 7.4 - y * 1.8 + seed * 0.7) +
        0.1 * Math.sin(a * 12.3 + y * 3.2 - seed)
      );
    }

    function createRevolvedGeometry(
      profile,
      seed = 1,
      segments = 64,
      palette = "stone"
    ) {
      const positions = [];
      const colors = [];
      const indices = [];

      const dark =
        palette === "cup"
          ? new THREE.Color(0xa86e34)
          : new THREE.Color(0x765034);

      const light =
        palette === "cup"
          ? new THREE.Color(0xf4dba4)
          : new THREE.Color(0xe4c58d);

      const tempColor = new THREE.Color();

      for (let i = 0; i < profile.length; i++) {
        const [radius, baseY] = profile[i];

        for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
          const angle = (j / segments) * Math.PI * 2;

          const organic =
            1 +
            0.055 * Math.sin(angle * 3 + seed) +
            0.027 * Math.sin(angle * 7 - seed * 1.7) +
            0.015 * Math.sin(angle * 11 + baseY * 2.1 + seed);

          const r = radius * organic;
          const y =
            baseY +
            0.018 *
              Math.sin(angle * 5 + seed) *
              clamp01(radius / 0.3);

          positions.push(
            Math.cos(angle) * r,
            y,
            Math.sin(angle) * r
          );

          const shade = clamp01(
            0.48 +
              0.22 * Math.sin(angle * 2.4 + seed) +
              0.18 * Math.sin(baseY * 2.6 + angle * 5.2) +
              0.1 * Math.sin(angle * 11.7 - seed)
          );

          tempColor.copy(dark).lerp(light, shade);
          colors.push(tempColor.r, tempColor.g, tempColor.b);
        }
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < profile.length - 1; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
          const next = (j + 1) % segments;

          const a = i * segments + j;
          const b = i * segments + next;
          const c = (i + 1) * segments + j;
          const d = (i + 1) * segments + next;

          indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
        }
      }

      // Close a profile that terminates at a non-zero outer radius.
      const finalProfile = profile[profile.length - 1];

      if (finalProfile[0] > 0.015) {
        const centerIndex = positions.length / 3;
        positions.push(0, finalProfile[1], 0);
        colors.push(dark.r, dark.g, dark.b);

        const finalRing = (profile.length - 1) * segments;

        for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
          const next = (j + 1) % segments;
          indices.push(centerIndex, finalRing + next, finalRing + j);
        }
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();
      geometry.computeBoundingSphere();

      return geometry;
    }

    function createFloor() {
      const rings = 34;
      const segments = 96;
      const radius = 21;
      const positions = [];
      const colors = [];
      const indices = [];

      const dark = new THREE.Color(0x202526);
      const light = new THREE.Color(0x4c4941);
      const temp = new THREE.Color();

      for (let ring = 0; ring <= rings; ring++) {
        const r = (ring / rings) * radius;

        for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
          const angle = (j / segments) * Math.PI * 2;

          const rough =
            0.19 * Math.sin(angle * 5.3 + r * 0.83) +
            0.12 * Math.sin(angle * 10.7 - r * 1.31) +
            0.08 * Math.sin(r * 2.2 + angle * 2.8);

          const flatten = clamp01(r / 3.1);
          const y = -2.74 + rough * flatten;

          positions.push(Math.cos(angle) * r, y, Math.sin(angle) * r);

          const shade = clamp01(
            0.48 +
            0.23 * Math.sin(angle * 4 + r * 0.5) +
            0.18 * Math.sin(angle * 9 - r * 1.3)
          );

          temp.copy(dark).lerp(light, shade);
          colors.push(temp.r, temp.g, temp.b);
        }
      }

      for (let ring = 0; ring < rings; ring++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
          const next = (j + 1) % segments;

          const a = ring * segments + j;
          const b = (ring + 1) * segments + j;
          const c = ring * segments + next;
          const d = (ring + 1) * segments + next;

          indices.push(a, c, b, c, d, b);
        }
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();

      return geometry;
    }

    function createWaterDisk(radius = 0.82, rings = 24, segments = 80) {
      const positions = [0, 0, 0];
      const uvs = [0.5, 0.5];
      const indices = [];

      for (let ring = 1; ring <= rings; ring++) {
        const r = (ring / rings) * radius;

        for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
          const angle = (j / segments) * Math.PI * 2;

          positions.push(Math.cos(angle) * r, 0, Math.sin(angle) * r);
          uvs.push(
            0.5 + (Math.cos(angle) * r) / (radius * 2),
            0.5 + (Math.sin(angle) * r) / (radius * 2)
          );
        }
      }

      for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
        const next = (j + 1) % segments;
        indices.push(0, 1 + next, 1 + j);
      }

      for (let ring = 0; ring < rings - 1; ring++) {
        const inner = 1 + ring * segments;
        const outer = inner + segments;

        for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
          const next = (j + 1) % segments;

          indices.push(
            inner + j,
            outer + next,
            outer + j,
            inner + j,
            inner + next,
            outer + next
          );
        }
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute("uv", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();

      return geometry;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Cave chamber
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
      createFloor(),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xffffff,
        vertexColors: true,
        roughness: 1,
        metalness: 0
      })
    );
    floor.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(floor);

    const wallGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
      20,
      22,
      18,
      96,
      14,
      true
    );

    const wallPositions = wallGeometry.attributes.position;
    const wallColors = [];
    const wallDark = new THREE.Color(0x111719);
    const wallLight = new THREE.Color(0x3a3a34);
    const wallColor = new THREE.Color();

    for (let i = 0; i < wallPositions.count; i++) {
      const x = wallPositions.getX(i);
      const y = wallPositions.getY(i);
      const z = wallPositions.getZ(i);

      const angle = Math.atan2(z, x);
      const distortion =
        1 +
        0.07 * Math.sin(angle * 5 + y * 0.3) +
        0.035 * Math.sin(angle * 11 - y * 0.7);

      wallPositions.setX(i, x * distortion);
      wallPositions.setZ(i, z * distortion);

      const shade = clamp01(
        0.45 +
        0.22 * Math.sin(angle * 7 + y * 0.8) +
        0.15 * Math.sin(angle * 15 - y * 1.4)
      );

      wallColor.copy(wallDark).lerp(wallLight, shade);
      wallColors.push(wallColor.r, wallColor.g, wallColor.b);
    }

    wallGeometry.setAttribute(
      "color",
      new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(wallColors, 3)
    );
    wallGeometry.computeVertexNormals();

    const wall = new THREE.Mesh(
      wallGeometry,
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xffffff,
        vertexColors: true,
        side: THREE.BackSide,
        roughness: 1
      })
    );
    wall.position.y = 2.1;
    wall.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(wall);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Main dripstone column and secondary formations
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const calciteMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      vertexColors: true,
      roughness: 0.57,
      metalness: 0.025
    });

    const mainProfile = [
      [0, 6.3],
      [1.16, 6.22],
      [1.38, 5.98],

    const waterMaterial = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: {
        uTime: { value: 0 }
      },
      vertexShader: `
        uniform float uTime;
        varying vec3 vPosition;
        varying float vWave;

        void main() {
          vec3 transformed = position;
          float radius = length(position.xz);
          float edgeFade = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.60, 0.82, radius);

          float waveA = sin(radius * 30.0 - uTime * 2.8);
          float waveB = sin((position.x + position.z) * 18.0 + uTime * 1.7);
          float waveC = cos((position.x - position.z) * 15.0 - uTime * 2.1);

          float wave = (waveA * 0.006 + waveB * 0.003 + waveC * 0.002) * edgeFade;

          transformed.y += wave;
          vPosition = transformed;
          vWave = waveA * 0.5 + waveB * 0.3 + waveC * 0.2;

          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(transformed, 1.0);
        }
      `,
      fragmentShader: `
        uniform float uTime;
        varying vec3 vPosition;
        varying float vWave;

        void main() {
          float radius = length(vPosition.xz);
          float edge = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.72, 0.82, radius);

          vec3 deep = vec3(0.035, 0.17, 0.18);
          vec3 light = vec3(0.20, 0.51, 0.49);

          float shimmer = clamp(0.5 + vWave * 0.22, 0.0, 1.0);
          vec3 color = mix(deep, light, shimmer);

          float glint = pow(max(0.0, sin(radius * 32.0 - uTime * 3.0)), 10.0);
          color += glint * 0.16;

          gl_FragColor = vec4(color, edge * 0.88);
        }
      `,
      transparent: true,
      depthWrite: false,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    const tipY = 1.42;
    const waterY = -2.505;
    const dropPeriod = 2.8;
    const dropOffsets = [0, 0.93, 1.86];

    const dropletGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.058, 14, 10);
    const dropletMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: 0xbbe8e3,
      roughness: 0.05,
      metalness: 0,
      transmission: 0.55,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.88,
      thickness: 0.25,
      ior: 1.33

    const ripples = dropOffsets.map(() => {

        color: 0xa4e3dc,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0,
        depthWrite: false,

      ring.position.y = waterY + 0.025;
      ring.renderOrder = 3;
      scene.add(ring);
      return ring;
    });

    const splashCount = 24;
    const splashPositions = new Float32Array(splashCount * 3);
    const splashGeometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    splashGeometry.setAttribute(
      "position",
      new THREE.BufferAttribute(splashPositions, 3)
    );

    const splashPoints = new THREE.Points(
      splashGeometry,
      new THREE.PointsMaterial({
        color: 0xbdebe6,
        size: 0.042,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.8,
        depthWrite: false,
        sizeAttenuation: true
      })
    );
    splashPoints.frustumCulled = false;
    scene.add(splashPoints);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Rocks and suspended cave dust
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const rockGeometry = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1);
    const rockMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x3b3c39,
      roughness: 0.96
    });

    let randomSeed = 931;
    function random() {
      randomSeed =
        (randomSeed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
      return randomSeed / 4294967296;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
      const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = 3.3 + random() * 12;
      const rock = new THREE.Mesh(rockGeometry, rockMaterial);

      rock.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        -2.7 + random() * 0.2,
        Math.sin(angle) * radius
      );

      const scale = 0.3 + random() * 0.8;
      rock.scale.set(
        scale * (0.8 + random() * 0.8),
        scale * (0.5 + random() * 0.55),
        scale * (0.8 + random() * 0.8)
      );

      rock.rotation.set(random() * 3, random() * 3, random() * 3);
      rock.castShadow = true;
      rock.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(rock);
    }

    const dustCount = 750;
    const dustPositions = new Float32Array(dustCount * 3);

    for (let i = 0; i < dustCount; i++) {
      const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = Math.sqrt(random()) * 15;

      dustPositions[i * 3] = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
      dustPositions[i * 3 + 1] = -2.3 + random() * 11.5;
      dustPositions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
    }

    const dustGeometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    dustGeometry.setAttribute(
      "position",
      new THREE.BufferAttribute(dustPositions, 3)
    );

    const dust = new THREE.Points(
      dustGeometry,
      new THREE.PointsMaterial({
        color: 0xd8c9a8,
        size: 0.022,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.32,
        depthWrite: false,
        sizeAttenuation: true
      })
    );
    scene.add(dust);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Animation
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();

    function animate() {
      const time = clock.getElapsedTime();

      // Smooth the custom camera controls.
      controls.theta +=
        (controls.desiredTheta - controls.theta) * 0.075;
      controls.phi +=
        (controls.desiredPhi - controls.phi) * 0.075;
      controls.radius +=
        (controls.desiredRadius - controls.radius) * 0.075;

      updateCamera();

      // Water surface motion.
      waterMaterial.uniforms.uTime.value = time;

      // Drifting cave dust.
      dust.rotation.y = time * 0.007;
      dust.position.y = Math.sin(time * 0.11) * 0.06;

      // Droplets and expanding impact rings.
      droplets.forEach((droplet, index) => {
        const phase = ((time + dropOffsets[index]) % dropPeriod) / dropPeriod;

        if (phase < 0.78) {
          const fall = phase / 0.78;

          droplet.visible = true;
          droplet.position.set(
            Math.sin(time * 2.1 + index) * 0.018,
            THREE.MathUtils.lerp(tipY, waterY, fall * fall),
            Math.cos(time * 1.7 + index) * 0.014
          );

          droplet.scale.set(
            0.78 + fall * 0.2,
            1.2 + fall * 1.8,
            0.78 + fall * 0.2
          );
        } else {
          droplet.visible = false;
        }

        const ripple = ripples[index];
        const ripplePhase =
          ((time + dropOffsets[index]) % dropPeriod) / dropPeriod;

        if (ripplePhase >= 0.78) {
          const age = (ripplePhase - 0.78) / 0.22;

          ripple.visible = true;
          ripple.scale.setScalar(1 + age * 5.4);
          ripple.material.opacity = Math.pow(1 - age, 1.7) * 0.52;
        } else {
          ripple.visible = false;
        }
      });

      // Small ballistic droplets thrown up at impact.
      for (let i = 0; i < splashCount; i++) {
        const sourceIndex = i % dropOffsets.length;
        const particleIndex = Math.floor(i / dropOffsets.length);

        const phase =
          ((time + dropOffsets[sourceIndex]) % dropPeriod) / dropPeriod;

        let x = 0;
        let y = -100;
        let z = 0;

        if (phase >= 0.78) {
          const normalizedAge = (phase - 0.78) / 0.22;
          const age = normalizedAge * dropPeriod;

          if (age < 0.55) {
            const angle =
              (particleIndex / 8) * Math.PI * 2 +
              sourceIndex * 0.7 +
              Math.sin(i * 3.7) * 0.18;

            const speed = 0.52 + (particleIndex % 3) * 0.12;
            const verticalSpeed = 1.25 + (particleIndex % 4) * 0.13;

            x = Math.cos(angle) * speed * age;
            z = Math.sin(angle) * speed * age;
            y =
              waterY +
              verticalSpeed * age -
              4.9 * age * age * 0.42;
          }
        }

        splashPositions[i * 3] = x;
        splashPositions[i * 3 + 1] = y;
        splashPositions[i * 3 + 2] = z;
      }

      splashGeometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    renderer.setAnimationLoop(animate);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Resize handling
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function onResize() {
      const width = window.innerWidth;
      const height = window.innerHeight;

      camera.aspect = width / height;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.setSize(width, height);
    }

    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);

    loading.classList.add("done");
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

Shape helper:
```
function roundedShape(x,y,w,h,r) {
 const s=new THREE.Shape();
 s.moveTo(x+r,y);
 s.lineTo(x+w-r,y);
 s.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);
 ...
 return s;
}
function roundedHole(...) {
 const p=new THREE.Path();
 p.moveTo(x+r,y);
 p.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x,y+r);
 p.lineTo(x,y+h-r);
 p.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x+r,y+h);
 p.lineTo(x+w-r,y+h);
 p.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w,y+h-r);
 p.lineTo(x+w,y+r);
 p.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w-r,y);
 p.lineTo(x+r,y);
 return p;
}
```
Check clockwise hole: starting bottom-left+r, curve to left bottom; then up; top; right; down; bottom left. yes.

function addDashedPath(points, spacing=.1,dash=.05) {
 const pts=points.map(p=>p.clone());
 const closed=pts.length>2 && pts[0].distanceTo(pts[pts.length-1])<1e-4;
 if(closed) pts.pop();
 const segs=[];
 let total=0;
 for i<pts.length-1 {len...; segs.push({a,b,start:total,len}); total+=len;}
 if(closed) {len first-last; segs...}
 for(let d=spacing*.45; d<total; d+=spacing) {
  const seg=segs.find(s=>d>=s.start&&d<=s.start+s.len);
 ...
 const t=(d-seg.start)/seg.len;
 const pos=seg.a.clone().lerp(seg.b,t);

 }
}
