  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const stage = document.querySelector("#stage");

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.domElement.setAttribute("aria-label", "Interactive leather bifold wallet");
    stage.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x171310);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      36,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      80
    );

    const cameraTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.02, -0.12);
    let fitRadius = 8.4;
    let yaw = 0.065;
    let pitch = 0.035;
    let targetYaw = yaw;
    let targetPitch = pitch;
    let zoom = 1;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural textures
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function mulberry32(seed) {
      return function () {
        let t = seed += 0x6D2B79F5;
        t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
        t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
        return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
      };
    }

    function clampByte(value) {
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, value));
    }

    function makeLeatherTextures(baseColor, seed) {
      const size = 384;
      const random = mulberry32(seed);

      const colorCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      const bumpCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      colorCanvas.width = colorCanvas.height = size;
      bumpCanvas.width = bumpCanvas.height = size;

      const colorContext = colorCanvas.getContext("2d");
      const bumpContext = bumpCanvas.getContext("2d");
      const colorImage = colorContext.createImageData(size, size);
      const bumpImage = bumpContext.createImageData(size, size);

      for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
          const index = (y * size + x) * 4;
          const grain = (random() - 0.5) * 20;
          const broad =
            Math.sin(x * 0.037 + Math.sin(y * 0.021) * 2.1) * 3.2 +
            Math.cos(y * 0.049 - x * 0.013) * 2.1;
          const pore = random() > 0.992 ? -18 : 0;

          colorImage.data[index] = clampByte(baseColor[0] + grain + broad + pore);
          colorImage.data[index + 1] = clampByte(baseColor[1] + grain * 0.7 + broad + pore);
          colorImage.data[index + 2] = clampByte(baseColor[2] + grain * 0.45 + broad + pore);
          colorImage.data[index + 3] = 255;

          const bumpValue = clampByte(128 + grain * 2.1 + broad * 2 + pore * 2);
          bumpImage.data[index] = bumpValue;
          bumpImage.data[index + 1] = bumpValue;
          bumpImage.data[index + 2] = bumpValue;
          bumpImage.data[index + 3] = 255;
        }
      }

      colorContext.putImageData(colorImage, 0, 0);
      bumpContext.putImageData(bumpImage, 0, 0);

      // Fine, irregular leather scratches.
      colorContext.lineCap = "round";
      for (let i = 0; i < 230; i++) {
        const x = random() * size;
        const y = random() * size;
        const length = 2 + random() * 13;
        const angle = (random() - 0.5) * 0.7;

        colorContext.strokeStyle = `rgba(42, 19, 10, ${0.025 + random() * 0.05})`;
        colorContext.lineWidth = 0.35 + random() * 0.65;
        colorContext.beginPath();
        colorContext.moveTo(x, y);
        colorContext.lineTo(
          x + Math.cos(angle) * length,
          y + Math.sin(angle) * length
        );
        colorContext.stroke();
      }

      // Small pores in the height map.
      bumpContext.fillStyle = "rgba(50, 50, 50, 0.32)";
      for (let i = 0; i < 1500; i++) {
        const radius = 0.25 + random() * 0.85;
        bumpContext.beginPath();
        bumpContext.arc(
          random() * size,
          random() * size,
          radius,
          0,
          Math.PI * 2
        );
        bumpContext.fill();
      }

      const map = new THREE.CanvasTexture(colorCanvas);
      map.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      map.wrapS = map.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      map.repeat.set(1.15, 1.15);
      map.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

      const bumpMap = new THREE.CanvasTexture(bumpCanvas);
      bumpMap.wrapS = bumpMap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      bumpMap.repeat.copy(map.repeat);
      bumpMap.anisotropy = map.anisotropy;

      return { map, bumpMap };
    }

    function makeBanknoteTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 768;
      canvas.height = 320;
      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");

      const gradient = context.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#a9b895");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.5, "#829774");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#b4c39f");
      context.fillStyle = gradient;
      context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      context.strokeStyle = "rgba(42, 63, 44, 0.7)";
      context.lineWidth = 9;
      context.strokeRect(18, 18, canvas.width - 36, canvas.height - 36);

      context.lineWidth = 2;
      context.strokeRect(34, 34, canvas.width - 68, canvas.height - 68);

      context.fillStyle = "rgba(43, 65, 45, 0.78)";
      context.font = "bold 94px Georgia";
      context.textAlign = "center";
      context.textBaseline = "middle";
      context.fillText("100", canvas.width * 0.5, canvas.height * 0.5);

      context.font = "22px Georgia";
      context.fillText("LEATHER EDITION", canvas.width * 0.5, 69);
      context.fillText("BIFOLD RESERVE", canvas.width * 0.5, canvas.height - 54);

      for (const x of [120, canvas.width - 120]) {
        context.beginPath();
        context.ellipse(x, 160, 58, 76, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.stroke();
        context.beginPath();
        context.ellipse(x, 160, 39, 54, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    const outerTextures = makeLeatherTextures([126, 66, 38], 1847);
    const liningTextures = makeLeatherTextures([151, 86, 52], 9214);

    const outerLeather = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      map: outerTextures.map,
      bumpMap: outerTextures.bumpMap,
      bumpScale: 0.019,
      roughness: 0.66,
      metalness: 0,
      clearcoat: 0.08,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.72
    });

    const liningLeather = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      map: liningTextures.map,
      bumpMap: liningTextures.bumpMap,
      bumpScale: 0.016,
      roughness: 0.71,
      metalness: 0,
      clearcoat: 0.045,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.8
    });

    const edgeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x35180f,
      roughness: 0.72,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const rimMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x955334,
      roughness: 0.69
    });

    const recessMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x170a06,
      roughness: 0.95
    });

    const threadMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xd0aa76,
      roughness: 0.94
    });

    const pocketMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x4d2818,
      roughness: 0.88
    });

    const banknoteMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: makeBanknoteTexture(),
      roughness: 0.92,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Rounded shape helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function roundedShape(x, y, width, height, radius) {
      const shape = new THREE.Shape();
      shape.moveTo(x + radius, y);
      shape.lineTo(x + width - radius, y);
      shape.quadraticCurveTo(x + width, y, x + width, y + radius);
      shape.lineTo(x + width, y + height - radius);
      shape.quadraticCurveTo(
        x + width,
        y + height,
        x + width - radius,
        y + height
      );
      shape.lineTo(x + radius, y + height);
      shape.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + height, x, y + height - radius);
      shape.lineTo(x, y + radius);
      shape.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + radius, y);
      return shape;
    }

    function roundedHole(x, y, width, height, radius) {
      // Opposite winding to the outer shape.
      const path = new THREE.Path();
      path.moveTo(x + radius, y);
      path.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x, y + radius);
      path.lineTo(x, y + height - radius);
      path.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + height, x + radius, y + height);
      path.lineTo(x + width - radius, y + height);
      path.quadraticCurveTo(
        x + width,
        y + height,
        x + width,
        y + height - radius
      );
      path.lineTo(x + width, y + radius);
      path.quadraticCurveTo(x + width, y, x + width - radius, y);
      path.lineTo(x + radius, y);
      return path;
    }

    function extrudeMesh(
      shape,
      depth,
      faceMaterial,
      sideMaterial,
      z,
      bevelSize = 0.01
    ) {
      const geometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
        depth,
        steps: 1,
        curveSegments: 14,
        bevelEnabled: true,
        bevelSegments: 3,
        bevelSize,
        bevelThickness: bevelSize
      });

      geometry.translate(0, 0, -depth * 0.5);

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, [faceMaterial, sideMaterial]);
      mesh.position.z = z;
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      return mesh;
    }

    function roundedLoopPoints(x, y, width, height, radius, z) {
      const points = [];

      function addPoint(point) {
        if (
          !points.length ||
          points[points.length - 1].distanceToSquared(point) > 0.000001
        ) {
          points.push(point);
        }
      }

      function line(ax, ay, bx, by, steps = 10) {
        for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
          const t = i / steps;
          addPoint(new THREE.Vector3(
            THREE.MathUtils.lerp(ax, bx, t),
            THREE.MathUtils.lerp(ay, by, t),
            z
          ));
        }
      }

      function arc(cx, cy, radius, angleA, angleB, steps = 8) {
        for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
          const angle = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(angleA, angleB, i / steps);
          addPoint(new THREE.Vector3(
            cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
            cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
            z
          ));
        }
      }

      line(x + radius, y, x + width - radius, y);
      arc(x + width - radius, y + radius, radius, -Math.PI / 2, 0);
      line(x + width, y + radius, x + width, y + height - radius);
      arc(x + width - radius, y + height - radius, radius, 0, Math.PI / 2);
      line(x + width - radius, y + height, x + radius, y + height);
      arc(x + radius, y + height - radius, radius, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI);
      line(x, y + height - radius, x, y + radius);
      arc(x + radius, y + radius, radius, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5);

      while (
        points.length > 1 &&
        points[0].distanceToSquared(points[points.length - 1]) < 0.000001
      ) {
        points.pop();
      }

      points.push(points[0].clone());
      return points;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Instanced saddle stitching
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const stitchTransforms = [];

    function addDashedPath(points, spacing = 0.105, dashLength = 0.048) {
      const path = points.map((point) => point.clone());
      const closed =
        path.length > 2 &&
        path[0].distanceToSquared(path[path.length - 1]) < 0.000001;

      if (closed) {
        path.pop();
      }

      const segments = [];
      let totalLength = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
        const length = path[i].distanceTo(path[i + 1]);
        segments.push({
          a: path[i],
          b: path[i + 1],
          start: totalLength,
          length
        });
        totalLength += length;
      }

      if (closed) {
        const length = path[path.length - 1].distanceTo(path[0]);
        segments.push({
          a: path[path.length - 1],
          b: path[0],
          start: totalLength,
          length
        });
        totalLength += length;
      }

      for (let distance = spacing * 0.45; distance < totalLength; distance += spacing) {
        const segment = segments.find(
          (item) =>
            distance >= item.start &&
            distance <= item.start + item.length
        );

        if (!segment || segment.length < 0.00001) {
          continue;
        }

        const t = (distance - segment.start) / segment.length;
        const position = segment.a.clone().lerp(segment.b, t);
        const tangent = segment.b.clone().sub(segment.a).normalize();

        stitchTransforms.push({
          position,
          tangent,
          length: dashLength
        });
      }
    }

    function createStitchMesh() {
      if (!stitchTransforms.length) {
        return;
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 0.014, 0.012);
      const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(
        geometry,
        threadMaterial,
        stitchTransforms.length
      );

      const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
      const xAxis = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0);

      stitchTransforms.forEach((stitch, index) => {
        dummy.position.copy(stitch.position);
        dummy.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(xAxis, stitch.tangent);
        dummy.scale.set(stitch.length, 1, 1);
        dummy.updateMatrix();
        mesh.setMatrixAt(index, dummy.matrix);
      });

      mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      mesh.frustumCulled = false;
      wallet.add(mesh);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Wallet panels and openings
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const wallet = new THREE.Group();
    wallet.rotation.set(-0.065, 0, -0.018);
    scene.add(wallet);

    function addSlotRim(hole) {
      const expansion = hole.type === "bill" ? 0.058 : 0.046;
      const innerInset = hole.type === "bill" ? 0.014 : 0.009;

      const rimShape = roundedShape(
        hole.x - expansion,
        hole.y - expansion,
        hole.w + expansion * 2,
        hole.h + expansion * 2,
        hole.r + expansion
      );

      rimShape.holes.push(
        roundedHole(
          hole.x + innerInset,
          hole.y + innerInset,
          hole.w - innerInset * 2,
          hole.h - innerInset * 2,
          Math.max(0.025, hole.r - innerInset)
        )
      );

      const rim = extrudeMesh(
        rimShape,
        0.016,
        rimMaterial,
        edgeMaterial,
        0.076,
        0.004
      );
      wallet.add(rim);

      const lipHeight = hole.type === "bill" ? 0.095 : 0.058;
      const lip = roundedShape(
        hole.x + 0.065,
        hole.y + hole.h * 0.5 - lipHeight + 0.006,
        hole.w - 0.13,
        lipHeight,
        0.023
      );

      const lipMesh = extrudeMesh(
        lip,
        0.018,
        hole.type === "bill" ? rimMaterial : liningLeather,
        edgeMaterial,
        0.083,
        0.004
      );
      wallet.add(lipMesh);

      if (hole.type !== "bill") {
        const seam = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.BoxGeometry(hole.w - 0.18, 0.009, 0.012),
          edgeMaterial
        );
        seam.position.set(
          hole.x + hole.w * 0.5,
          hole.y + hole.h * 0.5 - 0.052,
          0.098
        );
        wallet.add(seam);

        const stitchY = hole.y + hole.h * 0.5 + 0.094;
        addDashedPath([
          new THREE.Vector3(hole.x + 0.12, stitchY, 0.079),
          new THREE.Vector3(hole.x + hole.w - 0.12, stitchY, 0.079)
        ]);
      }
    }

    function buildPanel(x0, x1, holes) {
      const outerShape = roundedShape(x0, -2.25, x1 - x0, 4.5, 0.23);
      const liningShape = roundedShape(
        x0 + 0.075,
        -2.175,
        x1 - x0 - 0.15,
        4.35,
        0.17
      );

      for (const hole of holes) {
        liningShape.holes.push(
          roundedHole(hole.x, hole.y, hole.w, hole.h, hole.r)
        );
      }

      // Structural outer leather layer.
      const base = extrudeMesh(
        outerShape,
        0.13,
        outerLeather,
        edgeMaterial,
        -0.12,
        0.014
      );
      wallet.add(base);

      // Inner leather lining. Its holes are actual cut-through geometry.
      const lining = extrudeMesh(
        liningShape,
        0.12,
        liningLeather,
        edgeMaterial,
        0.005,
        0.01
      );
      wallet.add(lining);

      for (const hole of holes) {
        const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.ShapeGeometry(
            roundedShape(hole.x, hole.y, hole.w, hole.h, hole.r),
            12
          ),
          recessMaterial
        );
        floor.position.z = -0.035;
        floor.receiveShadow = true;
        wallet.add(floor);

        addSlotRim(hole);
      }

      addDashedPath(
        roundedLoopPoints(
          x0 + 0.14,
          -2.11,
          x1 - x0 - 0.28,
          4.22,
          0.14,
          0.079
        )
      );
    }

    const cardSlots = [
      // Three staggered slots on the left panel.
      { x: -3.10, y: 1.32, w: 2.40, h: 0.38, r: 0.075, type: "card" },
      { x: -2.94, y: 0.70, w: 2.34, h: 0.38, r: 0.075, type: "card" },
      { x: -3.08, y: 0.08, w: 2.34, h: 0.38, r: 0.075, type: "card" },

      // Two staggered slots on the right panel.
      { x: 0.72, y: 1.25, w: 2.34, h: 0.38, r: 0.075, type: "card" },
      { x: 0.86, y: 0.63, w: 2.34, h: 0.38, r: 0.075, type: "card" },

      // Larger bill opening, behind the card-slot layer.
      { x: 0.70, y: -0.58, w: 2.48, h: 0.62, r: 0.10, type: "bill" }
    ];

    buildPanel(-3.55, -0.42, cardSlots.slice(0, 3));
    buildPanel(0.42, 3.55, cardSlots.slice(3));

    // Leather bill sleeve behind the lining and its banknote.

      billPocketShape,

    const banknotePositions = banknoteGeometry.attributes.position;

    for (let i = 0; i < banknotePositions.count; i++) {
      const x = banknotePositions.getX(i);

      banknotePositions.setZ(

    banknote.castShadow = true;
    wallet.add(banknote);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Rolled center spine
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createFoldGeometry(radius, height, thickness, segments = 72) {
      const path = [];

      // A half-round made from two tangent quarter-cylinder bends.
      for (let i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
        const angle = Math.PI + (i / segments) * Math.PI;
        path.push(new THREE.Vector2(
          Math.cos(angle) * radius,
          Math.sin(angle) * radius
        ));
      }

      const positions = [];
      const uvs = [];
      const indices = [];
      let distance = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < path.length; i++) {
        if (i > 0) {
          distance += path[i].distanceTo(path[i - 1]);
        }

        const point = path[i];
        const inward = new THREE.Vector3(-point.x, 0, -point.y).normalize();
        const front = point.clone().addScaledVector(inward, thickness * 0.5);
        const back = point.clone().addScaledVector(inward, -thickness * 0.5);
        const u = distance / (Math.PI * radius) * 1.6;

        positions.push(
          front.x, -height * 0.5, front.y,
          front.x,  height * 0.5, front.y,
          back.x,  -height * 0.5, back.y,
          back.x,   height * 0.5, back.y
        );

        uvs.push(u, 0, u, 1, u, 0, u, 1);
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
        const a = i * 4;
        const b = (i + 1) * 4;

        // Front, back, top and bottom faces.
        indices.push(
          a, b, a + 1,
          a + 1, b, b + 1,

          a + 2, a + 3, b + 2,
          a + 3, b + 3, b + 2,

          a + 1, b + 1, a + 3,
          a + 3, b + 1, b + 3,

          a, a + 2, b,
          a + 2, b + 2, b
        );
      }

      // End caps, mostly concealed by the panel edges.
      indices.push(0, 2, 1, 1, 2, 3);

      const last = (path.length - 1) * 4;
      indices.push(last, last + 1, last + 2, last + 1, last + 3, last + 2);

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
      geometry.setAttribute("uv", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();
      return geometry;
    }

    const foldMaterial = outerLeather.clone();
    foldMaterial.side = THREE.DoubleSide;

    const fold = new THREE.Mesh(
      createFoldGeometry(0.42, 4.44, 0.09),
      foldMaterial
    );
    fold.castShadow = true;
    fold.receiveShadow = true;
    wallet.add(fold);

    // Rolled piping at the two panel/spine junctions.
    for (const x of [-0.405, 0.405]) {
      const curve = new THREE.LineCurve3(
        new THREE.Vector3(x, -2.13, 0.076),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, 2.13, 0.076)
      );

      const piping = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 1, 0.014, 8, false),
        rimMaterial
      );
      piping.castShadow = true;
      wallet.add(piping);
    }

    createStitchMesh();

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Direct camera controls: drag, wheel, touch and double-click reset
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function resize() {
      const width = window.innerWidth;
      const height = window.innerHeight;

      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.setSize(width, height);

      camera.aspect = width / height;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

      const halfFov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov * 0.5);
      const widthAtDistance = 2 * Math.tan(halfFov) * camera.aspect;
      fitRadius = Math.max(8.4, 7.9 / widthAtDistance);
    }

    function updateCamera() {
      const radius = fitRadius * zoom;

      camera.position.set(
        cameraTarget.x + Math.sin(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch) * radius,
        cameraTarget.y + Math.sin(pitch) * radius,
        cameraTarget.z + Math.cos(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch) * radius
      );

      camera.lookAt(cameraTarget);
    }

    const activePointers = new Map();
    let previousX = 0;
    let previousY = 0;

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      activePointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      previousX = event.clientX;
      previousY = event.clientY;
      renderer.domElement.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    });

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!activePointers.has(event.pointerId)) {
        return;
      }

      activePointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (activePointers.size === 1) {
        const deltaX = event.clientX - previousX;
        const deltaY = event.clientY - previousY;

        targetYaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          targetYaw + deltaX * 0.0045,
          -1.0,
          1.0
        );
        targetPitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          targetPitch - deltaY * 0.0035,
          -0.48,
          0.52
        );

        previousX = event.clientX;
        previousY = event.clientY;
      }
    });

    function releasePointer(event) {
      activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
    }

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerup", releasePointer);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointercancel", releasePointer);

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        zoom = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          zoom * Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001),
          0.72,
          1.6
        );
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
      targetYaw = 0.065;
      targetPitch = 0.035;
      zoom = 1;
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
    resize();
    updateCamera();

    renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
      yaw = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(yaw, targetYaw, 0.085);
      pitch = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(pitch, targetPitch, 0.085);
      updateCamera();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

`cylinderBetween`:

function cylinderBetween(a,b,r,material,parent=scene,segments=16) {
 const va = a.isVector3 ? a : new THREE.Vector3(...a)
...
 const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r,r,len,segments),material)
 mesh.position.copy(va).add(vb).multiplyScalar(.5)

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const viewport = document.getElementById("viewport");
    const loading = document.getElementById("loading");

    let renderer;

    try {
      renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
        antialias: true,
        alpha: false,
        powerPreference: "high-performance"
      });
    } catch (error) {
      loading.innerHTML =
        "<strong>WebGL is unavailable</strong>" +
        "<span>Please use a browser with hardware acceleration enabled.</span>";
      throw error;
    }

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.05;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;

    viewport.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const canvas = renderer.domElement;
    canvas.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "Interactive 3D gated irrigation pipe turnout with two controllable outlets"
    );

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xdce9e8);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xdce9e8, 19, 46);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      window.innerWidth < 700 ? 50 : 42,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );

    const narrowScreen = window.innerWidth < 700;

    const desiredCamera = {
      theta: 0.62,
      phi: 1.03,
      radius: narrowScreen ? 18 : 11.4,
      target: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.05, 0.02)
    };

    const currentCamera = {
      theta: desiredCamera.theta,
      phi: desiredCamera.phi,
      radius: desiredCamera.radius,
      target: desiredCamera.target.clone()
    };

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural environment map
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function makeEnvironmentTexture() {
      const envCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      envCanvas.width = 1024;
      envCanvas.height = 512;

      const ctx = envCanvas.getContext("2d");
      const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 512);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#9cc7d6");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.42, "#e7f2ee");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.52, "#f2e8cf");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#6d6555");
      ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 512);

      const sun = ctx.createRadialGradient(780, 90, 4, 780, 90, 145);
      sun.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,250,220,1)");
      sun.addColorStop(0.15, "rgba(255,245,207,0.8)");
      sun.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = sun;
      ctx.fillRect(620, 0, 320, 260);

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(envCanvas);
      texture.mapping = THREE.EquirectangularReflectionMapping;
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      return texture;
    }

    const environmentTexture = makeEnvironmentTexture();
    const pmrem = new THREE.PMREMGenerator(renderer);
    const environmentTarget = pmrem.fromEquirectangular(environmentTexture);
    scene.environment = environmentTarget.texture;
    environmentTexture.dispose();
    pmrem.dispose();

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xe5f5ff, 0x8a6c49, 1.75);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const sunLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1d5, 3.25);
    sunLight.position.set(-6, 11, 7);
    sunLight.castShadow = true;
    sunLight.shadow.mapSize.set(
      window.innerWidth < 700 ? 1024 : 2048,
      window.innerWidth < 700 ? 1024 : 2048
    );
    sunLight.shadow.camera.left = -8;
    sunLight.shadow.camera.right = 8;
    sunLight.shadow.camera.top = 8;
    sunLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -8;
    sunLight.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    sunLight.shadow.camera.far = 32;
    sunLight.shadow.bias = -0.0002;
    sunLight.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    sunLight.target.position.set(0, 0, 0);
    scene.add(sunLight, sunLight.target);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x9ccfe8, 0.85);
    fillLight.position.set(7, 5, -7);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const materials = {
      ground: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xc9b98d,
        roughness: 1,
        metalness: 0
      }),
      concrete: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xc9c3b4,
        roughness: 0.92,
        metalness: 0
      }),
      concreteDark: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xaaa497,
        roughness: 0.95
      }),
      pipe: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x617f82,
        roughness: 0.3,
        metalness: 0.68
      }),
      pipeLight: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x789497,
        roughness: 0.27,
        metalness: 0.64
      }),
      flange: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x40585d,
        roughness: 0.38,
        metalness: 0.72
      }),
      steel: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xb7c1bd,
        roughness: 0.25,
        metalness: 0.86
      }),
      darkSteel: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x263f43,
        roughness: 0.48,
        metalness: 0.66
      }),
      orange: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xe87538,
        roughness: 0.32,
        metalness: 0.38
      }),
      black: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x0b1b1d,
        roughness: 0.72,
        metalness: 0.12
      }),
      soil: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x6d593d,
        roughness: 1
      }),
      bank: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x9a8057,
        roughness: 1
      }),
      white: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf3f0df,
        roughness: 0.62
      })
    };

    // Procedural soil texture.
    {
      const textureCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      textureCanvas.width = 256;
      textureCanvas.height = 256;
      const ctx = textureCanvas.getContext("2d");

      ctx.fillStyle = "#c8b98f";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);

      let seed = 27;
      const random = () => {
        seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647;
        return (seed - 1) / 2147483646;
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < 3200; i++) {
        const light = random() > 0.55;
        ctx.fillStyle = light
          ? "rgba(255,255,225,0.09)"
          : "rgba(79,63,40,0.08)";
        const size = 0.4 + random() * 1.4;
        ctx.fillRect(
          random() * 256,
          random() * 256,
          size,
          size
        );
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(textureCanvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(20, 20);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      materials.ground.map = texture;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Geometry helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const UP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

    function addMesh(geometry, material, position, parent = scene) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      mesh.position.set(position[0], position[1], position[2]);
      mesh.castShadow = !material.transparent;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function cylinderBetween(
      start,
      end,
      radius,
      material,
      parent = scene,
      segments = 16
    ) {
      const a = start.isVector3 ? start : new THREE.Vector3(...start);
      const b = end.isVector3 ? end : new THREE.Vector3(...end);
      const direction = b.clone().sub(a);
      const length = direction.length();

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius, length, segments),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(UP, direction.normalize());
      mesh.castShadow = !material.transparent;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addFlangeX(x, y, z, pipeRadius) {
      const outerRadius = pipeRadius * 1.17;

      const sleeve = addMesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
          outerRadius,
          outerRadius,
          0.11,
          48,
          1,
          true
        ),
        materials.flange,
        [x, y, z]
      );
      sleeve.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;

      const ring = addMesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(pipeRadius * 1.025, 0.036, 10, 48),
        materials.flange,
        [x, y, z]
      );
      ring.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;

      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const angle = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2;
        const boltY = y + Math.cos(angle) * outerRadius * 0.82;
        const boltZ = z + Math.sin(angle) * outerRadius * 0.82;

        cylinderBetween(
          [x - 0.075, boltY, boltZ],
          [x + 0.075, boltY, boltZ],
          0.027,
          materials.steel,
          scene,
          8
        );
      }
    }

    function addFlangeZ(x, y, z, pipeRadius) {
      const outerRadius = pipeRadius * 1.17;

      const sleeve = addMesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
          outerRadius,
          outerRadius,
          0.1,
          40,
          1,
          true
        ),
        materials.flange,
        [x, y, z]
      );
      sleeve.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;

      const ring = addMesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(pipeRadius * 1.025, 0.033, 10, 40),
        materials.flange,
        [x, y, z]
      );

      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const angle = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
        const boltX = x + Math.cos(angle) * outerRadius * 0.82;
        const boltY = y + Math.sin(angle) * outerRadius * 0.82;

        cylinderBetween(
          [boltX, boltY, z - 0.07],
          [boltX, boltY, z + 0.07],
          0.024,
          materials.steel,
          scene,
          8
        );
      }
    }

    const manifoldPedestal = addMesh(

    manifoldPedestal.castShadow = false;

    function makeMainSupport(x) {
      const base = addMesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.95, 0.18, 1.08),
        materials.concreteDark,
        [x, 0.09, -1.55]
      );
      base.castShadow = false;

      const pedestal = addMesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.7, 0.54, 0.72),

        [x, 0.39, -1.55]
      );
      pedestal.castShadow = false;

      const saddle = addMesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.5, 0.035, 8, 40),
        materials.steel,
        [x, 1.08, -1.55]
      );
      saddle.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
    }

    makeMainSupport(-3.4);
    makeMainSupport(3.4);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Main pressure pipe and tee manifold
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const mainY = 1.08;
    const mainZ = -1.55;

    const mainPipe = addMesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.48, 0.48, 9.5, 48, 1, true),
      materials.pipe,
      [0, mainY, mainZ]
    );
    mainPipe.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;

    // Dark pipe interiors visible at both open ends.
    const rightInterior = addMesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.455, 48),
      materials.black,
      [4.73, mainY, mainZ]
    );
    rightInterior.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;

    const leftInterior = addMesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.455, 48),
      materials.black,
      [-4.73, mainY, mainZ]
    );
    leftInterior.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2;

    addFlangeX(-4.72, mainY, mainZ, 0.48);
    addFlangeX(4.72, mainY, mainZ, 0.48);

    for (const x of [-2.25, 2.25]) {
      const seam = addMesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.487, 0.024, 8, 48),
        materials.pipeLight,
        [x, mainY, mainZ]
      );
      seam.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
    }

    // Rounded tee body.
    addMesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.49, 32, 20),
      materials.pipe,
      [0, mainY, mainZ]
    );

    // Branch from the main into the cross manifold.
    const branch = addMesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.33, 0.33, 1.58, 36),
      materials.pipeLight,
      [0, mainY, -0.77]
    );
    branch.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;

    addFlangeZ(0, mainY, -1.08, 0.33);

    // Cross manifold.
    const manifold = addMesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.31, 0.31, 2.85, 36),
      materials.pipeLight,
      [0, mainY, 0]
    );
    manifold.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;

    addMesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.325, 28, 18),
      materials.pipeLight,
      [0, mainY, 0]
    );

    for (const x of [-1.43, 1.43]) {
      addMesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.31, 28, 18),
        materials.pipeLight,
        [x, mainY, 0]
      );
    }

    for (const x of [-1.15, 1.15]) {
      const collar = addMesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.315, 0.024, 8, 40),
        materials.flange,
        [x, mainY, 0]
      );
      collar.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Outlet assemblies, slide-gate bonnets, and handwheels
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const outlets = [];
    const wheelHitTargets = [];

    function createHandwheel(x, y, z, radius, outletIndex) {
      const wheel = new THREE.Group();
      wheel.position.set(x, y, z);
      scene.add(wheel);

      const ring = addMesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(radius, 0.029, 10, 40),
        materials.orange,
        [0, 0, 0],
        wheel
      );
      ring.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
      ring.userData.outletIndex = outletIndex;
      wheelHitTargets.push(ring);

      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2;
        cylinderBetween(
          [0, 0, 0],
          [Math.cos(angle) * (radius - 0.035), 0, Math.sin(angle) * (radius - 0.035)],
          0.013,
          materials.orange,
          wheel,
          8
        );
      }

      const hub = addMesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.047, 0.047, 0.09, 16),
        materials.steel,
        [0, 0, 0],
        wheel
      );

      return wheel;
    }

    function createOutlet(index, x, radius, nominalDiameter) {
      const gateZ = 0.5;
      const mouthZ = 1.64;

      const body = addMesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
          radius,
          radius,
          1.5,
          36,
          1,
          true
        ),
        materials.pipeLight,
        [x, mainY, 0.9]
      );
      body.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;

      addMesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(radius * 1.01, 24, 16),
        materials.pipeLight,
        [x, mainY, 0.19]
      );

      addFlangeZ(x, mainY, mouthZ, radius);
      addFlangeZ(x, mainY, gateZ - 0.12, radius);

      const interior = addMesh(
        new THREE.CircleGeometry(radius * 0.94, 32),
        materials.black,
        [x, mainY, mouthZ - 0.055]
      );

      // Vertical slide-gate bonnet.
      addMesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.095, 0.115, 0.43, 24),
        materials.darkSteel,
        [x, 1.49, gateZ]
      );

      addMesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.14, 0.125, 0.14, 24),
        materials.flange,
        [x, 1.73, gateZ]
      );

      cylinderBetween(
        [x, 1.78, gateZ],
        [x, 1.98, gateZ],
        0.024,
        materials.steel,
        scene,
        12
      );

      const wheelRadius = index === 0 ? 0.235 : 0.205;
      const wheel = createHandwheel(
        x,
        2.0,
        gateZ,
        wheelRadius,
        index
      );

      // A visible stem indicator on the gate housing.
      const slot = addMesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.062, 0.34, 0.04),
        materials.black,
        [x, 1.5, gateZ + 0.12]
      );

      const indicator = addMesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.028, 0.24, 0.018),
        materials.steel,
        [x, 1.51, gateZ + 0.147]
      );

      const ledMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x6de0a2,
        emissive: 0x2d8f58,
        emissiveIntensity: 1.4,
        roughness: 0.3
      });

      const led = addMesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.043, 16, 12),
        ledMaterial,
        [x + radius * 0.9, 1.73, gateZ + 0.14]
      );

      const outlet = {
        index,
        x,
        radius,
        nominalDiameter,
        targetOpening: 1,
        opening: 1,
        wheel,
        indicator,
        led,
        ledMaterial
      };

      outlets.push(outlet);
      return outlet;
    }

    createOutlet(0, -0.72, 0.255, 600);
    createOutlet(1, 0.72, 0.215, 450);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Water jets, particles, pools, and irrigation furrows
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createFlow(outlet) {
      const x = outlet.x;
      const radius = outlet.radius;

      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
        new THREE.Vector3(x, mainY, 1.66),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, 1.04, 1.88),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.78, 2.12),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.31, 2.38),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.065, 2.58)
      ]);

      const group = new THREE.Group();
      scene.add(group);

      const waterMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x38bfd9,
        emissive: 0x073d4b,
        emissiveIntensity: 0.42,
        roughness: 0.16,
        metalness: 0.04,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.57,
        depthWrite: false,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      });

      const stream = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 52, radius * 0.54, 14, false),
        waterMaterial
      );
      stream.castShadow = false;
      stream.receiveShadow = false;
      stream.renderOrder = 5;
      group.add(stream);

      const coreMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0xb7f1fb,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.64,
        depthWrite: false
      });

      const core = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 52, radius * 0.22, 10, false),
        coreMaterial
      );
      core.castShadow = false;
      core.receiveShadow = false;
      core.renderOrder = 6;
      group.add(core);

      const particleGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(
        radius * 0.11,
        8,
        6
      );
      const particleMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0xd2f8ff,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.82,
        depthWrite: false
      });

      const particles = [];
      const particleCount = outlet.index === 0 ? 24 : 20;

      for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
        const particle = new THREE.Mesh(
          particleGeometry,
          particleMaterial
        );
        particle.castShadow = false;
        group.add(particle);
        particles.push(particle);
      }

      const poolMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x42bdd2,
        roughness: 0.16,
        metalness: 0.02,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.31,
        depthWrite: false,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      });

      const pool = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CircleGeometry(radius * 1.5, 36),
        poolMaterial
      );
      pool.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
      pool.position.set(x, 0.064, 2.57);
      pool.renderOrder = 3;
      group.add(pool);

      const rippleMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0xb8f2fa,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.5,
        depthWrite: false
      });

      const ripple = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(radius * 0.62, 0.012, 7, 36),
        rippleMaterial
      );
      ripple.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
      ripple.position.set(x, 0.071, 2.57);
      ripple.renderOrder = 6;
      group.add(ripple);

      // Recessed-looking soil furrow and water strip.
      const trench = addMesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(radius * 2.7, 0.035, 5.4),
        materials.soil,
        [x, 0.022, 5.18]
      );
      trench.castShadow = false;

      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        const bank = addMesh(
          new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.075, 0.06, 5.4),
          materials.bank,
          [x + side * radius * 1.38, 0.038, 5.18]
        );
        bank.castShadow = false;
      }

      const channelMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x3aafc3,
        roughness: 0.2,
        metalness: 0.03,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.64,
        depthWrite: false
      });

      const channelWater = addMesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(radius * 1.34, 0.018, 5.4),
        channelMaterial,
        [x, 0.049, 5.18]
      );
      channelWater.castShadow = false;
      channelWater.renderOrder = 2;

      return {
        group,
        curve,
        stream,
        core,
        waterMaterial,
        coreMaterial,
        particles,
        pool,
        poolMaterial,
        ripple,
        rippleMaterial,
        channelWater,
        channelMaterial
      };
    }

    for (const outlet of outlets) {
      outlet.flow = createFlow(outlet);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Low vegetation for scale
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    {
      let seed = 93;
      const random = () => {
        seed = (seed * 48271) % 2147483647;
        return (seed - 1) / 2147483646;
      };

      const grassGeometry = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.045, 0.22, 5);
      const grassMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xffffff,
        roughness: 1
      });

      const grassCount = 170;
      const grass = new THREE.InstancedMesh(
        grassGeometry,
        grassMaterial,
        grassCount
      );
      const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
      const color = new THREE.Color();

      let placed = 0;
      let attempts = 0;

      while (placed < grassCount && attempts < grassCount * 10) {
        attempts++;

        const x = (random() - 0.5) * 19;
        const z = 3.1 + random() * 8.6;

        if (Math.abs(Math.abs(x) - 0.72) < 0.48) {
          continue;
        }

        const scale = 0.65 + random() * 1.15;
        dummy.position.set(x, 0.095 * scale, z);
        dummy.rotation.set(
          (random() - 0.5) * 0.18,
          random() * Math.PI * 2,
          (random() - 0.5) * 0.18
        );
        dummy.scale.set(scale, scale, scale);
        dummy.updateMatrix();

        grass.setMatrixAt(placed, dummy.matrix);
        color.setHSL(
          0.19 + random() * 0.055,
          0.24 + random() * 0.15,
          0.25 + random() * 0.09
        );
        grass.setColorAt(placed, color);
        placed++;
      }

      grass.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      if (grass.instanceColor) {
        grass.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
      }
      scene.add(grass);
    }

    function makeSignTexture() {
      const signCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      signCanvas.width = 1024;
      signCanvas.height = 512;
      const ctx = signCanvas.getContext("2d");

      ctx.fillStyle = "#eeeade";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 512);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e87538";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 30);
      ctx.fillRect(0, 482, 1024, 30);

      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#173a3e";
      ctx.font = "800 67px system-ui, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("IRRIGATION TURNOUT", 512, 145);

      ctx.fillStyle = "#e87538";
      ctx.font = "800 43px system-ui, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("TWO-OUTLET MANIFOLD", 512, 235);

      ctx.fillStyle = "#48696c";
      ctx.font = "650 35px system-ui, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("A  /  DN 600       B  /  DN 450", 512, 335);

      ctx.fillStyle = "#789093";
      ctx.font = "600 24px system-ui, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("SLIDE GATE • PRESSURE MAIN", 512, 412);

      for (const x of [35, 989]) {
        for (const y of [65, 447]) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(x, y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = "#6a7e7e";
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(signCanvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    {
      const signTexture = makeSignTexture();

      const signBacking = addMesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.62, 0.83, 0.055),
        materials.darkSteel,
        [2.38, 1.28, 0.39]

      signBacking.rotation.y = -0.15;

      const signFace = addMesh(
        new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.55, 0.76),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          map: signTexture,
          roughness: 0.72,
          metalness: 0.02
        }),
        [2.38, 1.28, 0.422]
      );
      signFace.rotation.y = -0.15;

      cylinderBetween(
        [2.08, 0.08, 0.38],

      );

      cylinderBetween(
        [2.68, 0.08, 0.38],
        [2.68, 1.15, 0.38],
        0.026,
        materials.steel
      );
    }

    const stateA = document.getElementById("stateA");

    const sceneValueA = document.getElementById("sceneValueA");
    const sceneValueB = document.getElementById("sceneValueB");
    const openCount = document.getElementById("openCount");
    const pauseButton = document.getElementById("pauseButton");
    const flowStatus = document.getElementById("flowStatus");

    let flowPaused = false;

    function setGate(index, value) {
      const clamped = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(value, 0, 1);
      outlets[index].targetOpening = clamped;

      const slider = index === 0 ? sliderA : sliderB;
      const output = index === 0 ? valueA : valueB;

      slider.value = Math.round(clamped * 100);
      output.textContent = `${Math.round(clamped * 100)}%`;
    }

    sliderA.addEventListener("input", () => {
      setGate(0, Number(sliderA.value) / 100);
    });

    sliderB.addEventListener("input", () => {
      setGate(1, Number(sliderB.value) / 100);
    });

    function setFlowPaused(paused) {
      flowPaused = paused;
      pauseButton.textContent = flowPaused ? "RESUME FLOW" : "PAUSE FLOW";
      flowStatus.classList.toggle("paused", flowPaused);
      flowStatus.innerHTML = `<i></i>${flowPaused ? "PAUSED" : "FLOWING"}`;
    }

    pauseButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      setFlowPaused(!flowPaused);
    });

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom camera controls: orbit, pan, zoom, touch pinch
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const viewPresets = {
      overview: {
        theta: 0.62,
        phi: 1.03,
        radius: window.innerWidth < 700 ? 18 : 11.4,
        target: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.05, 0.02)
      },
      front: {
        theta: 0,
        phi: 1.29,
        radius: window.innerWidth < 700 ? 13.5 : 8.4,
        target: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.15, 0.4)
      },
      top: {
        theta: 0.01,
        phi: 0.14,
        radius: window.innerWidth < 700 ? 17.5 : 10.7,
        target: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0.45)
      }
    };

    const viewButtons = [...document.querySelectorAll(".view-button")];

    function setView(name) {
      const preset = viewPresets[name];
      if (!preset) return;

      desiredCamera.theta = preset.theta;
      desiredCamera.phi = preset.phi;
      desiredCamera.radius = preset.radius;
      desiredCamera.target.copy(preset.target);

      viewButtons.forEach((button) => {
        button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.view === name);
      });
    }

    viewButtons.forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => setView(button.dataset.view));
    });

    function dampAngle(current, target, lambda, dt) {
      const difference =
        ((target - current + Math.PI) % (Math.PI * 2) + Math.PI * 2) %
          (Math.PI * 2) -
        Math.PI;
      return current + difference * (1 - Math.exp(-lambda * dt));
    }

    function panCamera(deltaX, deltaY) {
      camera.updateMatrixWorld();

      const right = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixColumn(camera.matrix, 0);
      const up = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixColumn(camera.matrix, 1);
      const scale = currentCamera.radius * 0.00125;

      desiredCamera.target.addScaledVector(right, -deltaX * scale);
      desiredCamera.target.addScaledVector(up, deltaY * scale);

      desiredCamera.target.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
        desiredCamera.target.x,
        -5,
        5
      );
      desiredCamera.target.y = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
        desiredCamera.target.y,
        0,
        4
      );
      desiredCamera.target.z = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
        desiredCamera.target.z,
        -4,
        6
      );
    }

    const activePointers = new Map();
    let gesture = null;
    let dragged = false;

    canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => event.preventDefault());

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      activePointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      dragged = false;

      if (activePointers.size === 1) {
        gesture = {
          mode: event.button === 2 || event.shiftKey ? "pan" : "orbit",
          pointerId: event.pointerId,
          lastX: event.clientX,
          lastY: event.clientY
        };
      } else if (activePointers.size === 2) {
        const points = [...activePointers.values()];
        const first = points[0];
        const second = points[1];

        gesture = {
          mode: "pinch",
          pointerId: event.pointerId,
          distance: Math.hypot(
            second.x - first.x,
            second.y - first.y
          ),
          centerX: (first.x + second.x) / 2,
          centerY: (first.y + second.y) / 2
        };
      }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!activePointers.has(event.pointerId)) {
        updateHoverCursor(event);
        return;
      }

      activePointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (activePointers.size === 1 && gesture && gesture.mode !== "pinch") {
        const deltaX = event.clientX - gesture.lastX;
        const deltaY = event.clientY - gesture.lastY;

        if (Math.abs(deltaX) + Math.abs(deltaY) > 2) {
          dragged = true;
        }

        if (gesture.mode === "orbit") {
          desiredCamera.theta -= deltaX * 0.006;
          desiredCamera.phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            desiredCamera.phi - deltaY * 0.0055,
            0.12,
            1.48
          );
        } else {
          panCamera(deltaX, deltaY);
        }

        gesture.lastX = event.clientX;
        gesture.lastY = event.clientY;
      } else if (activePointers.size >= 2 && gesture?.mode === "pinch") {
        const points = [...activePointers.values()];
        const first = points[0];
        const second = points[1];
        const distance = Math.hypot(
          second.x - first.x,
          second.y - first.y
        );
        const centerX = (first.x + second.x) / 2;
        const centerY = (first.y + second.y) / 2;

        if (gesture.distance > 0 && distance > 0) {
          desiredCamera.radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            desiredCamera.radius * (gesture.distance / distance),
            4.2,
            24
          );
        }

        panCamera(
          centerX - gesture.centerX,
          centerY - gesture.centerY
        );

        gesture.distance = distance;
        gesture.centerX = centerX;
        gesture.centerY = centerY;
      }
    });

    function finishPointer(event) {
      const wasClick =
        !dragged &&
        gesture &&
        gesture.pointerId === event.pointerId &&
        gesture.mode !== "pinch";

      activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);

      if (wasClick) {
        const index = pickOutlet(event);
        if (index >= 0) {
          setGate(index, outlets[index].targetOpening > 0.5 ? 0 : 1);
        }
      }

      if (activePointers.size === 1) {
        const remaining = [...activePointers.entries()][0];
        gesture = {
          mode: "orbit",
          pointerId: remaining[0],
          lastX: remaining[1].x,
          lastY: remaining[1].y
        };
      } else if (activePointers.size === 0) {
        gesture = null;
      }
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", finishPointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", finishPointer);

    canvas.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        desiredCamera.radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          desiredCamera.radius * Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001),
          4.2,
          24
        );
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    canvas.addEventListener("dblclick", () => setView("overview"));

    // Raycasting permits clicking the orange handwheels.
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const pointer = new THREE.Vector2();

    function pickOutlet(event) {
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      pointer.x =
        ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
      pointer.y =
        -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;

      raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
      const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(wheelHitTargets, false);

      return hits.length ? hits[0].object.userData.outletIndex : -1;
    }

    function updateHoverCursor(event) {
      if (activePointers.size) {
        canvas.style.cursor = "grabbing";
        return;
      }
      canvas.style.cursor = pickOutlet(event) >= 0 ? "pointer" : "grab";
    }

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (
        event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement ||
        event.target instanceof HTMLButtonElement
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (event.key === "1") setView("overview");
      if (event.key === "2") setView("front");
      if (event.key === "3") setView("top");

      if (event.key.toLowerCase() === "a") {
        setGate(0, outlets[0].targetOpening > 0.5 ? 0 : 1);
      }

      if (event.key.toLowerCase() === "b") {
        setGate(1, outlets[1].targetOpening > 0.5 ? 0 : 1);
      }

      if (event.code === "Space") {
        event.preventDefault();
        setFlowPaused(!flowPaused);
      }
    });

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Projection of labels into screen space
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const projected = new THREE.Vector3();

    function positionLabel(element, worldPosition) {
      projected.copy(worldPosition).project(camera);

      const visible =
        projected.z > -1 &&
        projected.z < 1 &&
        projected.x > -1.2 &&
        projected.x < 1.2 &&
        projected.y > -1.2 &&
        projected.y < 1.2;

      const x = (projected.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * window.innerWidth;
      const y = (-projected.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * window.innerHeight;

      element.style.left = `${x}px`;
      element.style.top = `${y}px`;
      element.style.opacity = visible ? "1" : "0";
    }

    const labelA = document.getElementById("labelA");
    const labelB = document.getElementById("labelB");
    const labelMain = document.getElementById("labelMain");

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Resize and animation
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      const width = window.innerWidth;
      const height = window.innerHeight;

      camera.aspect = width / height;
      camera.fov = width < 700 ? 50 : 42;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

      renderer.setPixelRatio(
        Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, width < 700 ? 1.6 : 2)
      );
      renderer.setSize(width, height);
    });

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();
    let flowClock = 0;
    let firstFrame = true;

    function animate() {
      const dt = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);

      if (!flowPaused) {
        flowClock += dt;
      }

      // Smooth camera movement.
      const cameraDamping = 1 - Math.exp(-8 * dt);

      currentCamera.theta = dampAngle(
        currentCamera.theta,
        desiredCamera.theta,
        8,
        dt
      );
      currentCamera.phi = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
        currentCamera.phi,
        desiredCamera.phi,
        cameraDamping
      );
      currentCamera.radius = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
        currentCamera.radius,
        desiredCamera.radius,
        cameraDamping
      );
      currentCamera.target.lerp(
        desiredCamera.target,
        cameraDamping
      );

      const horizontalRadius =
        currentCamera.radius * Math.sin(currentCamera.phi);

      camera.position.set(
        currentCamera.target.x +
          horizontalRadius * Math.sin(currentCamera.theta),
        currentCamera.target.y +
          currentCamera.radius * Math.cos(currentCamera.phi),
        currentCamera.target.z +
          horizontalRadius * Math.cos(currentCamera.theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(currentCamera.target);
      camera.updateMatrixWorld();

      let openGates = 0;

      for (const outlet of outlets) {
        outlet.opening = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
          outlet.opening,
          outlet.targetOpening,
          1 - Math.exp(-6 * dt)
        );

        if (outlet.opening > 0.025) {
          openGates++;
        }

        // Handwheel and gate stem indicator.
        outlet.wheel.rotation.y = outlet.opening * Math.PI * 3;
        outlet.indicator.position.y = 1.43 + outlet.opening * 0.2;

        const ledColor =
          outlet.opening > 0.025 ? 0x6de0a2 : 0xff665c;
        const ledEmissive =
          outlet.opening > 0.025 ? 0x2d8f58 : 0x9b211c;

        outlet.ledMaterial.color.setHex(ledColor);
        outlet.ledMaterial.emissive.setHex(ledEmissive);

        const flow = outlet.flow;
        const visible = outlet.opening > 0.015;

        flow.group.visible = visible;
        flow.channelWater.visible = visible;

        flow.waterMaterial.opacity = 0.18 + outlet.opening * 0.4;
        flow.coreMaterial.opacity = 0.2 + outlet.opening * 0.46;
        flow.channelMaterial.opacity = 0.2 + outlet.opening * 0.46;
        flow.poolMaterial.opacity = 0.12 + outlet.opening * 0.2;

        for (let i = 0; i < flow.particles.length; i++) {
          const particle = flow.particles[i];
          const particleThreshold = i / flow.particles.length;
          particle.visible = particleThreshold < outlet.opening;

          const t =
            (flowClock * (0.23 + outlet.opening * 0.15) +
              i / flow.particles.length +
              outlet.index * 0.17) %
            1;

          const point = flow.curve.getPointAt(t);
          point.x +=
            Math.sin(i * 12.37 + flowClock * 2.1) *
            outlet.radius *
            0.11;
          point.y +=
            Math.cos(i * 7.13 + flowClock * 1.7) *
            outlet.radius *
            0.05;
          particle.position.copy(point);

          const pulse = 0.72 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.52;
          particle.scale.setScalar(pulse);
        }

        const ripplePhase =
          (flowClock * 0.72 + outlet.index * 0.37) % 1;
        const rippleScale = 1 + ripplePhase * 2.1;
        flow.ripple.scale.setScalar(rippleScale);
        flow.rippleMaterial.opacity =
          (1 - ripplePhase) * 0.52 * outlet.opening;
      }

      // UI state.
      stateA.textContent = outlets[0].opening > 0.025 ? "OPEN" : "CLOSED";
      stateB.textContent = outlets[1].opening > 0.025 ? "OPEN" : "CLOSED";
      stateA.className =
        "gate-state " + (outlets[0].opening > 0.025 ? "open" : "closed");
      stateB.className =
        "gate-state " + (outlets[1].opening > 0.025 ? "open" : "closed");

      openCount.textContent = `${openGates} / 2`;

      const percentA = Math.round(outlets[0].opening * 100);
      const percentB = Math.round(outlets[1].opening * 100);
      sceneValueA.textContent = `DN 600 · ${percentA}%`;
      sceneValueB.textContent = `DN 450 · ${percentB}%`;

      // Scene labels.
      positionLabel(labelA, new THREE.Vector3(-0.72, 2.36, 0.5));
      positionLabel(labelB, new THREE.Vector3(0.72, 2.36, 0.5));
      positionLabel(labelMain, new THREE.Vector3(-2.55, 1.78, -1.55));

      renderer.render(scene, camera);

      if (firstFrame) {
        firstFrame = false;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => loading.classList.add("is-hidden"));
      }
    }

    renderer.setAnimationLoop(animate);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

function annulusGeometry(inner,outer,depth,start=0,end=TAU,bevel=.025) {
 const shape=new THREE.Shape();
 if (end-start >= TAU-.0001) {
   shape.absarc(0,0,outer,0,TAU,false);
   const hole=new THREE.Path();
   hole.absarc(0,0,inner,0,TAU,true);
   shape.holes.push(hole);
 } else {
 ...
 }
 const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape,{depth,bevelEnabled:bevel>0,bevelThickness:bevel,bevelSize:bevel,bevelSegments:2,curveSegments:96,steps:1});
 g.translate(0,0,-depth/2);
 g.computeVertexNormals();
 return g;
}
```

`makeSpringGeometry`:
```
function makeSpringGeometry(start,end,coilRadius,turns,wireRadius){
 const axis=end.clone().sub(start);
 const len=axis.length(); axis.normalize();
 let v1 = new THREE.Vector3(-axis.y,axis.x,0);
 if(v1.lengthSq()<.1) v1.set(1,0,0);
 v1.normalize();
 const v2=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(axis,v1).normalize();
 const pts=[];
 const steps=turns*20;
 for i...
  const t=i/steps, phi=t*turns*TAU;
  const center=start.clone().addScaledVector(axis,len*t);
  center.addScaledVector(v1,coilRadius*Math.cos(phi));
  center.addScaledVector(v2,coilRadius*Math.sin(phi));
  pts.push(center);
 const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts,false,'centripetal');
 return new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve,steps,wireRadius,8,false);
}
```
`TubeGeometry` path uses getPointAt (arc-length), so helix pitch uniform-ish, okay.
