```html
  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
    const DEG = Math.PI / 180;
    const clamp = THREE.MathUtils.clamp;

    const sceneElement = document.getElementById("scene");
    const loading = document.getElementById("loading");
    const leaders = document.getElementById("leaders");
    const callouts = document.getElementById("callouts");

    let renderer;

    try {
      renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
        antialias: true,
        powerPreference: "high-performance"
      });
    } catch (error) {
      loading.querySelector(".message").textContent =
        "WebGL is required to view this assembly";
      throw error;
    }

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.setClearColor(0x080d13, 1);

    renderer.domElement.id = "viewport";
    renderer.domElement.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "Interactive 3D cutaway of a six-roller overrunning clutch"
    );
    renderer.domElement.tabIndex = 0;
    sceneElement.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x080d13);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x080d13, 18, 35);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      42,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      80
    );

    const assembly = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(assembly);

    // Procedural image-based lighting; no external assets.
    function createEnvironment() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 512;
      canvas.height = 256;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const vertical = context.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 256);
      vertical.addColorStop(0, "#dce9f4");
      vertical.addColorStop(0.42, "#617487");
      vertical.addColorStop(0.66, "#1a222c");
      vertical.addColorStop(1, "#070a0e");
      context.fillStyle = vertical;
      context.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 256);

      function glow(x, y, radius, inner, outer) {
        const gradient = context.createRadialGradient(
          x, y, 0, x, y, radius
        );
        gradient.addColorStop(0, inner);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, outer);
        context.fillStyle = gradient;
        context.fillRect(x - radius, y - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2);
      }

      glow(82, 54, 88, "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)", "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
      glow(310, 42, 112, "rgba(170,213,255,0.82)", "rgba(170,213,255,0)");
      glow(445, 112, 76, "rgba(255,192,116,0.66)", "rgba(255,192,116,0)");
      glow(218, 162, 64, "rgba(110,150,180,0.34)", "rgba(110,150,180,0)");

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.mapping = THREE.EquirectangularReflectionMapping;
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

      const pmrem = new THREE.PMREMGenerator(renderer);
      const target = pmrem.fromEquirectangular(texture);
      pmrem.dispose();
      texture.dispose();

      return target.texture;
    }

    scene.environment = createEnvironment();

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xd6e7fa, 0x121820, 1.4);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 3.8);
    keyLight.position.set(5, 8, 12);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -8;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 8;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 8;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -8;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 2;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 30;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.00035;
    keyLight.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    scene.add(keyLight, keyLight.target);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x9bc7ff, 2.0);
    fillLight.position.set(-8, 1, 7);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffc58d, 1.55);
    rimLight.position.set(5, -5, -6);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    const warmPoint = new THREE.PointLight(0xffb567, 42, 24, 2);
    warmPoint.position.set(4, -4, 7);
    scene.add(warmPoint);

    const coolPoint = new THREE.PointLight(0x8dc9ff, 48, 26, 2);
    coolPoint.position.set(-4, 5, 4);
    scene.add(coolPoint);

    const materials = {
      outer: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xaeb8c2,
        metalness: 0.98,
        roughness: 0.23,
        envMapIntensity: 1.45
      }),
      inner: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x8795a2,
        metalness: 0.98,
        roughness: 0.27,
        envMapIntensity: 1.35
      }),
      ramp: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xc8d1d9,
        metalness: 1,
        roughness: 0.17,
        envMapIntensity: 1.6
      }),
      roller: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xdce3e9,
        metalness: 1,
        roughness: 0.13,
        envMapIntensity: 1.7
      }),
      contact: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf2f6fa,
        metalness: 1,
        roughness: 0.08,
        envMapIntensity: 1.8
      }),
      cage: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x10161d,
        metalness: 0.72,
        roughness: 0.32,
        envMapIntensity: 1.15
      }),
      bronze: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xc17c35,
        metalness: 0.9,
        roughness: 0.22,
        envMapIntensity: 1.55
      }),
      darkSteel: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x37414b,
        metalness: 0.92,
        roughness: 0.31,
        envMapIntensity: 1.1
      }),
      bolt: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x5d6975,
        metalness: 0.95,
        roughness: 0.2,
        envMapIntensity: 1.4
      }),
      recess: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x080b0f,
        metalness: 0.65,
        roughness: 0.45
      }),
      floor: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x090d12,
        metalness: 0.12,
        roughness: 0.88
      })
    };

    const edgeMaterial = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x455563,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.32
    });

    function put(geometry, material, parent = assembly, castShadow = true) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      mesh.castShadow = castShadow;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function annulusGeometry(
      inner,
      outer,
      depth,
      {
        bevel = 0.025,
        start = 0,
        end = TAU,
        segments = 96
      } = {}
    ) {
      const shape = new THREE.Shape();

      if (end - start >= TAU - 0.0001) {
        shape.absarc(0, 0, outer, 0, TAU, false);

        const hole = new THREE.Path();
        hole.absarc(0, 0, inner, 0, TAU, true);
        shape.holes.push(hole);
      } else {
        shape.moveTo(Math.cos(start) * outer, Math.sin(start) * outer);
        shape.absarc(0, 0, outer, start, end, false);
        shape.lineTo(Math.cos(end) * inner, Math.sin(end) * inner);
        shape.absarc(0, 0, inner, end, start, true);
        shape.closePath();
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
        depth,
        steps: 1,
        curveSegments: segments,
        bevelEnabled: bevel > 0,
        bevelThickness: bevel,
        bevelSize: bevel,
        bevelSegments: 2
      });

      geometry.translate(0, 0, -depth / 2);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();
      return geometry;
    }

    function cylinderBetween(start, end, radius, material, radialSegments = 12) {
      const direction = end.clone().sub(start);
      const length = direction.length();

      const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
        radius,
        radius,
        length,
        radialSegments,
        1,
        false
      );

      const mesh = put(geometry, material);
      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );
      return mesh;
    }

    function springGeometry(
      start,
      end,
      coilRadius = 0.095,
      turns = 8,
      wireRadius = 0.022
    ) {
      const axis = end.clone().sub(start);
      const length = axis.length();
      axis.normalize();

      let basisA = new THREE.Vector3(-axis.y, axis.x, 0);
      if (basisA.lengthSq() < 0.01) {
        basisA.set(1, 0, 0);
      }
      basisA.normalize();

      const basisB = new THREE.Vector3()
        .crossVectors(axis, basisA)
        .normalize();

      const points = [];
      const steps = turns * 20;

      for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
        const t = i / steps;
        const phase = t * turns * TAU;

        const point = start.clone().addScaledVector(axis, length * t);
        point.addScaledVector(basisA, Math.cos(phase) * coilRadius);
        point.addScaledVector(basisB, Math.sin(phase) * coilRadius);
        points.push(point);
      }

      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points, false, "centripetal");
      return new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, steps, wireRadius, 7, false);
    }

    function addBolt(position, radius = 0.08) {
      const washerGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
        radius * 1.55,
        radius * 1.55,
        0.025,
        24
      );
      washerGeometry.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
      const washer = put(washerGeometry, materials.darkSteel);
      washer.position.copy(position);
      washer.position.z -= 0.015;

      const headGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
        radius,
        radius,
        0.07,
        6
      );
      headGeometry.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
      const head = put(headGeometry, materials.bolt);
      head.position.copy(position);
      head.position.z += 0.035;

      const socket = put(
        new THREE.CircleGeometry(radius * 0.32, 12),
        materials.recess,
        assembly,
        false
      );
      socket.position.copy(position);
      socket.position.z += 0.072;
    }

    // Subtle technical backdrop and shadow floor.
    const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(8.2, 128),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x0c141d })
    );
    backdrop.position.z = -3.25;
    scene.add(backdrop);

    const backdropRing = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(6.15, 6.17, 160),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0x274154,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.34
      })
    );
    backdropRing.position.z = -3.22;
    scene.add(backdropRing);

    const floor = put(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(40, 40),
      materials.floor,
      scene,
      false
    );
    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    floor.position.y = -6.15;
    floor.receiveShadow = true;

    // Fixed, ground inner race.
    const innerRace = put(
      annulusGeometry(1.08, 2.36, 1.2, { bevel: 0.035 }),
      materials.inner
    );
    innerRace.position.z = -0.1;

    const innerRaceEdges = new THREE.LineSegments(
      new THREE.EdgesGeometry(innerRace.geometry, 32),
      edgeMaterial
    );
    innerRaceEdges.position.copy(innerRace.position);
    assembly.add(innerRaceEdges);

    const contactBandGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
      2.372,
      2.372,
      1.18,
      128,
      1,
      true
    );
    contactBandGeometry.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
    const contactBand = put(contactBandGeometry, materials.contact);
    contactBand.position.z = -0.08;

    const innerRaceLip = put(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(2.25, 0.026, 8, 128),
      materials.contact
    );
    innerRaceLip.position.z = 0.515;

    const fixedShaftGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
      1.045,
      1.045,
      1.9,
      64
    );
    fixedShaftGeometry.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
    const fixedShaft = put(fixedShaftGeometry, materials.darkSteel);
    fixedShaft.position.z = -0.25;

    // Six recessed fixing points identify the inner race as ground/fixed.
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const angle = (i + 0.5) * TAU / 6;
      const recess = put(
        new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.105, 24),
        materials.recess,
        assembly,
        false
      );
      recess.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * 1.72,
        Math.sin(angle) * 1.72,
        0.508
      );
    }

    // Outer race. The front shell is removed through a 130-degree sector.
    const cutStart = 100 * DEG;
    const cutEnd = 330 * DEG;

    const rearOuterRace = put(
      annulusGeometry(4.12, 5.38, 0.3, { bevel: 0.035 }),
      materials.outer
    );
    rearOuterRace.position.z = -0.65;

    const frontOuterRace = put(
      annulusGeometry(4.12, 5.38, 1.1, {
        bevel: 0.05,
        start: cutStart,
        end: cutEnd
      }),
      materials.outer
    );

    const outerRaceEdges = new THREE.LineSegments(
      new THREE.EdgesGeometry(frontOuterRace.geometry, 34),
      edgeMaterial
    );
    assembly.add(outerRaceEdges);

    function addOuterArc(radius, tube, z, material) {
      const geometry = new THREE.TorusGeometry(
        radius,
        tube,
        9,
        180,
        cutEnd - cutStart
      );
      const arc = put(geometry, material);
      arc.rotation.z = cutStart;
      arc.position.z = z;
      return arc;
    }

    addOuterArc(5.12, 0.036, 0.565, materials.darkSteel);
    addOuterArc(4.34, 0.025, 0.565, materials.contact);

    // Polished radial faces emphasize the sectioned outer race.
    const cutBarGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.26, 0.055, 0.045);

    for (const angle of [cutStart, cutEnd]) {
      const cutBar = put(cutBarGeometry, materials.contact);
      const midRadius = (4.12 + 5.38) * 0.5;
      cutBar.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * midRadius,
        Math.sin(angle) * midRadius,
        0.57
      );
      cutBar.rotation.z = angle;
    }

    const rollerCenterRadius = 2.82;
    const rollerRadius = 0.46;
    const rampNarrowRadius = rollerCenterRadius + rollerRadius;
    const rampWideAngle = 22 * DEG;

    const rampRecords = [];
    const rollerRecords = [];
    const springRecords = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const angle = i * TAU / 6;
      const outerPoints = [];
      const innerPoints = [];

      for (let j = 0; j <= 7; j++) {
        const t = j / 7;
        const localAngle = angle - rampWideAngle + rampWideAngle * t;
        const innerRadius =
          rampNarrowRadius + (4.18 - rampNarrowRadius) * t;

        outerPoints.push(
          new THREE.Vector2(
            Math.cos(localAngle) * 4.58,
            Math.sin(localAngle) * 4.58
          )
        );

        innerPoints.push(
          new THREE.Vector2(
            Math.cos(localAngle) * innerRadius,
            Math.sin(localAngle) * innerRadius
          )
        );
      }

      const rampShape = new THREE.Shape([
        ...outerPoints,
        ...innerPoints.slice().reverse()
      ]);
      rampShape.closePath();

      const rampGeometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(rampShape, {
        depth: 1.02,
        steps: 1,
        bevelEnabled: true,
        bevelThickness: 0.025,
        bevelSize: 0.025,
        bevelSegments: 2
      });
      rampGeometry.translate(0, 0, -0.51);

      const ramp = put(rampGeometry, materials.ramp);
      ramp.name = `Ramp ${i + 1}`;

      const edgeCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
        innerPoints.map(
          point => new THREE.Vector3(point.x, point.y, 0.525)
        )
      );

      const rampEdge = put(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(edgeCurve, 42, 0.018, 6, false),
        materials.contact,
        assembly,
        false
      );
      rampEdge.receiveShadow = true;

      const contactPoint = new THREE.Vector3(
        Math.cos(angle) * rampNarrowRadius,
        Math.sin(angle) * rampNarrowRadius,
        0.5
      );

      const contactMarker = put(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.032, 16, 10),
        materials.contact
      );
      contactMarker.position.copy(contactPoint);

      rampRecords.push({
        angle,
        contact: contactPoint,
        ramp
      });

      // Cylindrical roller, axis parallel to the main shaft.
      const rollerGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
        rollerRadius,
        rollerRadius,
        1.04,
        48,
        1,
        false
      );
      rollerGeometry.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);

      const roller = put(rollerGeometry, materials.roller);
      roller.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * rollerCenterRadius,
        Math.sin(angle) * rollerCenterRadius,
        0
      );
      roller.name = `Roller ${i + 1}`;

      // Fine concentric machining marks on the exposed roller end.
      for (const radius of [0.29, 0.13]) {
        const machiningRing = put(
          new THREE.TorusGeometry(radius, 0.007, 6, 48),
          materials.darkSteel,
          assembly,
          false
        );
        machiningRing.position.copy(roller.position);
        machiningRing.position.z = 0.525;
      }

      rollerRecords.push({
        angle,
        roller,
        front: roller.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0.53))
      });

      // Bronze compression spring pushes tangentially toward the narrow end.
      const radial = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(angle), Math.sin(angle), 0);
      const tangent = new THREE.Vector3(-Math.sin(angle), Math.cos(angle), 0);

      const rollerCenter = new THREE.Vector3(
        radial.x * rollerCenterRadius,
        radial.y * rollerCenterRadius,
        0.05
      );

      const springStart = rollerCenter.clone().addScaledVector(tangent, -1.12);
      const springEnd = rollerCenter.clone().addScaledVector(tangent, -0.49);

      const spring = put(
        springGeometry(springStart, springEnd),
        materials.bronze
      );
      spring.name = `Bronze spring ${i + 1}`;

      // Seat and support connect the spring to the wide end of the ramp.
      const radialSeatTop = new THREE.Vector3(springStart.x, springStart.y, 0)
        .normalize()
        .multiplyScalar(4.14);
      radialSeatTop.z = 0.05;

      cylinderBetween(
        springStart,
        radialSeatTop,
        0.045,
        materials.darkSteel
      );

      const springAxis = springEnd.clone().sub(springStart).normalize();
      cylinderBetween(
        springStart.clone().addScaledVector(springAxis, -0.065),
        springStart.clone().addScaledVector(springAxis, 0.025),
        0.125,
        materials.cage,
        20
      );

      const springTip = put(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.037, 14, 10),
        materials.bronze
      );
      springTip.position.copy(springEnd);

      springRecords.push({
        angle,
        midpoint: springStart.clone().lerp(springEnd, 0.5),
        spring
      });
    }

    // Rear cage web with six equally spaced circular roller windows.
    function cageWebGeometry() {
      const shape = new THREE.Shape();
      shape.absarc(0, 0, 3.72, 0, TAU, false);

      const centerHole = new THREE.Path();
      centerHole.absarc(0, 0, 1.12, 0, TAU, true);
      shape.holes.push(centerHole);

      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const angle = i * TAU / 6;
        const x = Math.cos(angle) * rollerCenterRadius;
        const y = Math.sin(angle) * rollerCenterRadius;

        const windowHole = new THREE.Path();
        windowHole.absarc(x, y, 0.58, 0, TAU, true);
        shape.holes.push(windowHole);
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
        depth: 0.16,
        steps: 1,
        curveSegments: 72,
        bevelEnabled: true,
        bevelThickness: 0.018,
        bevelSize: 0.018,
        bevelSegments: 2
      });

      geometry.translate(0, 0, -0.08);
      return geometry;
    }

    const cageWeb = put(cageWebGeometry(), materials.cage);
    cageWeb.position.z = -0.62;

    // Front retainer rings: each roller is captured in a circular window.
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const angle = i * TAU / 6;
      const retainer = put(
        annulusGeometry(0.49, 0.63, 0.13, {
          bevel: 0.018,
          segments: 48
        }),
        materials.cage
      );

      retainer.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * rollerCenterRadius,
        Math.sin(angle) * rollerCenterRadius,
        0.61
      );
    }

    const cageOuterRing = put(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(3.48, 0.06, 10, 160),
      materials.cage
    );
    cageOuterRing.position.z = 0.62;

    // Central cage hub and radial arms.
    const hubGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.06, 1.06, 0.22, 64);
    hubGeometry.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
    const cageHub = put(hubGeometry, materials.cage);
    cageHub.position.z = 0.68;

    const spokeLength = 2.27 - 1.02;
    const spokeGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(spokeLength, 0.11, 0.13);

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const angle = i * TAU / 6;
      const midRadius = (2.27 + 1.02) * 0.5;

      const spoke = put(spokeGeometry, materials.cage);
      spoke.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * midRadius,
        Math.sin(angle) * midRadius,
        0.61
      );
      spoke.rotation.z = angle;
    }

    // Bolts visibly attach the black cage to its hub.
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const angle = i * TAU / 6;
      addBolt(
        new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * 0.78,
          Math.sin(angle) * 0.78,
          0.79
        ),
        0.075
      );
    }

    const centerCapGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.34, 0.34, 0.055, 48);
    centerCapGeometry.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
    const centerCap = put(centerCapGeometry, materials.bolt);
    centerCap.position.z = 0.81;

    // Camera controls implemented directly with pointer, wheel and keyboard.
    const desired = {
      theta: 0.64,
      phi: 0.8,
      radius: 16.8,
      target: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0)
    };

    const current = {
      theta: desired.theta,
      phi: desired.phi,
      radius: desired.radius,
      target: desired.target.clone()
    };

    let activePointer = null;
    let lastX = 0;
    let lastY = 0;
    let dragMode = "orbit";
    let autoOrbit = false;

    const canvas = renderer.domElement;

    canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", event => event.preventDefault());

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
      if (event.button !== 0 && event.button !== 2) return;

      activePointer = event.pointerId;
      lastX = event.clientX;
      lastY = event.clientY;
      dragMode = event.button === 2 ? "pan" : "orbit";

      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      setAutoOrbit(false);
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", event => {
      if (event.pointerId !== activePointer) return;

      const dx = event.clientX - lastX;
      const dy = event.clientY - lastY;
      lastX = event.clientX;
      lastY = event.clientY;

      if (dragMode === "orbit") {
        desired.theta -= dx * 0.006;
        desired.phi = clamp(desired.phi - dy * 0.005, 0.25, 2.55);
      } else {
        camera.updateMatrixWorld();

        const right = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixColumn(
          camera.matrixWorld,
          0
        );
        const up = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixColumn(
          camera.matrixWorld,
          1
        );
        const panScale = current.radius * 0.0013;

        desired.target
          .addScaledVector(right, -dx * panScale)
          .addScaledVector(up, dy * panScale);
      }
    });

    function endPointer(event) {
      if (event.pointerId !== activePointer) return;
      activePointer = null;

      if (canvas.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
        canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      }
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", endPointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", endPointer);

    canvas.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        desired.radius = clamp(
          desired.radius * Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001),
          8.5,
          25
        );
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    const autoButton = document.getElementById("autoOrbit");
    const labelsButton = document.getElementById("labels");
    const resetButton = document.getElementById("reset");

    function setAutoOrbit(value) {
      autoOrbit = value;
      autoButton.classList.toggle("active", value);
      autoButton.textContent = value ? "Orbiting" : "Auto orbit";
    }

    function resetView() {
      desired.theta = 0.64;
      desired.phi = 0.8;
      desired.radius = 16.8;
      desired.target.set(0, 0, 0);
      setAutoOrbit(false);
    }

    let labelsVisible = true;

    function toggleLabels() {
      labelsVisible = !labelsVisible;
      leaders.classList.toggle("hidden", !labelsVisible);
      callouts.classList.toggle("hidden", !labelsVisible);
      labelsButton.classList.toggle("active", labelsVisible);
      labelsButton.textContent = labelsVisible ? "Labels on" : "Labels off";
    }

    autoButton.addEventListener("click", () => setAutoOrbit(!autoOrbit));
    labelsButton.addEventListener("click", toggleLabels);
    resetButton.addEventListener("click", resetView);

    window.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if (event.repeat) return;

      if (event.code === "KeyR") resetView();
      if (event.code === "KeyL") toggleLabels();

      if (event.code === "Space") {
        event.preventDefault();
        setAutoOrbit(!autoOrbit);
      }

      if (event.code === "ArrowLeft") desired.theta += 0.08;
      if (event.code === "ArrowRight") desired.theta -= 0.08;
      if (event.code === "ArrowUp") desired.phi -= 0.06;
      if (event.code === "ArrowDown") desired.phi += 0.06;

      desired.phi = clamp(desired.phi, 0.25, 2.55);
    });

    // Projected HTML annotations.
    const annotationDefinitions = [
      {
        title: "Internal Ramp",
        detail: "Narrow contact end",
        anchor: rampRecords[1].contact.clone(),
        offset: [-170, -72]
      },
      {
        title: "Cylindrical Roller",
        detail: "Hardened steel",
        anchor: rollerRecords[0].front.clone(),
        offset: [-150, 75]
      },
      {
        title: "Bronze Return Spring",
        detail: "Pushes toward narrow end",
        anchor: springRecords[1].midpoint.clone(),
        offset: [168, -4]
      },
      {
        title: "Ground Inner Race",
        detail: "Fixed steel race",
        anchor: new THREE.Vector3(1.55, -1.45, 0.54),
        offset: [-142, 70]
      },
      {
        title: "Windowed Retaining Cage",
        detail: "Bolted to central hub",
        anchor: new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(TAU / 6) * 3.32,
          Math.sin(TAU / 6) * 3.32,
          0.7
        ),
        offset: [155, -65]
      }
    ];

    const annotations = annotationDefinitions.map(definition => {
      const label = document.createElement("div");
      label.className = "label";
      label.innerHTML = `${definition.title}<small>${definition.detail}</small>`;
      callouts.appendChild(label);

      const line = document.createElementNS(
        "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        "line"
      );
      line.setAttribute("stroke", "rgba(137, 201, 235, 0.62)");
      line.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1");
      line.setAttribute("vector-effect", "non-scaling-stroke");
      leaders.appendChild(line);

      const dot = document.createElementNS(
        "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        "circle"
      );
      dot.setAttribute("r", "2.5");
      dot.setAttribute("fill", "#a8d7f0");
      leaders.appendChild(dot);

      return { ...definition, label, line, dot };
    });

    function updateAnnotations() {
      const width = window.innerWidth;
      const height = window.innerHeight;

      for (const annotation of annotations) {
        const projected = annotation.anchor.clone().project(camera);
        const visible = projected.z > -1 && projected.z < 1;

        if (!visible) {
          annotation.label.style.opacity = "0";
          annotation.line.style.opacity = "0";
          annotation.dot.style.opacity = "0";
          continue;
        }

        const anchorX = (projected.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * width;
        const anchorY = (-projected.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * height;

        const labelX = clamp(
          anchorX + annotation.offset[0],
          88,
          width - 88
        );
        const labelY = clamp(
          anchorY + annotation.offset[1],
          52,
          height - 52
        );

        annotation.label.style.opacity = "1";
        annotation.line.style.opacity = "1";
        annotation.dot.style.opacity = "1";

        annotation.label.style.left = `${labelX}px`;
        annotation.label.style.top = `${labelY}px`;

        annotation.line.setAttribute("x1", anchorX);
        annotation.line.setAttribute("y1", anchorY);
        annotation.line.setAttribute("x2", labelX);
        annotation.line.setAttribute("y2", labelY);

        annotation.dot.setAttribute("cx", anchorX);
        annotation.dot.setAttribute("cy", anchorY);
      }
    }

    function resize() {
      const width = window.innerWidth;
      const height = window.innerHeight;

      renderer.setSize(width, height);
      camera.aspect = width / height;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

      leaders.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
    }

    window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
    resize();

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();
    let firstFrame = true;

    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);

      const delta = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);
      const damping = 1 - Math.exp(-delta * 11);

      if (autoOrbit) {
        desired.theta += delta * 0.11;
      }

      current.theta = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
        current.theta,
        desired.theta,
        damping
      );
      current.phi = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
        current.phi,
        desired.phi,
        damping
      );
      current.radius = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
        current.radius,
        desired.radius,
        damping
      );
      current.target.lerp(desired.target, damping);

      const sinPhi = Math.sin(current.phi);

      camera.position.set(
        current.target.x +
          current.radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(current.theta),
        current.target.y +
          current.radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(current.theta),
        current.target.z + current.radius * Math.cos(current.phi)
      );

      camera.lookAt(current.target);
      camera.updateMatrixWorld();

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      updateAnnotations();

      if (firstFrame) {
        firstFrame = false;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => loading.classList.add("done"));
      }
    }

    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```
